/**
 * Real Payments API â€” implements the PaymentsApi contract (Paystack flows are
 * proxied through the backend; the frontend never holds Paystack keys).
 *
 * SUCCESS RULE: `verifyPayment()` reports exactly what the backend reports.
 * "success" means the backend said success â€” never that a redirect happened
 * or that a reference exists.
 */
import type {
  PaymentInitializationRequest,
  PaymentInitializationResponse,
  PaymentVerificationResponse,
} from '../types';
import type { PaymentsApi } from '../services/payments';
import { ApiError } from '../errors';
import { httpClient } from './client';
import { isRecord, toNumber, toText } from '../normalize';

export class RealPaymentsApi implements PaymentsApi {
  async initializePayment(
    data: PaymentInitializationRequest,
  ): Promise<PaymentInitializationResponse> {
    const raw = await httpClient.post<unknown>('/payments/initialize', data);
    const body = isRecord(raw) ? raw : {};
    const authorizationUrl = toText(body.authorizationUrl)
      ?? toText(body.authorization_url)
      ?? toText(body.checkoutUrl);
    const reference = toText(body.reference) ?? toText(body.transactionReference);
    const statusText = toText(body.status);
    const status: PaymentInitializationResponse['status'] =
      statusText === 'success' ? 'success'
      : statusText === 'failed' ? 'failed'
      : (() => {
        throw new ApiError({
          message: 'The payment server returned an unknown initialization status.',
          status: 0,
          code: 'UNKNOWN_ERROR',
        });
      })();
    if (!authorizationUrl || !reference) {
      // A 2xx without a checkout URL/reference cannot start a payment â€”
      // surface it instead of redirecting the buyer into the void.
      throw new ApiError({
        message: 'The payment could not be initialized. Please try again.',
        status: 0,
        code: 'UNKNOWN_ERROR',
      });
    }
    return { authorizationUrl, reference, status };
  }

  async verifyPayment(reference: string): Promise<PaymentVerificationResponse> {
    const raw = await httpClient.get<unknown>(
      `/payments/verify/${encodeURIComponent(reference)}`,
    );
    const body = isRecord(raw) ? raw : {};
    const statusText = toText(body.status) ?? toText(body.state);
    // Only the backend's explicit words map to a state; anything else is
    // "pending" â€” the honest "we do not know yet" answer.
    const status: PaymentVerificationResponse['status'] =
      statusText === 'success' ? 'success'
      : statusText === 'failed' ? 'failed'
      : 'pending';
    return {
      reference: toText(body.reference) ?? reference,
      status,
      amount: toNumber(body.amount),
      currency: toText(body.currency),
      transactionId: toText(body.transactionId) ?? toText(body.transaction_id),
      paidAt: toText(body.paidAt) ?? toText(body.paid_at),
      orderId: toText(body.orderId) ?? toText(body.order_id),
    };
  }
}

===== C:\Users\Admin\Universe-frontend\Universe-frontend\universe-react\src\api\real\products.api.ts =====

/**
 * Real Products API â€” implements the ProductsApi contract against the real
 * backend through the DOCUMENTED server-side pagination endpoint
 * `GET /products` (docs/API_CONTRACT.md).
 *
 * DESIGN RULE: the backend owns filtering, searching, sorting and paging. One
 * `getProducts()` call performs exactly ONE HTTP request â€” the adapter never
 * downloads the catalog page-by-page and filters locally. When the backend
 * caps `pageSize` it simply returns its own page size; the UI then either
 * accepts the smaller page or uses explicit pagination.
 *
 * `getAllProducts()` is the ONLY multi-request path: an explicit, opt-in
 * aggregation helper (max 20 requests) for callers that genuinely need every
 * matching item (e.g. export/backfill tooling). No UI code uses it today.
 *
 * Every payload passes through the normalizers in ../normalize, so the whole
 * marketplace keeps working whatever dialect the backend speaks: snake_case
 * keys, DRF pagination (`{ count, results }`), string numbers, or
 * `{ data: ... }` envelopes.
 */
import type {
  CreateProductRequest,
  Product,
  ProductQueryParams,
  PaginatedResponse,
  UpdateProductRequest,
} from '../types';
import type { ProductsApi } from '../services/products';
import { ApiError } from '../errors';
import { httpClient } from './client';
import {
  isRecord,
  normalizeProduct,
  toPaginatedResponse,
  unwrapEnvelope,
} from '../normalize';

/**
 * Safety valve for `getAllProducts` ONLY: one aggregation never fires more
 * HTTP requests than this, however the backend chooses to paginate.
 */
const MAX_PAGE_REQUESTS = 20;
/** Prevent a normal UI list call from requesting an unbounded catalog page. */
const MAX_NORMAL_PAGE_SIZE = 50;

/** Build the query string exactly as documented in docs/API_CONTRACT.md. */
export function buildProductQuery(values: ProductQueryParams): string {
  const sp = new URLSearchParams();
  if (values.sellerId) sp.set('seller_id', values.sellerId);
  if (values.status) sp.set('status', values.status);
  if (values.category) sp.set('category', values.category);
  if (values.search) sp.set('search', values.search);
  if (values.featured !== undefined) sp.set('featured', String(values.featured));
  if (values.page) sp.set('page', String(values.page));
  if (values.pageSize) sp.set('page_size', String(values.pageSize));
  const qs = sp.toString();
  return qs ? `?${qs}` : '';
}

/** Contract-violating 2xx response (no usable product id) -> explicit error. */
function productShapeError(): ApiError {
  return new ApiError({
    message: 'The server returned an unexpected product response.',
    status: 0,
    code: 'UNKNOWN_ERROR',
  });
}

export class RealProductsApi implements ProductsApi {
  /**
   * List products â€” ONE server request, server-side pagination.
   *
   * The workshop, buyer search, seller shop and storefront pages may ask for
  * large page sizes; this adapter caps normal requests at 50 and the backend
  * may apply a lower maximum. The frontend NEVER walks remaining pages here â€”
   * see `getAllProducts()` for the explicit opt-in aggregation.
   */
  async getProducts(params: ProductQueryParams = {}): Promise<PaginatedResponse<Product>> {
    const requested = {
      page: Math.max(1, params.page ?? 1),
      pageSize: Math.min(MAX_NORMAL_PAGE_SIZE, Math.max(1, params.pageSize ?? 40)),
    };
    const response = toPaginatedResponse(
      await httpClient.get<unknown>(`/products${buildProductQuery({ ...params, ...requested })}`),
      requested,
    );
    return response;
  }

  /**
   * OPT-IN aggregation: fetch EVERY matching product by walking pages, capped
   * at MAX_PAGE_REQUESTS requests. Explicit by design â€” a caller that runs
   * this accepts up to 20 HTTP round-trips. Nothing in the UI uses it today.
   */
  async getAllProducts(params: ProductQueryParams = {}): Promise<PaginatedResponse<Product>> {
    const requested = {
      page: Math.max(1, params.page ?? 1),
      pageSize: Math.max(1, params.pageSize ?? 40),
    };
    const first = toPaginatedResponse(
      await httpClient.get<unknown>(`/products${buildProductQuery({ ...params, ...requested })}`),
      requested,
    );
    const collected = [...first.items];
    const seen = new Set(collected.map((product) => product.id));
    const backendPageSize = first.pageSize > 0 ? first.pageSize : requested.pageSize;

    for (let request = 1; request < MAX_PAGE_REQUESTS; request += 1) {
      if (collected.length >= first.total) break;
      const cursor = requested.page + request;
      const next = toPaginatedResponse(
        await httpClient.get<unknown>(
          `/products${buildProductQuery({ ...params, page: cursor, pageSize: backendPageSize })}`,
        ),
        { page: cursor, pageSize: backendPageSize },
      );
      const added = next.items.filter((product) => !seen.has(product.id));
      if (added.length === 0) break; // exhausted / backend ignored `page`
      added.forEach((product) => seen.add(product.id));
      collected.push(...added);
    }

    return { items: collected, page: requested.page, pageSize: requested.pageSize, total: first.total };
  }

  async getProduct(id: string): Promise<Product> {
    const raw = await httpClient.get<unknown>(`/products/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`);
    const product = normalizeProduct(unwrapEnvelope(raw, ['product', 'data', 'item']));
    if (!product.id) throw productShapeError();
    return product;
  }

  /**
   * Create a product. The backend MUST return the created product (200/201).
   * The adapter never merges the REQUEST into the response â€” that would
   * pretend the backend stored exactly what the client sent.
   */
  async createProduct(data: CreateProductRequest): Promise<Product> {
    const raw = await httpClient.post<unknown>('/products', data);
    const product = normalizeProduct(unwrapEnvelope(isRecord(raw) ? raw : {}, ['product', 'data', 'item']));
    if (!product.id) throw productShapeError();
    return product;
  }

  /**
   * Update a product. The backend MUST return the updated product; when it
   * answers 204/empty the adapter re-reads the authoritative record instead
   * of echoing the submitted patch back as if it were server truth.
   */
  async updateProduct(id: string, data: UpdateProductRequest): Promise<Product> {
    const raw = await httpClient.patch<unknown>(`/products/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, data);
    const body = unwrapEnvelope(isRecord(raw) ? raw : {}, ['product', 'data', 'item']);
    if (isRecord(body) && normalizeProduct(body).id) {
      return normalizeProduct(body);
    }
    return this.getProduct(id);
  }

  async deleteProduct(id: string): Promise<void> {
    return httpClient.delete<void>(`/products/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`);
  }
}

===== C:\Users\Admin\Universe-frontend\Universe-frontend\universe-react\src\api\real\storefront.api.ts =====

/**
 * Real backend implementation of the storefront API.
 *
 * Performs exactly ONE documented request: `GET /storefront/:slug`
 * (public â€” buyers on a store domain are not authenticated, so skipAuth is
 * set and a 401 can never cascade into a token refresh).
 *
 * RESPONSIBILITY BOUNDARY: this adapter never calls other API implementations
 * (no hidden products-API dependency). The backend is expected to EMBED the
 * store's catalog in the response; when it does not, the response still
 * carries `sellerId` and the documented product API (`GET /products?sellerId=`)
 * can be used SEPARATELY â€” composition happens in the hook/UI layer, never
 * inside this class. Nothing is fabricated to fill an empty catalog: the page
 * simply renders its empty state.
 */
import type { Storefront } from '../types';
import type { StorefrontApi } from '../services/storefront';
import { slugifyStoreName } from '../../lib/storeDomain';
import { httpClient } from './client';
import { isRecord, unwrapEnvelope } from '../normalize';
import { normalizeStorefront } from './storefront.normalize';

/** Envelopes a backend may wrap the storefront payload in. */
const STOREFRONT_ENVELOPE = ['storefront', 'store', 'data'];

export class RealStorefrontApi implements StorefrontApi {
  async getStorefront(slug: string): Promise<Storefront> {
    const raw = await httpClient.get<unknown>(`/storefront/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}`, true);
    const payload = unwrapEnvelope(isRecord(raw) ? raw : {}, STOREFRONT_ENVELOPE);
    return normalizeStorefront(payload, slugifyStoreName(slug) || slug);
  }
}

===== C:\Users\Admin\Universe-frontend\Universe-frontend\universe-react\src\api\real\storefront.normalize.ts =====

/**
 * Storefront normalizer for GET /storefront/:slug (REAL backend).
 *
 * PURPOSE: convert the backend payload into the shape StorefrontPage renders.
 * StorefrontPage reads ~40 fields and calls `.toFixed()`, `.toLocaleString()`
 * and `.map()` on several of them, so every field must exist â€” but existence
 * is achieved with NULL for unknown business data, never with invented values.
 *
 * FABRICATION RULES (docs/API_CONTRACT.md -> Storefront):
 * - rating / reviewCount / followers are SELLER-OWNED stats: pass through or
 *   null. They are never derived from the product catalog, never defaulted to
 *   4.9/2104 â€” the UI renders "â€”" / "No reviews yet" for null.
 * - badge (flash/bestseller) is set ONLY when the backend sends it. It is
 *   never inferred from a salePrice â€” a discount is not a flash sale.
 * - campusPickup is pass-through only; it is never inferred from a category.
 * - popularity is pass-through only; never synthesized from ratings.
 * - assurances (stockNote, pickupNote, badgeLabel, campusTag, bioLead,
 *   reviewsNote) are the seller's words: pass-through or null.
 * - prices are passed through as numbers; a formatted `priceLabel` is derived
 *   ONLY from a real price (display formatting, not new data).
 *
 * The cosmetic values below are the ONLY derivations allowed, all documented:
 * - `slug`/`domain` are routing/display values derived from the requested slug,
 * - `whatsappUrl` built from the seller's real phone,
 * - `catalogCounts` counted from the catalog the response actually contains
 *   (backend-sent counts win when present),
 * - `memberSinceLabel` from the backend's real member-since/createdAt date,
 * - `pickupNote` naming the backend's real pickupLocation,
 * - `imageAlt` from the product name (accessibility),
 * - `/logo.png` placeholder where an <img> would otherwise break.
 */
import type {
  ProductVariant,
  Storefront,
  StorefrontAssurance,
  StorefrontBioBadge,
  StorefrontCategory,
  StorefrontProduct,
  StorefrontReview,
} from '../types';
import { getPrettyStoreDomain } from '../../lib/storeDomain';
import {
  isRecord,
  pick,
  toBoolean,
  toNumber,
  toText,
  toStringArray,
} from '../normalize';

/** Category buckets shown on the storefront tab bar. */
const CATEGORY_LABELS: Record<StorefrontCategory, string> = {
  tech: 'Tech & Gadgets',
  campus: 'Campus Essentials',
  lifestyle: 'Lifestyle & Accessories',
};

const CATEGORY_KEYS = Object.keys(CATEGORY_LABELS) as StorefrontCategory[];

/** Last-resort cover so an `<img src>` never renders a broken-image icon. */
const PLACEHOLDER_IMAGE = '/logo.png';

/**
 * Free-form category text -> storefront bucket.
 *
 * DERIVED: bucketing is a UI routing concern (which tab a product appears
 * under); the backend's own category text is never modified.
 */
export function storefrontCategory(value: unknown): StorefrontCategory {
  const text = (toText(value) ?? '').toLowerCase();
  if (CATEGORY_KEYS.includes(text as StorefrontCategory)) return text as StorefrontCategory;
  if (/tech|electronic|gadget|phone|laptop|computer|device|accessor/.test(text)) return 'tech';
  if (/campus|school|book|station|study|supplie/.test(text)) return 'campus';
  return 'lifestyle';
}

/** "â‚¦1,249" style â€” storefront prices are formatted in Nigerian Naira. */
function ngn(value: number): string {
  return `â‚¦${Math.round(value).toLocaleString('en-US')}`;
}

/** "07051917468" -> "https://wa.me/2347051917468" (empty when no phone). */
function toWhatsappUrl(phone?: string | null): string {
  const digits = (phone ?? '').replace(/\D/g, '');
  if (!digits) return '';
  const local = digits.startsWith('0') ? digits.slice(1) : digits;
  return `https://wa.me/234${local}`;
}

/** Year from an ISO date; null when the value is not a usable date. */
function yearOf(value: unknown): number | null {
  const text = toText(value);
  if (!text) return null;
  const parsed = new Date(text);
  return Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime()) ? null : parsed.getFullYear();
}

/* --------------------------- Storefront products -------------------------- */

/** Normalize variant option groups (null when there are none). */
function normalizeStorefrontVariants(value: unknown): ProductVariant[] | null {
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) return null;
  const groups: ProductVariant[] = [];
  for (const entry of value) {
    if (!isRecord(entry)) continue;
    const name = toText(pick(entry, ['name', 'label', 'option']));
    const values = toStringArray(pick(entry, ['values', 'options', 'choices']));
    if (name && values.length > 0) groups.push({ name, values });
  }
  return groups.length > 0 ? groups : null;
}

/**
    announcementTitle: toText(pick(record, ['announcementTitle'])),
    announcementLead: toText(pick(record, ['announcementLead'])),
 * `StorefrontProduct` (`priceLabel` + `image`).
 *
 * Entries without an id are DROPPED (they cannot be opened, saved to a cart,
 * or keyed by React) â€” never given a synthetic identity.
 */
export function normalizeStorefrontProduct(raw: unknown): StorefrontProduct | null {
  const record = isRecord(raw) ? raw : {};
  const id = toText(pick(record, ['id', 'uuid', '_id']));
  if (!id) return null;
  const name = toText(pick(record, ['name', 'title'])) ?? 'Untitled product';

  const images = toStringArray(pick(record, ['images', 'gallery', 'photos']));
  const cover = toText(pick(record, ['image', 'imageUrl', 'coverImage', 'photo', 'thumbnail']));
  const gallery = cover && !images.includes(cover) ? [cover, ...images] : images;
  // DERIVED (placeholder): an <img> with no src breaks the grid â€” fall back
  // to the app logo instead of inventing product imagery.
  if (gallery.length === 0) gallery.push(PLACEHOLDER_IMAGE);

  const price = toNumber(pick(record, ['price', 'amount']));
  const salePrice = toNumber(pick(record, ['salePrice', 'discountedPrice', 'discountPrice']));
  // DERIVED: when the backend sends both prices, buyers see the sale price and
  // the regular price becomes the strikethrough. Both come from the backend.
  const onSale = salePrice !== null && price !== null && salePrice < price;
  const displayPrice = onSale ? (salePrice as number) : price;

  const category = storefrontCategory(pick(record, ['category', 'categoryLabel', 'bucket']) ?? name);
  const badgeText = toText(pick(record, ['badge']));
  const variants = normalizeStorefrontVariants(pick(record, ['variants', 'options']));

  return {
    id,
    name,
    description: toText(pick(record, ['description', 'details', 'summary'])),
    category,
    // DERIVED: display label for the backend's category bucket.
    categoryLabel: toText(pick(record, ['categoryLabel'])) ?? CATEGORY_LABELS[category],
    price: displayPrice,
    // DERIVED: format the real price; a backend-formatted label wins as-is.
    priceLabel: toText(pick(record, ['priceLabel'])) ?? (displayPrice !== null ? ngn(displayPrice) : null),
    // DERIVED: strikethrough of the real regular price during a real sale.
    oldPriceLabel: onSale ? ngn(price as number) : (toText(pick(record, ['oldPriceLabel', 'oldPrice'])) ?? null),
    rating: toNumber(pick(record, ['rating', 'averageRating'])),
    reviews: toNumber(pick(record, ['reviews', 'reviewCount', 'reviewsCount'])),
    popularity: toNumber(pick(record, ['popularity', 'sold', 'sales'])),
    stock: toNumber(pick(record, ['stock', 'quantity', 'inventory'])),
    badge: badgeText === 'flash' || badgeText === 'bestseller' ? badgeText : null,
    campusPickup: toBoolean(pick(record, ['campusPickup'])),
    image: gallery[0],
    // DERIVED: accessibility label from the real product name.
    imageAlt: toText(pick(record, ['imageAlt', 'imageDescription', 'alt'])) ?? name,
    images: gallery,
    variants: variants ?? undefined,
  };
}

/* ----------------------------- Storefront tabs ---------------------------- */

function normalizeAssurances(value: unknown): StorefrontAssurance[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) return [];
  const tones = ['primary', 'success', 'tertiary'] as const;
  return value.flatMap((entry) => {
    if (!isRecord(entry)) return [];
    const icon = toText(pick(entry, ['icon']));
    const title = toText(pick(entry, ['title']));
    if (!icon || !title) return [];
    const tone = toText(pick(entry, ['tone']));
    return [{
      icon,
      tone: (tones as readonly string[]).includes(tone ?? '') ? (tone as StorefrontAssurance['tone']) : 'primary',
      title,
      sub: toText(pick(entry, ['sub', 'subtitle', 'description'])) ?? '',
    }];
  });
}

function normalizeBioBadges(value: unknown): StorefrontBioBadge[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) return [];
  const tones = ['success', 'primary', 'tertiary'] as const;
  return value.flatMap((entry) => {
    if (!isRecord(entry)) return [];
    const icon = toText(pick(entry, ['icon']));
    const label = toText(pick(entry, ['label', 'text', 'title']));
    if (!icon || !label) return [];
    const tone = toText(pick(entry, ['tone']));
    return [{
      icon,
      tone: (tones as readonly string[]).includes(tone ?? '') ? (tone as StorefrontBioBadge['tone']) : 'primary',
      label,
    }];
  });
}

function normalizeReviews(value: unknown): StorefrontReview[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) return [];
  return value.flatMap((entry, index) => {
    if (!isRecord(entry)) return [];
    const name = toText(pick(entry, ['name', 'author', 'buyerName']));
    const text = toText(pick(entry, ['text', 'body', 'comment']));
    if (!name || !text) return [];
    const tone = toText(pick(entry, ['avatarTone', 'tone']));
    return [{
      id: toText(pick(entry, ['id', 'uuid'])) ?? `rev-${index}`,
      initials: toText(pick(entry, ['initials'])) ?? name.trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase(),
      name,
      meta: toText(pick(entry, ['meta', 'subtitle', 'context'])) ?? '',
      text,
      avatarTone: tone === 'secondary' ? 'secondary' : 'primary',
    }];
  });
}

/**
 * Catalog tab counts.
 *
 * Backend-sent counts win when present. Otherwise the tabs count the catalog
 * ACTUALLY INCLUDED in this response â€” an honest tally of real data, never an
 * estimate of a larger catalog. When no catalog is present every count is 0.
 */
function normalizeCatalogCounts(
  value: unknown,
  products: StorefrontProduct[],
): Record<StorefrontCategory | 'all', number> {
  const record = isRecord(value) ? value : {};
  const countIn = (bucket: StorefrontCategory) => products.filter((p) => p.category === bucket).length;
  const zero = toNumber(pick(record, ['all', 'total']));
  return {
    all: zero ?? products.length,
    tech: toNumber(pick(record, ['tech'])) ?? countIn('tech'),
    campus: toNumber(pick(record, ['campus'])) ?? countIn('campus'),
    lifestyle: toNumber(pick(record, ['lifestyle'])) ?? countIn('lifestyle'),
  };
}

/* ------------------------------- Storefront ------------------------------- */

/**
 * Build a renderable `Storefront` from the backend payload.
 *
 * @param raw  Whatever `GET /storefront/:slug` returned (already unwrapped).
 * @param slug Slug used to resolve the store â€” authoritative for the URL,
 *             the display domain and the cosmetic store code.
 */
export function normalizeStorefront(raw: unknown, slug: string): Storefront {
  const record = isRecord(raw) ? raw : {};
  const embedded = pick(record, ['products', 'catalog', 'items', 'storeProducts']);
  const catalog = Array.isArray(embedded) ? embedded : [];
  const products = catalog
    .map((entry) => normalizeStorefrontProduct(entry))
    .filter((entry): entry is StorefrontProduct => entry !== null);

  const name = toText(pick(record, ['name', 'storeName', 'title'])) ?? slug;
  const owner = toText(pick(record, ['owner', 'ownerName', 'sellerName', 'fullName'])) ?? '';
  const school = toText(pick(record, ['school', 'university', 'institution'])) ?? '';
  const phone = toText(pick(record, ['phone', 'phoneNumber', 'whatsapp'])) ?? '';
  const bannerImages = toStringArray(pick(record, ['bannerImages', 'banners']));
  // DERIVED: the hero image mirrors the first gallery image when only the
  // array is sent (the mock API denormalizes the same way).
  const bannerImage = toText(pick(record, ['bannerImage', 'bannerUrl', 'banner'])) ?? bannerImages[0] ?? null;
  const avatarImage = toText(pick(record, ['avatarImage', 'logoUrl', 'logo']));
  const pickupLocation = toText(pick(record, ['pickupLocation', 'location']));

  // DERIVED: "Since <year>" from the backend's real membership date only â€”
  // when no date exists the label is null, never the current year.
  const sinceYear = yearOf(pick(record, ['memberSince', 'createdAt']));
  const memberSinceLabel = toText(pick(record, ['memberSinceLabel']))
    ?? (sinceYear !== null ? `Since ${sinceYear}` : null);

  return {
    slug: toText(pick(record, ['slug'])) ?? slug,
    name,
    owner,
    school,
    // Backend-owned identifier. Missing means the backend did not provide one.
    storeId: toText(pick(record, ['storeId'])),
    sellerId: toText(pick(record, ['sellerId', 'userId', 'ownerId', 'sellerUserId'])),
    // SELLER STATS: pass through or null. Never derived from the catalog.
    rating: toNumber(pick(record, ['rating', 'averageRating'])),
    reviewCount: toNumber(pick(record, ['reviewCount', 'reviewsCount'])),
    followers: toNumber(pick(record, ['followers', 'followerCount'])),
    // Seller metrics are backend-owned; absence stays null.
    fulfillmentLabel: toText(pick(record, ['fulfillmentLabel'])),
    responseTimeLabel: toText(pick(record, ['responseTimeLabel'])),
    memberSinceLabel,
    badgeLabel: toText(pick(record, ['badgeLabel'])),
    campusTag: toText(pick(record, ['campusTag'])),
    stockNote: toText(pick(record, ['stockNote'])),
    // DERIVED: name the backend's real pickup hub; null when there is none.
    pickupNote: toText(pick(record, ['pickupNote']))
      ?? (pickupLocation ? `Campus Pickup: ${pickupLocation}` : null),
    template: toText(pick(record, ['template', 'storeTemplate', 'theme'])),
    pickupLocation,
    // DERIVED: pretty display domain from the requested slug (routing aid).
    domain: toText(pick(record, ['domain'])) ?? getPrettyStoreDomain(slug),
    // DERIVED: deep-link built from the seller's real phone; '' when none.
    whatsappUrl: toText(pick(record, ['whatsappUrl'])) ?? toWhatsappUrl(phone),
    phone,
    email: toText(pick(record, ['email', 'supportEmail'])),
    couponCode: toText(pick(record, ['couponCode'])) ?? '',
    announcementTitle: toText(pick(record, ['announcementTitle'])),
    announcementLead: toText(pick(record, ['announcementLead'])),
    bannerImage,
    bannerImages: bannerImages.length > 0 ? bannerImages : (bannerImage ? [bannerImage] : []),
    bannerAlt: toText(pick(record, ['bannerAlt'])) ?? undefined,
    avatarImage,
    avatarAlt: toText(pick(record, ['avatarAlt'])) ?? undefined,
    bioLead: toText(pick(record, ['bioLead', 'bio'])),
    bioDetail: toText(pick(record, ['bioDetail'])),
    bioBadges: normalizeBioBadges(pick(record, ['bioBadges'])),
    reviews: normalizeReviews(pick(record, ['reviews', 'reviewList'])),
    reviewsNote: toText(pick(record, ['reviewsNote'])),
    assurances: normalizeAssurances(pick(record, ['assurances'])),
    catalogCounts: normalizeCatalogCounts(pick(record, ['catalogCounts', 'counts']), products),
    products,
  };
}

/**
 * Real Uploads API â€” multipart/form-data image uploads through the separate
 * HttpClient.upload() path. Success is defined ONLY by the backend response:
 * a locally-rendered preview is never treated as an uploaded image.
 */
import type { UploadedFile } from '../types';
import type { UploadsApi } from '../services/uploads';
import { ApiError } from '../errors';
import { httpClient } from './client';
import { isRecord, toNumber, toText } from '../normalize';

/** Documented endpoint: POST /uploads/images (multipart). */
const UPLOAD_IMAGE_PATH = '/uploads/images';

/** Client-side guards mirrored in the contract (backend enforces its own). */
const MAX_IMAGE_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024;

export class RealUploadsApi implements UploadsApi {
  async uploadImage(file: File): Promise<UploadedFile> {
    if (!file.type.startsWith('image/')) {
      throw new ApiError({
        message: 'Only image files are allowed.',
        status: 0,
        code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
        fieldErrors: { image: 'Only image files are allowed' },
      });
    }
    if (file.size > MAX_IMAGE_BYTES) {
      throw new ApiError({
        message: 'Image must be 5MB or smaller.',
        status: 0,
        code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
        fieldErrors: { image: 'Image must be 5MB or smaller' },
      });
    }

    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append('image', file, file.name);

    const raw = await httpClient.upload<unknown>(UPLOAD_IMAGE_PATH, formData);
    const url = isRecord(raw) ? toText(raw.url) ?? toText(raw.file) ?? toText(raw.path) : null;
    if (!url) {
      // The backend answered 2xx without a stored URL â€” the image did NOT
      // reach storage in a usable way. Never fake a success.
      throw new ApiError({
        message: 'The upload could not be confirmed. Please try again.',
        status: 0,
        code: 'UNKNOWN_ERROR',
      });
    }
    return {
      url,
      name: isRecord(raw) ? toText(raw.name) : null,
      size: isRecord(raw) ? toNumber(raw.size) : null,
    };
  }
}

===== C:\Users\Admin\Universe-frontend\Universe-frontend\universe-react\src\api\real\users.api.ts =====

/**
 * Real Users API â€” implements the UsersApi contract against the real backend.
 *
 * Payloads are normalized (see ../normalize) so the seller workspace, the
 * onboarding wizard and the storefront always receive complete camelCase
 * objects, even when the backend answers with snake_case keys or an envelope.
 *
 * 404 HANDLING POLICY: ONLY `getSellerProfile()` treats a 404 as "profile
 * does not exist yet" and resolves to a blank profile (the UI requires a
 * profile object). That rule lives in exactly one place and checks BOTH the
 * status and the NOT_FOUND code â€” a 404 from any other endpoint, or any other
 * error, is rethrown untouched.
 */
import type {
  ChangePasswordRequest,
  DeleteAccountRequest,
  PublicSellerProfile,
  SellerProfile,
  UpdateEmailRequest,
  UpdateSellerProfileRequest,
  UpdateUserRequest,
  User,
} from '../types';
import type { UsersApi } from '../services/users';
import { ApiError } from '../errors';
import { httpClient } from './client';
import {
  emptySellerProfile,
  isRecord,
  normalizePublicSellerProfile,
  normalizeSellerProfile,
  normalizeUser,
  unwrapEnvelope,
} from '../normalize';

/** Envelopes a backend may wrap a profile/user payload in. */
const PROFILE_ENVELOPE = ['sellerProfile', 'profile', 'data'];
const PUBLIC_PROFILE_ENVELOPE = ['sellerProfile', 'profile', 'seller', 'data'];
const USER_ENVELOPE = ['user', 'data', 'account'];

export class RealUsersApi implements UsersApi {
  /**
   * PUBLIC seller profile (no session required).
   *
   * 404 POLICY: unlike `getSellerProfile()`, a 404 here is a REAL "no such
   * seller" â€” it is rethrown untouched so the profile page renders its
   * "seller not found" state instead of an empty profile shell.
   */
  async getPublicSellerProfile(sellerId: string): Promise<PublicSellerProfile> {
    const raw = await httpClient.get<unknown>(
      `/users/${encodeURIComponent(sellerId)}/seller-profile`,
    );
    return normalizePublicSellerProfile(unwrapEnvelope(raw, PUBLIC_PROFILE_ENVELOPE));
  }

  /**
   * Read the seller profile.
   *
   * A seller who has not filled anything in yet may have no row at all. The
   * mock API auto-creates one on first read and the workspace expects a
   * profile object â€” so a 404 from THIS endpoint resolves to a blank profile
   * and the first PATCH creates the row server-side (PATCH upserts, per the
   * contract).
   *
   * ISOLATION: this conversion applies only to `GET /users/me/seller-profile`.
   * Other 404s (products, storefront, orders...) must NEVER be swallowed into
   * an empty profile â€” they are rethrown as ApiError(NOT_FOUND).
   */
  async getSellerProfile(): Promise<SellerProfile> {
    try {
      const raw = await httpClient.get<unknown>('/users/me/seller-profile');
      return normalizeSellerProfile(unwrapEnvelope(raw, PROFILE_ENVELOPE));
    } catch (error) {
      if (
        error instanceof ApiError
        && error.status === 404
        && error.code === 'NOT_FOUND'
      ) {
        return emptySellerProfile();
      }
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Update the profile. The backend MUST return the updated profile; when it
   * answers 204/empty the adapter re-reads the authoritative record. The
   * submitted payload is NEVER echoed back as if the backend had returned it
   * â€” that would silently pretend unsaved values were saved.
   */
  async updateSellerProfile(data: UpdateSellerProfileRequest): Promise<SellerProfile> {
    const raw = await httpClient.patch<unknown>('/users/me/seller-profile', data);
    const body = unwrapEnvelope(isRecord(raw) ? raw : {}, PROFILE_ENVELOPE);
    if (isRecord(body)) return normalizeSellerProfile(body);
    // 204/empty body â€” fetch the row the backend just wrote (or, for a brand
    // new seller whose GET 404s, an all-empty profile). Never merge `data`.
    return this.getSellerProfile();
  }

  /** Update the account fields (name, phone, avatar). */
  async updateCurrentUser(data: UpdateUserRequest): Promise<User> {
    const raw = await httpClient.patch<unknown>('/users/me', data);
    const body = unwrapEnvelope(isRecord(raw) ? raw : {}, USER_ENVELOPE);
    if (isRecord(body)) return normalizeUser(body);
    // 204 with no body â€” the canonical user comes from GET /auth/me.
    const me = await httpClient.get<unknown>('/auth/me');
    return normalizeUser(unwrapEnvelope(isRecord(me) ? me : {}, USER_ENVELOPE));
  }

  async changePassword(data: ChangePasswordRequest): Promise<void> {
    await httpClient.patch<void>('/users/me/password', data);
  }

  async updateEmail(data: UpdateEmailRequest): Promise<User> {
    const raw = await httpClient.post<unknown>('/users/me/email', data);
    const body = unwrapEnvelope(isRecord(raw) ? raw : {}, USER_ENVELOPE);
    if (isRecord(body)) return normalizeUser(body);
    // 204/empty â€” re-read the authoritative user.
    const me = await httpClient.get<unknown>('/auth/me');
    return normalizeUser(unwrapEnvelope(isRecord(me) ? me : {}, USER_ENVELOPE));
  }

  async deleteAccount(data: DeleteAccountRequest): Promise<void> {
    await httpClient.delete<void>('/users/me', data);
  }
}

===== C:\Users\Admin\Universe-frontend\Universe-frontend\universe-react\src\api\services\auth.ts =====

/**
 * Auth API contract + factory.
 *
 * Components/hooks only ever see this `authApi` object which satisfies the
 * AuthApi interface. Whether it currently resolves to the in-browser mock or

===== C:\Users\Admin\Universe-frontend\Universe-frontend\universe-react\src\api\config.ts =====

/**
 * Central API configuration.
 *
 * The active backend implementation is selected here from ONE environment
 * variable. Switching the whole application between the mock API and the real
 * backend is a config-only change â€” no React component/hook code needs to be
 * edited:
 *
 *   VITE_API_MODE=mock   -> all services resolve to the Mock*Api implementations
 *   VITE_API_MODE=real   -> all services resolve to the HTTP-based implementations
 *
 *   VITE_API_URL           -> base URL used only by the real HTTP client
 *   VITE_MOCK_LATENCY      -> "off" disables the artificial network delay
 *   VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID  -> Google OAuth client id (real Google sign-in)
 */

export type ApiMode = 'mock' | 'real';

export interface MockLatencyOptions {
  enabled: boolean;
  /** Lower bound of the simulated network delay in ms. */
  min: number;
  /** Upper bound of the simulated network delay in ms. */
  max: number;
}

function parseMode(value: string | undefined): ApiMode {
  return value === 'real' ? 'real' : 'mock';
}

function parseMockLatency(value: string | undefined): MockLatencyOptions {
  if (value === 'off' || value === '0' || value === 'false') {
    return { enabled: false, min: 0, max: 0 };
  }
  // ~300â€“800ms so loading/error/empty states can be tested realistically.
  return { enabled: true, min: 300, max: 800 };
}

export interface ApiConfig {
  mode: ApiMode;
  baseUrl: string;
  mockLatency: MockLatencyOptions;
  /**
   * Google OAuth client id (VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID). Empty string disables
   * real Google sign-in â€” the "Continue with Google" button then reports the
   * setup steps through the normal error UI instead of faking an account.
   */
  googleClientId: string;
}

export const apiConfig: ApiConfig = {
  mode: parseMode(import.meta.env.VITE_API_MODE as string | undefined),
  baseUrl: (import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL as string | undefined)?.replace(/\/+$/, '') ?? 'http://localhost:8000/api',
  mockLatency: parseMockLatency(import.meta.env.VITE_MOCK_LATENCY as string | undefined),
  googleClientId: (import.meta.env.VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID as string | undefined)?.trim() ?? '',
};

/** True when the real HTTP client stack is active. */
export const isRealApi = apiConfig.mode === 'real';

===== C:\Users\Admin\Universe-frontend\Universe-frontend\universe-react\src\api\errors.ts =====

/**
 * Consistent API error type shared by the mock API and the real HTTP client.
 *
 * Components only ever see ApiError instances, so the UI does not depend on
 * mock-specific or HTTP-specific error shapes.
 *
 * Error-code rules (see docs/API_CONTRACT.md -> "Error format"):
 * - The codes below are the ONLY values the frontend understands. A backend
 *   code outside this list is NEVER guessed or mapped onto a "similar" one â€”
 *   it falls back to UNKNOWN_ERROR so the UI cannot act on a misleading code.
 * - UNKNOWN_ERROR is the explicit "cannot safely classify this error" bucket
 *   (unrecognized backend code, unparseable body, non-HTTP failure).
 * - MARKETPLACE_LIMIT_REACHED is part of the frontend contract (the workshop
 *   UI surfaces it verbatim when the 2-listing cap is hit).
 */

export type ApiErrorCode =
  | 'VALIDATION_ERROR'
  | 'EMAIL_TAKEN'
  | 'INVALID_CREDENTIALS'
  | 'INVALID_CURRENT_PASSWORD'
  | 'WEAK_PASSWORD'
  /** Seller already features MARKETPLACE_LISTING_LIMIT active products. */
  | 'MARKETPLACE_LIMIT_REACHED'
  /** Seller already holds WORKSHOP_PRODUCT_LIMIT products (active + drafts). */
  | 'WORKSHOP_LIMIT_REACHED'
  | 'RATE_LIMITED'
  | 'UNAUTHORIZED'
  | 'FORBIDDEN'
  | 'NOT_FOUND'
  | 'CONFLICT'
  | 'SERVER_ERROR'
  | 'NETWORK_ERROR'
  | 'TIMEOUT'
  /** The backend error could not be safely classified. */
  | 'UNKNOWN_ERROR';

export class ApiError extends Error {
  /** HTTP status code when the backend produced the error (0 for network issues). */
  status: number;
  /** Stable machine-readable code, e.g. "EMAIL_TAKEN". */
  code: ApiErrorCode;
  /** Backend code as received, retained for logging even when unrecognized. */
  backendCode?: string;
  /** Per-field validation messages keyed by field name (when applicable). */
  fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>;

  constructor(options: {
    message: string;
    status?: number;
    code?: ApiErrorCode;
    backendCode?: string;
    fieldErrors?: Record<string, string>;
  }) {
    super(options.message);
    this.name = 'ApiError';
    this.status = options.status ?? 0;
    this.code = options.code ?? 'UNKNOWN_ERROR';
    this.backendCode = options.backendCode;
    this.fieldErrors = options.fieldErrors;
  }
}

/** Build an ApiError from an unknown throwable (network failure, JSON parse, ...). */
export function toApiError(error: unknown): ApiError {
  if (error instanceof ApiError) return error;
  if (error instanceof Error) {
    return new ApiError({ message: error.message, code: 'UNKNOWN_ERROR' });
  }
  return new ApiError({ message: 'Something went wrong. Please try again.', code: 'UNKNOWN_ERROR' });
}

/** True when the error indicates the session is invalid/expired. */
export function isAuthError(error: unknown): boolean {
  return error instanceof ApiError && error.code === 'UNAUTHORIZED';
}

===== C:\Users\Admin\Universe-frontend\Universe-frontend\universe-react\src\api\session.ts =====

/**
 * Client-side session/token store.
 *
 * This is the ONLY place the UI-adjacent code (mainly the hooks) persists the
 * session. It belongs to the API layer so that neither React components nor
 * localStorage are coupled together directly:
 *
 *   React component -> hook -> auth service -> sessionStore
 *
 * Security notes:
 * - "Remember me" decides where tokens live. Remembered sessions persist in
 *   localStorage; non-remembered sessions live in sessionStorage so they die
 *   with the tab â€” a real-world session-scoping measure.
 * - Tokens are opaque random values; the mock backend only ever stores their
 *   SHA-256 hashes server-side.
 */

const ACCESS_TOKEN_KEY = 'universe.access_token';
const REFRESH_TOKEN_KEY = 'universe.refresh_token';

export type TokenPersistMode = 'local' | 'session';

export interface StoredTokens {
  accessToken: string;
  refreshToken: string;
}

function readFirst(storage: Storage, key: string): string | null {
  try {
    return storage.getItem(key);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function writeToken(storage: Storage, key: string, value: string): void {
  try {
    storage.setItem(key, value);
  } catch {
    /* storage full/blocked â€” token simply won't persist */
  }
}

function removeToken(storage: Storage, key: string): void {
  try {
    storage.removeItem(key);
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }
}

export const sessionStore = {
  getAccessToken(): string | null {
    return readFirst(window.localStorage, ACCESS_TOKEN_KEY) ?? readFirst(window.sessionStorage, ACCESS_TOKEN_KEY);
  },

  getRefreshToken(): string | null {
    return readFirst(window.localStorage, REFRESH_TOKEN_KEY) ?? readFirst(window.sessionStorage, REFRESH_TOKEN_KEY);
  },

  hasTokens(): boolean {
    return Boolean(this.getAccessToken());
  },

  /**
   * Store a token pair. `persist: 'local'` keeps the session across browser
   * restarts (remember me), `'session'` scopes it to the current tab. Any
   * stale copy in the other storage is removed so exactly one authoritative
   * copy exists.
   */
  setTokens(tokens: StoredTokens, persist: TokenPersistMode = 'local'): void {
    const keep = persist === 'local' ? window.localStorage : window.sessionStorage;
    const drop = persist === 'local' ? window.sessionStorage : window.localStorage;
    writeToken(keep, ACCESS_TOKEN_KEY, tokens.accessToken);
    writeToken(keep, REFRESH_TOKEN_KEY, tokens.refreshToken);
    removeToken(drop, ACCESS_TOKEN_KEY);
    removeToken(drop, REFRESH_TOKEN_KEY);
  },

  /** Where the current access token lives ('local' when not signed in). */
  currentPersistMode(): TokenPersistMode {
    if (readFirst(window.localStorage, ACCESS_TOKEN_KEY)) return 'local';
    if (readFirst(window.sessionStorage, ACCESS_TOKEN_KEY)) return 'session';
    return 'local';
  },

  clear(): void {
    removeToken(window.localStorage, ACCESS_TOKEN_KEY);
    removeToken(window.localStorage, REFRESH_TOKEN_KEY);
    removeToken(window.sessionStorage, ACCESS_TOKEN_KEY);
    removeToken(window.sessionStorage, REFRESH_TOKEN_KEY);
  },
};

/**
 * Shared API contract types.
 *
 * These types are the single source of truth for the shape of every request
 * and response. BOTH the mock API and the real HTTP client are bound to these
 * same types, which is what makes swapping the backend a zero-code-change
 * operation. Also re-exported from src/types for convenience.
 */

/* ------------------------------ Accounts ------------------------------ */

export type AccountType = 'buyer' | 'seller';
export type UserStatus = 'active' | 'suspended';

export interface User {
  id: string;
  email: string;
  fullName: string;
  accountType: AccountType;
  /** How the account authenticates. Absent on rows created before Google auth existed (treated as "password"). */
  authProvider?: 'password' | 'google';
  avatarUrl?: string | null;
  /** Contact number set through PATCH /users/me (optional â€” not every backend returns it). */
  phone?: string | null;
  status: UserStatus;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}

/** Data the client may send when updating the logged-in user. */
export interface UpdateUserRequest {
  fullName?: string;
  phone?: string;
  avatarUrl?: string | null;
}

/** Password change â€” always requires confirming the current password. */
export interface ChangePasswordRequest {
  currentPassword: string;
  newPassword: string;
}

/** Email change â€” password-confirmed so a stolen tab can't hijack the account. */
export interface UpdateEmailRequest {
  currentPassword: string;
  newEmail: string;
}

/** Permanent account deletion â€” requires the current password. */
export interface DeleteAccountRequest {
  currentPassword: string;
}

/* -------------------------- Password Reset -------------------------- */

/** Step 1: Request a password reset â€” generates and "emails" an OTP. */
export interface PasswordResetRequest {
  email: string;
}

/** Step 2: Verify the OTP sent to the user's email. */
export interface VerifyResetCodeRequest {
  email: string;
  code: string;
}

/** Step 3: Complete the password reset with the verified code. */
export interface ResetPasswordRequest {
  email: string;
  code: string;
  newPassword: string;
}

/** Response to password reset request â€” includes OTP in mock mode only. */
export interface PasswordResetResponse {
  message: string;
  /** Development-only field: OTP for testing (NEVER in production). */
  devOtp?: string;
}

/** Response to OTP verification. */
export interface VerifyResetCodeResponse {
  message: string;
  verified: boolean;
}

export interface LoginRequest {
  email: string;
  password: string;
  /** Hint for the backend/auth provider; the frontend always keeps the session in localStorage. */
  rememberMe?: boolean;
}

export interface RegisterRequest {
  fullName: string;
  email: string;
  password: string;
  accountType: AccountType;
}

/**
 * Standard claims carried by a Google ID token â€” the signed JWT that Google
 * Identity Services hands back after the user picks an account in Google's
 * own chooser. The REAL backend verifies the signature against Google's
 * public keys (JWKS) and then reads these claims; the mock backend decodes
 * and validates the claims without signature verification (see
 * api/mock/googleIdToken.ts).
 */
export interface GoogleIdTokenPayload {
  /** Token issuer â€” always accounts.google.com (with or without https://). */
  iss?: string;
  /** Intended audience(s) â€” must contain this app's OAuth client ID. */
  aud?: string | string[];
  /** Google's stable account id. */
  sub?: string;
  email?: string;
  /** Google only issues tokens whose email is verified. */
  email_verified?: boolean;
  name?: string;
  given_name?: string;
  family_name?: string;
  picture?: string;
  /** Expiry time (seconds since epoch). */
  exp?: number;
  /** Issued-at time (seconds since epoch). */
  iat?: number;
}

/** Body of POST /auth/google. */
export interface GoogleLoginRequest {
  /** Google ID token (JWT) obtained from Google Identity Services. */
  credential: string;
  rememberMe?: boolean;
  /**
   * Only consulted when the Google email has never signed up before (it is
    * ignored for existing accounts).
   */
  accountType?: AccountType;
}

export interface TokenPair {
  accessToken: string;
  refreshToken: string;
  /** Optional â€” real backends may add an expiresIn (seconds) field. */
  expiresIn?: number;
}

export interface AuthResponse {
  user: User;
  tokens: TokenPair;
  /**
   * True when this request CREATED the account (e.g. first Google sign-in for
   * an email the backend has never seen). Lets the UI run signup-style
   * redirects (onboarding) without a second endpoint.
   */
  isNewUser?: boolean;
}

export interface RefreshTokenRequest {
  refreshToken: string;
}

export type RefreshTokenResponse = TokenPair;

  phone?: string;
  level?: string;
  department?: string;
  course?: string;
  school?: string;
  bio?: string;

  logoUrl?: string | null;

  bannerImages?: string[] | null;

  storeTemplate?: string | null;

  supportEmail?: string | null;

  storeName?: string;

  level?: string;

  course?: string;

/**

 *

  name: string;

  course?: string | null;
  school?: string | null;
  bio?: string | null;
  logoUrl?: string | null;
}

/* ------------------------------ Products ------------------------------- */

export type ProductStatus = 'active' | 'draft';

/**
 * How many active products ONE seller may feature in the shared public
 * marketplace catalog at the same time. Enforced by the mock products API on
 * every create/update; the workshop UI reads the same number to show the
 * seller how many listing slots they have left.
 */
export const MARKETPLACE_LISTING_LIMIT = 2;

/**
 * How many products (active + drafts combined) ONE seller may keep in their
 * workshop at the same time. Enforced by the products API (mock + real
 * backend contract) on create; the workshop UI reads the same number to
 * disable "Add Product" when the cap is reached.
 */
export const WORKSHOP_PRODUCT_LIMIT = 20;

/**
 * The ONE delivery hub every product is listed with (platform constant).
 *
 * The Add Product page no longer asks the seller for a location: a new product
 * is always delivered from this hub, and the public marketplace shows it on the
 * product card and on the product page. It is not fabricated seller data â€” a
 * product whose backend row carries no `deliveryLocation` falls back to this
 * documented default (see `resolveDeliveryLocation`).
 */
export const DEFAULT_DELIVERY_LOCATION = 'Motion Ground At DHL Building';

/**
 * The delivery location a buyer sees: the product's own stored value when the
 * backend has one, otherwise the platform default hub.
 */
export function resolveDeliveryLocation(deliveryLocation?: string | null): string {
  return (deliveryLocation ?? '').trim() || DEFAULT_DELIVERY_LOCATION;
}

/**
 * A product option group ("variant") â€” e.g. `{ name: 'Size', values: ['Small', 'Medium'] }`.
 *
 * Sellers add these on the Add/Edit Product pages; buyers pick one value per
 * group on the product pages of the public marketplace and the storefront.
 */
export interface ProductVariant {
  /** Option name shown to buyers, e.g. "Size", "Colour" or "Edition". */
  name: string;
  /** Selectable values for the option, e.g. ["Small", "Medium", "Large"]. */
  values: string[];
}

export interface CreateProductRequest {
  name: string;
  /** Nullable per the API contract â€” a backend may clear the description. */
  description?: string | null;
  price: number;
  salePrice?: number | null;
  stock?: number | null;
  sku?: string;
  category?: string;
  status?: ProductStatus;
  /**
   * Primary/cover image â€” the first entry of `images`, kept denormalized so
   * list views (marketplace cards, storefront) never need to read the array.
   */
  imageUrl?: string | null;
  imageAlt?: string | null;
  /**
   * Up to 5 gallery images (http(s) URLs or uploaded data URLs). The first
   * entry is the cover image.
   */
  images?: string[] | null;
  /**
   * Variant option groups (e.g. Size / Colour) with their selectable values.
   * Null or empty means the product has no variants.
   */
  variants?: ProductVariant[] | null;
  /**
   * Physical condition the seller attests on the Add Product page â€”
   * "new" (Brand New) or "used" (Fairly Used). Null when the backend has no
   * data (legacy rows); the UI then shows "Condition unavailable".
   */
  condition?: 'new' | 'used' | null;
  /**
   * Where the product is handed over to the buyer. The Add Product page always
   * sends DEFAULT_DELIVERY_LOCATION (the seller does not type a location);
   * the public marketplace renders it on the card and the product page.
   */
  deliveryLocation?: string | null;
  /**
   * When true the product is listed in the shared public marketplace catalog.
   * Each seller may feature at most 2 active products â€” enforced by the API
   * on both create and update. Buyers can still open every active product via
   * the seller's shop page ("View all products from this seller").
   */
  featuredInMarketplace?: boolean | null;
}

export type UpdateProductRequest = Partial<CreateProductRequest>;

/* -------------------------------- Orders ------------------------------- */

export type OrderStatus = 'processing' | 'shipped' | 'delivered' | 'cancelled';

/**
 * One line item inside an order, as reported by the backend. `unitPrice` is
 * the price actually charged per unit (sale price when on sale) and
 * `lineTotal` is `quantity * unitPrice` â€” both BACKEND-computed. `sellerId`

export interface OrderItem {

  productName: string;
  quantity: number;

}

export interface Order {
  id: string;

  buyerName: string;

  amount: number | null;
  status: OrderStatus;
  createdAt: string;
  /**
   * Line items, when the backend includes them (required on /seller/orders,
   * optional elsewhere). Seller analytics are computed from these â€” the UI
   * never invents figures when they are missing.
   */
  items?: OrderItem[];
}

export interface OrderQueryParams {
  page?: number;
  pageSize?: number;
  /**
   * Optional ISO 8601 window bounding `createdAt` â€” server-side period
   * filtering so Sales Analytics never downloads an entire order history.
   */
  since?: string;
  until?: string;
}

/* -------------------------------- Orders -------------------------------- */

/**
 * One purchased line item as the frontend submits it. `unitPrice` is the
 * price the buyer saw (sale price when on sale) â€” the BACKEND must recompute
 * the authoritative total against its own catalog prices; the frontend value
 * is informational only.
 */
export interface OrderItemRequest {
  productId: string;
  quantity: number;
  /** Selected variant values, e.g. { Size: "M" } (informational). */
  variantSelection?: Record<string, string>;
  unitPrice?: number | null;
}

/** Where/how the order should be delivered (submitted with the order). */
export interface DeliveryAddress {
  fullName: string;
  phone: string;
  /** Street / hall / hostel line. */
  addressLine1: string;
  addressLine2?: string | null;
  city: string;
  state?: string | null;
  /** Campus pickup hub chosen instead of home delivery, when used. */
  pickupLocation?: string | null;
  notes?: string | null;
}

/**
 * Body of POST /orders. Payment happens BEFORE order creation (see
 * docs/API_CONTRACT.md): the buyer completes the Paystack transaction, the
 * frontend verifies it, and only then submits the order referencing the
 * payment. The backend must reject orders whose paymentReference is unknown,
 * unpaid, or already used.
 */
export interface CreateOrderRequest {
  items: OrderItemRequest[];
  deliveryAddress: DeliveryAddress;
  /** Paystack transaction reference verified via GET /payments/verify/:reference. */
  paymentReference?: string | null;
  /** Free-form note the buyer attached to the order. */
  note?: string | null;
}

/* ------------------------------- Payments ------------------------------- */

/** Body of POST /payments/initialize (Paystack, via the backend). */
export interface PaymentInitializationRequest {
  /** Amount in the currency's major unit (e.g. naira), NOT kobo/cents. */
  amount: number;
  email: string;
  currency?: string;
  /**
   * Cart digest the backend may embed in the Paystack metadata; opaque to the
   * frontend beyond echo-back.
   */
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

/** Response of POST /payments/initialize. */
export interface PaymentInitializationResponse {
  /** Paystack checkout URL the frontend redirects the buyer to. */
  authorizationUrl: string;
  /** Backend-generated transaction reference (echoed by verification). */
  reference: string;
  /** True when Paystack accepted the initialization. */
  status: 'success' | 'failed';
}

/** Normalized result of GET /payments/verify/:reference. */
export interface PaymentVerificationResponse {
  reference: string;
  /** Authoritative payment state as reported by the backend. */
  status: 'success' | 'failed' | 'pending';
  amount?: number | null;
  currency?: string | null;
  /** Backend transaction/channel id, when exposed. */
  transactionId?: string | null;
  paidAt?: string | null;
  /** Order the backend linked to this payment, when already created. */
  orderId?: string | null;
}

/* -------------------------------- Uploads ------------------------------- */

/** Response of POST /uploads/images. */
export interface UploadedFile {
  /** URL the backend stored the file under (use this in product/profile fields). */
  url: string;
  /** Backend filename / id, when exposed. */
  name?: string | null;
  /** File size in bytes, when exposed. */
  size?: number | null;
}

import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

const AuthBackground = () => {
  const containerRef = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Create decorative elements dynamically
    const container = containerRef.current;
    if (!container) return;

    // Create large faded circular shapes
    const circles = [
      { size: 600, top: -200, left: -200, opacity: 0.03 },
      { size: 400, bottom: -150, right: -150, opacity: 0.02 },
      { size: 300, top: '30%', left: '80%', opacity: 0.025 },
      { size: 250, bottom: '20%', left: '10%', opacity: 0.02 },
    ];

    circles.forEach((circle, i) => {
      const el = document.createElement('div');
      el.className = 'auth-bg-circle';
      el.style.cssText = `
        position: absolute;
        width: ${circle.size}px;
        height: ${circle.size}px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, var(--color-primary) 0%, transparent 70%);
        opacity: ${circle.opacity};

        animation-delay: ${i * 0.5}s;
      `;
      container.appendChild(el);
    });

    // Create small outlined blue circles
    const smallCircles = [
      { top: '15%', left: '5%', size: 60 },

        ${circle.right !== undefined ? `right: ${circle.right};` : ''}
        animation: float-slow ${10 + i * 1.5}s ease-in-out infinite;
        animation-delay: ${i * 0.3}s;
      `;
      container.appendChild(el);
    });

    // Create dotted square patterns
    const dotPatterns = [
      { top: '20%', left: '15%', cols: 4, rows: 4, spacing: 12, dotSize: 3 },
      { bottom: '25%', right: '20%', cols: 3, rows: 3, spacing: 10, dotSize: 2.5 },
      { top: '60%', left: '8%', cols: 5, rows: 2, spacing: 14, dotSize: 2 },
    ];

    dotPatterns.forEach((pattern, i) => {
      const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
      wrapper.className = 'auth-bg-dot-pattern';
      wrapper.style.cssText = `
        position: absolute;
        pointer-events: none;
        z-index: 0;
        ${pattern.top !== undefined ? `top: ${pattern.top};` : ''}
        ${pattern.bottom !== undefined ? `bottom: ${pattern.bottom};` : ''}
        ${pattern.left !== undefined ? `left: ${pattern.left};` : ''}
        ${pattern.right !== undefined ? `right: ${pattern.right};` : ''}
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(${pattern.cols}, ${pattern.spacing}px);
        grid-template-rows: repeat(${pattern.rows}, ${pattern.spacing}px);
        gap: 0;
        animation: float-slow ${12 + i * 2}s ease-in-out infinite;
        animation-delay: ${i * 0.4}s;
      `;

      for (let r = 0; r < pattern.rows; r++) {
        for (let c = 0; c < pattern.cols; c++) {
          const dot = document.createElement('div');
          dot.style.cssText = `
            width: ${pattern.dotSize}px;
            height: ${pattern.dotSize}px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: rgba(37, 99, 235, ${0.15 + Math.random() * 0.1});
            margin: auto;
          `;
          wrapper.appendChild(dot);
        }
      }
      container.appendChild(wrapper);
    });

    // Create soft gradient orbs
    const gradientOrbs = [
      { top: '10%', right: '10%', size: 300, opacity: 0.04 },
      { bottom: '10%', left: '10%', size: 250, opacity: 0.035 },
    ];

    gradientOrbs.forEach((orb, i) => {
      const el = document.createElement('div');
      el.className = 'auth-bg-gradient-orb';
      el.style.cssText = `
        position: absolute;
        width: ${orb.size}px;
        height: ${orb.size}px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: radial-gradient(circle at center, var(--color-primary) 0%, transparent 70%);
        opacity: ${orb.opacity};
        filter: blur(60px);
        pointer-events: none;
        z-index: 0;
        ${orb.top !== undefined ? `top: ${orb.top};` : ''}
        ${orb.bottom !== undefined ? `bottom: ${orb.bottom};` : ''}
        ${orb.left !== undefined ? `left: ${orb.left};` : ''}
        ${orb.right !== undefined ? `right: ${orb.right};` : ''}
        animation: float-slow ${14 + i * 3}s ease-in-out infinite;
        animation-delay: ${i * 0.6}s;
      `;
      container.appendChild(el);
    });

    return () => {
      // Cleanup on unmount
      container.innerHTML = '';
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <div 
      ref={containerRef} 
      className="auth-background"
      style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        inset: 0,
        overflow: 'hidden',

===== C:\Users\Admin\Universe-frontend\Universe-frontend\universe-react\src\components\auth\ForgotPasswordForm.jsx =====

import { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import Button from '../ui/Button';
import ArrowIcon from '../ui/ArrowIcon';
import { useRequestPasswordReset } from '../../hooks/useAuth';
import { ApiError } from '../../api/errors';

const ForgotPasswordForm = ({ onSuccess, onBackToLogin }) => {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});
  const [focusedField, setFocusedField] = useState(null);
  const [serverError, setServerError] = useState(null);
  const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = useState(null);
  
  const emailRef = useRef(null);
  const formRef = useRef(null);

  const requestResetMutation = useRequestPasswordReset();
  const isLoading = requestResetMutation.isPending;

  // Focus management for accessibility
  useEffect(() => {
    emailRef.current?.focus();
  }, []);

  const validateEmail = (email) => {
    return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setServerError(null);
    setSuccessMessage(null);
    
    const newErrors = {};
    if (!email.trim()) {
      newErrors.email = 'Email is required';
    } else if (!validateEmail(email)) {
      newErrors.email = 'Please enter a valid email address';
    }
    
    if (Object.keys(newErrors).length > 0) {
      setErrors(newErrors);
      return;
    }
    
    setErrors({});
    requestResetMutation.mutate(
      { email: email.trim() },
      {
        onSuccess: (data) => {
          setSuccessMessage(data.message);
          // Pass email and devOtp (in dev mode) to the parent
          onSuccess?.(email.trim(), data.devOtp);
        },
        onError: (error) => {
          if (error instanceof ApiError && error.fieldErrors) {
            setErrors(error.fieldErrors);
          } else {
            setServerError(error instanceof ApiError ? error.message : 'Something went wrong. Please try again.');
          }
        },
      },
    );
  };

  const inputStyle = (fieldName) => ({
    width: '100%',
    padding: '16px 16px 16px 52px',
    fontSize: '1rem',
    fontFamily: 'inherit',
    color: 'var(--color-gray-800)',
    backgroundColor: 'var(--color-white)',
    border: '1.5px solid var(--color-gray-200)',
    borderRadius: '16px',
    outline: 'none',
    transition: 'all 0.2s ease',
    boxShadow: focusedField === fieldName ? '0 0 0 4px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.12)' : '0 2px 8px -2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.03)',
  });

  return (
    <form ref={formRef} onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="auth-forgot-password-form" style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '20px' }}>
      {/* Header */}
      <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginBottom: '8px' }}>
        <h2 style={{ fontSize: '1.75rem', fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--color-gray-900)', marginBottom: '8px' }}>
          Forgot Password?
        </h2>
        <p style={{ fontSize: '0.95rem', color: 'var(--color-gray-600)', lineHeight: '1.5' }}>
          No worries! Enter your email and we'll send you a verification code to reset your password.
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Success message */}
      {successMessage && (
        <div style={{ padding: '12px 16px', borderRadius: '12px', background: '#F0FDF4', border: '1px solid #BBF7D0', color: '#15803D', fontSize: '0.875rem', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px' }}>
          <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" style={{ flexShrink: 0 }}>
            <path d="M22 11.08V12a10 10 0 1 1-5.93-9.14"></path>
            <polyline points="22 4 12 14.01 9 11.01"></polyline>
          </svg>
          {successMessage}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Server error */}
      {serverError && (
        <div style={{ padding: '12px 16px', borderRadius: '12px', background: '#FEF2F2', border: '1px solid #FECACA', color: '#DC2626', fontSize: '0.875rem', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px' }}>
          <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" style={{ flexShrink: 0 }}>
            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" /><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="12" /><line x1="12" y1="16" x2="12.01" y2="16" />
          </svg>
          {serverError}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Email Field */}
      <div className="auth-field-wrapper" style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
        <div 
          style={{
            position: 'absolute',
            left: '16px',
            top: '50%',
            transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            width: '20px',
            height: '20px',
            backgroundColor: 'var(--color-primary-light)',
            borderRadius: '6px',
            color: 'var(--color-primary)',
            zIndex: 2,
            pointerEvents: 'none',
            transition: 'all 0.2s ease',
          }}
        >
          <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" style={{ width: '18px', height: '18px' }}>
            <rect x="2" y="4" width="20" height="16" rx="2"></rect>
            <path d="m22 7-8.97 5.7a1.94 1.94 0 0 1-2.06 0L2 7"></path>
          </svg>
        </div>
        <input
          ref={emailRef}
          type="email"
          id="reset-email"
          name="email"
          placeholder="Email Address"
          value={email}
          onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
          onFocus={() => setFocusedField('email')}
          onBlur={() => setFocusedField(null)}
          disabled={isLoading}
          style={{
            ...inputStyle('email'),
            paddingLeft: '52px',
          }}
          autoComplete="email"
          aria-describedby={errors.email ? 'email-error' : undefined}
          aria-invalid={!!errors.email}
        />
        {errors.email && (
          <p id="email-error" style={{ color: '#EF4444', fontSize: '0.8rem', marginTop: '6px', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '4px' }}>
            <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" style={{ flexShrink: 0 }}>
              <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle>
              <line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="12"></line>
              <line x1="12" y1="16" x2="12.01" y2="16"></line>
            </svg>
            {errors.email}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Send Code Button */}
      <Button
        type="submit"
        className="btn-primary auth-submit-btn"
        disabled={isLoading}
        style={{ 
          width: '100%', 
          padding: '16px 24px', 
          fontSize: '1rem',
          marginTop: '4px',
        }}
      >
        {isLoading ? (
          <>
            <svg className="animate-spin" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" style={{ marginRight: '8px', animation: 'spin 1s linear infinite' }}>
              <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="3" strokeOpacity="0.25" strokeLinecap="round" strokeDasharray="60" strokeDashoffset="20"></circle>
            </svg>
            Sending Code...
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            Send Verification Code
            <ArrowIcon className="btn-icon" style={{ marginLeft: '8px' }} />
          </>
        )}
      </Button>

      {/* Back to Login */}
      <div style={{ 
        textAlign: 'center', 
        marginTop: '16px',
        paddingTop: '20px',
        borderTop: '1px solid var(--color-gray-100)',
      }}>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onBackToLogin}
          disabled={isLoading}
          style={{
            display: 'inline-flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: '6px',
            color: 'var(--color-gray-600)',
            fontWeight: 500,
            background: 'none',
            border: 'none',
            cursor: 'pointer',
            fontSize: '0.95rem',
            fontFamily: 'inherit',
            padding: '8px 12px',
            borderRadius: '8px',
            transition: 'all 0.2s ease',
          }}
          onMouseOver={(e) => {
            e.currentTarget.style.backgroundColor = 'var(--color-gray-50)';
            e.currentTarget.style.color = 'var(--color-gray-800)';
          }}
          onMouseOut={(e) => {
            e.currentTarget.style.backgroundColor = 'transparent';
            e.currentTarget.style.color = 'var(--color-gray-600)';
          }}
        >
          <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
            <line x1="19" y1="12" x2="5" y2="12"></line>
            <polyline points="12 19 5 12 12 5"></polyline>
          </svg>
          Back to Login
        </button>
      </div>

      <style>{`
        @keyframes spin {
          to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
        }
        .animate-spin {
          animation: spin 1s linear infinite;
        }
      `}</style>
    </form>
  );
};

export default ForgotPasswordForm;

/**
 * "Continue with Google" button â€” REAL Google Identity Services integration.
 *
 * When VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID is configured, Google's own official button is
 * rendered here (localized label "Continue with Google"). Clicking it opens
 * Google's account chooser and the signed ID token (JWT) is forwarded to
 * `onCredential` â€” the parent runs the SAME auth flow as email/password
 * login (useGoogleLogin -> POST /auth/google).
 *
 * Without a client id, the styled fallback button reports the setup steps
 * through `onError` instead of faking a sign-in.
 *
 * Loading: while `loading` is true the button is dimmed and ignores clicks;
 * if authentication fails the parent clears `loading` and the button is
 * restored.
 */
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { GOOGLE_SETUP_MESSAGE, isGoogleConfigured, renderGoogleButton } from '../../lib/googleIdentity';

const GoogleIcon = ({ size = 20 }) => (
  <svg width={size} height={size} viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} aria-hidden="true">

    <path d="M12 5.38c1.62 0 3.06.56 4.21 1.64l3.15-3.15C17.45 2.09 14.97 1 12 1 7.7 1 3.99 3.47 2.18 7.07l3.66 2.84c.87-2.6 3.3-4.53 6.16-4.53z"/>
  </svg>

const GoogleSignInButton = ({ onCredential, onError, loading = false, disabled = false }) => {
  const containerRef = useRef(null);
  // Latest-callback refs: the GIS button renders ONCE per mount, so the
  // handlers it triggers must always run the parent's current closures.
  const onCredentialRef = useRef(onCredential);
  const onErrorRef = useRef(onError);
  onCredentialRef.current = onCredential;
  onErrorRef.current = onError;

  const isDisabled = loading || disabled;
  const configured = isGoogleConfigured();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!configured) return undefined;
    const container = containerRef.current;
    if (!container) return undefined;
    let cancelled = false;
    renderGoogleButton(
      container,
      (credential) => {
        if (!cancelled) onCredentialRef.current(credential);
      },
      (message) => {
        if (!cancelled) onErrorRef.current?.(message);
      },
    ).catch((error) => {
      if (!cancelled) onErrorRef.current?.(error?.message || 'Could not load Google sign-in. Please try again.');
    });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [configured]);

  if (!configured) {
    // No OAuth client id configured â€” surface the setup steps instead of
    // faking a Google account.
    return (
      <>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="auth-social-btn"
          disabled={isDisabled}
          aria-busy={loading}
          title={GOOGLE_SETUP_MESSAGE}
          onClick={() => onErrorRef.current?.(GOOGLE_SETUP_MESSAGE)}
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            gap: '10px',
            width: '100%',
            padding: '14px 20px',
            border: '1.5px solid var(--color-gray-200)',
            borderRadius: '14px',
            background: 'var(--color-white)',
            cursor: isDisabled ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
            transition: 'all 0.2s ease',
            fontWeight: 500,
            fontSize: '0.95rem',
            fontFamily: 'inherit',
            color: 'var(--color-gray-700)',
            opacity: isDisabled ? 0.6 : 1,
          }}
          onMouseOver={(e) => {
            if (isDisabled) return;
            e.currentTarget.style.borderColor = 'var(--color-primary)';
            e.currentTarget.style.backgroundColor = 'var(--color-primary-light)';
            e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'translateY(-2px)';
            e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow = '0 8px 24px -4px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.15)';
          }}
          onMouseOut={(e) => {
            if (isDisabled) return;
            e.currentTarget.style.borderColor = 'var(--color-gray-200)';
            e.currentTarget.style.backgroundColor = 'var(--color-white)';
            e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
            e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow = 'none';
          }}
        >
          {loading ? (
            <>
              <span
                style={{
                  width: '18px',
                  height: '18px',
                  border: '2px solid rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.25)',
                  borderTopColor: 'var(--color-primary)',
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  display: 'inline-block',
                  animation: 'googleBtnSpin 0.8s linear infinite',
                  flexShrink: 0,
                }}
              />
              Signing in...
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <GoogleIcon />
              Continue with Google
            </>
          )}
        </button>
        <p
          style={{
            margin: 0,
            fontSize: '0.72rem',
            color: 'var(--color-gray-400)',
            textAlign: 'center',
          }}
        >
          Google sign-in is disabled â€” add <code>VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID</code> to your <code>.env</code> to
          enable the real Google button.
        </p>
        <style>{`
          @keyframes googleBtnSpin {
            to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
          }
        `}</style>
      </>
    );
  }

  // Real Google button â€” Google renders and styles it; we just dim/block it
  // while an auth round-trip is in flight.
  return (
    <div
      ref={containerRef}
      aria-busy={loading}
      style={{
        width: '100%',
        display: 'flex',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        minHeight: '48px',
        opacity: isDisabled ? 0.6 : 1,
        pointerEvents: isDisabled ? 'none' : 'auto',
        transition: 'opacity 0.2s ease',
      }}
    />
  );
};

export default GoogleSignInButton;

const LoginForm = ({ onSwitchToAccountSelection }) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [rememberMe, setRememberMe] = useState(false);
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});
  const [focusedField, setFocusedField] = useState(null);
  const [serverError, setServerError] = useState(null);
  
  const emailRef = useRef(null);
  const passwordRef = useRef(null);
  const formRef = useRef(null);

  const loginMutation = useLogin();
  const googleLogin = useGoogleLogin();
  const isLoading = loginMutation.isPending;
  // Busy while EITHER auth flow runs â€” the Google flow writes the same
  // session, so both must block each other to prevent double sign-in races.
  const isBusy = isLoading || googleLogin.isPending;

  // Focus management for accessibility
  useEffect(() => {
    emailRef.current?.focus();
  }, []);

  const validateEmail = (email) => {
    return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setServerError(null);
    
    const newErrors = {};
    if (!email.trim()) {
      newErrors.email = 'Email is required';
    } else if (!validateEmail(email)) {
      newErrors.email = 'Please enter a valid email address';
    }
    
    if (!password) {
      newErrors.password = 'Password is required';
    } else if (password.length < 8) {
      newErrors.password = 'Password must be at least 8 characters';
    }
    
    if (Object.keys(newErrors).length > 0) {
      setErrors(newErrors);
      return;
    }
    
    setErrors({});
    loginMutation.mutate(
      { email: email.trim(), password, rememberMe },
      {
        onError: (error) => {
          if (error instanceof ApiError && error.fieldErrors) {
            setErrors(error.fieldErrors);
          } else {
            setServerError(error instanceof ApiError ? error.message : 'Something went wrong. Please try again.');
          }
        },
      },
    );
  };

  const handleForgotPassword = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    navigate('/auth/forgot-password');
  };

  // REAL Google flow: Google Identity Services hands back a signed ID token
  // (JWT) after the user picks an account in Google's own chooser. It runs
  // the SAME auth path as email/password login â€” useGoogleLogin ->
  // authApi.googleLogin() -> POST /auth/google -> shared session + cache.
  const handleGoogleCredential = (credential) => {
    if (isBusy) return;
    setServerError(null);
    setErrors({});
    googleLogin.mutate(
      { credential, rememberMe },
      {
        onError: (error) => {
          if (error instanceof ApiError && error.fieldErrors && Object.keys(error.fieldErrors).length > 0) {
            setServerError(String(Object.values(error.fieldErrors)[0]));
          } else {
            setServerError(error instanceof ApiError ? error.message : 'Google sign-in failed. Please try again.');
          }
        },
      },
    );
  };

  // GIS setup/moment failures (script blocked, origin not authorized, popup
  // closed, ...) surface through the same server-error banner.

    setServerError(message);
  };

  const inputStyle = (fieldName) => ({
    width: '100%',
    padding: '16px 16px 16px 52px',
    fontSize: '1rem',

    color: 'var(--color-gray-800)',
