import { Icon, MobileFrame, ProductCard, ScreenHeader } from './MobileMarketplaceShell';

function SavedItemsPage({ savedProducts = [], onToggleSaved, cartItems = [] }) {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { data: products } = useProducts({ status: 'active', page: 1, pageSize: 50 });
  const items = savedProducts;
  const savedIds = new Set(savedProducts.map((product) => product.id));
  return <MobileFrame active="saved" cartCount={cartItems.reduce((total, item) => total + item.quantity, 0)}>
    <ScreenHeader title="Saved Items" />
    <main className="mm-scroll mm-saved-scroll">{items.length ? <section className="mm-product-grid">{items.map((product) => <ProductCard key={product.id} product={product} saved={savedIds.has(product.id) || !savedProducts.length} onToggleSaved={onToggleSaved} onOpen={(item) => navigate(`/marketplace/product/${item.id}`)} />)}</section> : <section className="mm-empty-cart"><Icon name="heart" /><h2>No saved items yet</h2><p>Tap the heart on a product to keep it here.</p></section>}</main>
  </MobileFrame>;
}

export default SavedItemsPage;

===== C:\Users\Admin\Universe-frontend\Universe-frontend\universe-react\src\components\marketplace\SellerProfilePage.jsx =====

import { useNavigate, useParams, useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useProducts } from '../../hooks/useProducts';
import { useCurrentUser } from '../../hooks/useAuth';
import { usePublicSellerProfile } from '../../hooks/useUser';
import { resolveDeliveryLocation } from '../../api/types';
import { slugifyStoreName } from '../../lib/storeDomain';
import { Icon, MobileFrame, ProductCard, ScreenHeader, WhatsAppGlyph } from './MobileMarketplaceShell';

/**
 * Public seller profile â€” opened by the "View seller profile" button at the
 * bottom of a product page.
 *
 * ROUTE NAME = THE SELLER NAME: the path segment is the seller's store name
 * slugified with the same helper that derives seller store domains
 * (src/lib/storeDomain -> slugifyStoreName), so "Campus Tech Hub" becomes
 * /marketplace/seller-profile/campustechhub. The seller's user id travels in
 * the query string (?sellerId=...) so a link copied from the address bar
 * resolves directly; when the id is missing (link typed by hand, id stripped)
 * the slug is resolved against the public catalog instead.
 *
 * DATA SOURCES: the seller's own published fields (name, email, phone, level,
 * department, course, school, bio) come from the PUBLIC seller-profile endpoint
 * (GET /users/:id/seller-profile); the listing-derived figures (product count,
 * average rating, review count, categories, first listing date, delivery hub)
 * are computed from the seller's active products. Any field the seller has not
 * published is left out entirely â€” nothing is invented to fill a gap. If a
 * backend has not implemented the endpoint yet the page still renders from the
 * product data alone.
 */
function SellerProfilePage({ savedProducts = [], onToggleSaved, onAddToCart }) {
  const { sellerSlug = '' } = useParams();
  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { data: currentUser } = useCurrentUser();
  const sellerIdFromUrl = searchParams.get('sellerId');

  /**
   * Sentinel: an id the API returns no rows for. Other marketplace views
   * (MyMarketplace, AddProductPage) use the same trick to keep hooks
   * unconditional while a real id is still being resolved.
   */
  const unresolved = { sellerId: '__loading__' };

  // Shared-link fallback: without an id in the URL, look the slug up in the
  // public catalog (each seller's featured listings).
  const { data: catalog = [], isLoading: isResolvingSeller } = useProducts(
    sellerIdFromUrl ? unresolved : { page: 1, pageSize: 50 },
  );
  const sellerId = sellerIdFromUrl
    || catalog.find((item) => item.sellerId && slugifyStoreName(item.seller) === sellerSlug)?.sellerId
    || null;

  // The seller's posted catalog. The API scopes drafts to the owner's own
  // workshop view, so a visitor only ever sees active products.
  const { data: products = [], isLoading: isLoadingProducts } = useProducts(
    sellerId ? { sellerId, page: 1, pageSize: 50 } : unresolved,
  );

  // The seller's own PUBLIC profile fields. Fetched in its own request so a
  // backend without the endpoint still leaves this page working from the
  // product data alone (and an unknown seller id stays a plain 404).
  const { data: profile } = usePublicSellerProfile(sellerId);


  if ((!sellerIdFromUrl && isResolvingSeller) || (sellerId && isLoadingProducts)) {
    return <SellerProfileState title="Opening seller profile" text="Loading this seller's store profile..." />;
  }

  if (!sellerId) {
    return <SellerProfileState title="Seller not found" text="This seller profile may have been removed or the link may be outdated." action="Back to marketplace" onAction={() => navigate('/marketplace')} />;
  }

  /**
   * A seller opening their OWN profile gets the workshop view back (active +
   * drafts). The profile must always show what BUYERS see, so explicit drafts
   * are dropped â€” a missing status is treated as visible, never hidden.
   */
  const listings = products.filter((product) => product.status !== 'draft');
  const seller = listings[0];
  if (!seller) {
    return <SellerProfileState title="No listings yet" text="This seller has no products posted right now. Check back soon." action="Back to marketplace" onAction={() => navigate('/marketplace')} />;
  }

  const sellerName = profile?.name || seller.seller || 'Campus Seller';
  // Contact number: the published profile phone first, then the number the
  // marketplace denormalizes onto each of this seller's product rows.
  const sellerPhone = String(profile?.phone || seller.sellerPhone || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
  const sellerLogo = profile?.logoUrl || seller.sellerLogo || null;
  const savedIds = new Set(savedProducts.map((product) => product.id));
  const isOwner = Boolean(currentUser && sellerId === currentUser.id);

  // Stats derived from the seller's own listings â€” every number comes from
  // backend data, so "â€”" is shown instead of a fabricated figure.
  const rated = listings.filter((product) => product.rating != null);
  const averageRating = rated.length
    ? rated.reduce((total, product) => total + product.rating, 0) / rated.length
    : null;
  const reviewCount = listings.reduce((total, product) => total + (product.reviews ?? 0), 0);
  const categories = [...new Set(listings.map((product) => product.category).filter(Boolean))];
  const firstListed = listings.reduce((oldest, product) => {
    const time = Date.parse(product.createdAt);
    if (Number.isNaN(time)) return oldest;
    return oldest != null && oldest <= time ? oldest : time;
  }, null);

  /**
   * Details list: the seller's PUBLISHED profile fields (name is in the hero)
   * followed by the facts derived from their listings. Rows whose value is
   * missing are dropped, so the page never shows an empty row or an invented
   * placeholder.
   */
  const facts = [
    ['Email', profile?.email],
    ['Phone', profile?.phone],
    ['Level', profile?.level],
    ['Department', profile?.department],
    ['Course', profile?.course],
    ['School', profile?.school],
    ['Categories', categories.length ? categories.join(', ') : null],
    ['First listed', formatMonthYear(firstListed)],
    ['Delivery hub', resolveDeliveryLocation(seller.deliveryLocation)],
  ].filter(([, value]) => Boolean(value));

  const messageSeller = () => {
    if (!sellerPhone) return;
    // Local numbers are dialled with the country code (the same rule the
    // product page's contact strip applies).
    const phone = sellerPhone.startsWith('0') ? `234${sellerPhone.slice(1)}` : sellerPhone;
    const text = `Hello ${sellerName}, I found your store on UNIVERSE and I'd like to ask about your products.`;
    window.open(`https://wa.me/${phone}?text=${encodeURIComponent(text)}`, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
  };

  return <MobileFrame active="home" cartCount={0}>
    <ScreenHeader title={sellerName} />
    <main className="mm-scroll mm-seller-profile">
      <section className="mm-seller-profile-hero">
        <span className="mm-seller-profile-avatar" aria-hidden="true">
          {sellerLogo ? <img src={sellerLogo} alt="" /> : sellerName.trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
        </span>
        <h2>{sellerName}</h2>
        <span className="mm-seller-profile-verified"><Icon name="check" /> Verified seller</span>
        <p>{`${listings.length} product${listings.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} listed on the UNIVERSE marketplace`}</p>
      </section>

      <section className="mm-seller-profile-stats" aria-label="Seller stats">
        <div><strong>{listings.length}</strong><span>Products</span></div>
        <div><strong>{averageRating != null ? averageRating.toFixed(1) : 'â€”'}</strong><span>Avg rating</span></div>
        <div><strong>{reviewCount > 0 ? reviewCount : 'â€”'}</strong><span>Reviews</span></div>
      </section>

      {facts.length > 0 && (
        <section className="mm-seller-profile-facts" aria-label="Seller details">
          {facts.map(([label, value]) => (
            <div key={label}><span>{label}</span><b>{value}</b></div>
          ))}
        </section>
      )}

      {profile?.bio && (
        <section className="mm-seller-profile-bio" aria-label="About this seller">
          <h2>{`About ${sellerName}`}</h2>
          <p>{profile.bio}</p>
        </section>
      )}

      {sellerPhone && (
        <section className="mm-contact-seller" aria-label="Contact seller">
          <button type="button" className="mm-whatsapp" onClick={messageSeller}>
            <WhatsAppGlyph />
            Message seller on WhatsApp
          </button>
          <small>Ask about any of this seller's products</small>
        </section>
      )}

      {isOwner && (
        <section className="mm-owner-row" aria-label="Seller actions">
          <button type="button" className="mm-owner-edit" onClick={() => navigate('/seller/profile')}>
            <Icon name="edit" /> Edit my store profile
          </button>
          <small>Buyers see this profile from every one of your product pages.</small>
        </section>
      )}

      <h2 className="mm-seller-profile-heading">{`Products from ${sellerName}`}</h2>
      <section className="mm-product-grid">
        {listings.map((product) => (
          <ProductCard
            key={product.id}
            product={product}
            saved={savedIds.has(product.id)}
            onToggleSaved={onToggleSaved}
            onAddToCart={onAddToCart}
            onOpen={(item) => navigate(`/marketplace/product/${item.id}`)}
          />
        ))}
      </section>
    </main>
  </MobileFrame>;
}

/** Month + year of the seller's oldest listing, e.g. "Sep 2026" (null when absent). */
function formatMonthYear(timestamp) {
  if (timestamp == null) return null;
  const date = new Date(timestamp);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return null;
  return date.toLocaleDateString('en-NG', { month: 'short', year: 'numeric' });
}

function SellerProfileState({ title, text, action, onAction }) {
  return <div className="mm-state">
    <h1>{title}</h1>
    <p>{text}</p>
    {action && <button type="button" onClick={onAction}>{action}</button>}
  </div>;
}

export default SellerProfilePage;


===== C:\Users\Admin\Universe-frontend\Universe-frontend\universe-react\src\components\marketplace\SellerShopPage.jsx =====

import { useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useProducts } from '../../hooks/useProducts';
import { useCurrentUser } from '../../hooks/useAuth';
import { Icon, MobileFrame, ProductCard, ScreenHeader } from './MobileMarketplaceShell';

/**
 * Seller shop â€” reached from the "View all products from this seller" button
 * on the product page. Shows every product the seller has POSTED (active
 * ones; drafts stay private because the API only exposes active products to
 * non-owner viewers). Each seller features at most 2 products in the shared
 * marketplace catalog, but buyers can browse their full posted catalog here.
 */
function SellerShopPage({ savedProducts = [], onToggleSaved, onAddToCart }) {
  const { sellerId } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { data: currentUser } = useCurrentUser();
  // NOTE: useProducts unwraps the paginated response and resolves to the
  // product array itself (see hooks/useProducts.ts) â€” not `{ items }`.
  const { data: products = [], isLoading } = useProducts(
    sellerId ? { sellerId, page: 1, pageSize: 50 } : undefined,
  );
  const savedIds = new Set(savedProducts.map((product) => product.id));
  const sellerName = products[0]?.seller || 'Campus Seller';
  const sellerLogo = products[0]?.sellerLogo;
  // A seller often lands on their own shop from one of their product pages;
  // offer a direct route back to the editing surface instead of making them
  // dig through the dashboard menu.
  const isOwner = Boolean(currentUser && sellerId && currentUser.id === sellerId);

  return <MobileFrame active="home" cartCount={0}>
    <ScreenHeader title={sellerName} />
    <main className="mm-scroll mm-seller-shop">
      <section className="mm-seller-shop-head">
        <span className="mm-seller-shop-avatar" aria-hidden="true">{sellerLogo ? <img src={sellerLogo} alt="" /> : sellerName.trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase()}</span>
        <div className="mm-seller-shop-id">
          <h2>{sellerName}</h2>
          <p>{isLoading ? 'Loading productsâ€¦' : `${products.length} product${products.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} available`}</p>
        </div>
      </section>
      {isOwner && (
        <section className="mm-owner-row" aria-label="Seller actions">
          <button type="button" className="mm-owner-edit" onClick={() => navigate('/seller/marketplace')}>
            <Icon name="edit" /> Manage my products
          </button>
          <small>You are viewing your own shop â€” all products can be edited there.</small>
        </section>
      )}
      {isLoading ? <p className="mm-loading">Loading products...</p>
        : products.length ? (
          <section className="mm-product-grid">
            {products.map((product) => (
              <ProductCard
                key={product.id}
                product={product}
                saved={savedIds.has(product.id)}
                onToggleSaved={onToggleSaved}
                onAddToCart={onAddToCart}
                onOpen={(item) => navigate(`/marketplace/product/${item.id}`)}
              />
            ))}
          </section>
        ) : (
          <section className="mm-empty-cart">
            <Icon name="search" />
            <h2>No products yet</h2>
            <p>This seller has no products posted right now. Check back soon.</p>
          </section>
        )}
    </main>
  </MobileFrame>;
}

export default SellerShopPage;

===== C:\Users\Admin\Universe-frontend\Universe-frontend\universe-react\src\components\seller-dashboard\ui\AddProductPage.jsx =====

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useCreateProduct, useProducts } from '../../../hooks/useProducts';
import { useCurrentUser } from '../../../hooks/useAuth';
import { DEFAULT_DELIVERY_LOCATION, MARKETPLACE_LISTING_LIMIT, WORKSHOP_PRODUCT_LIMIT } from '../../../api/types';
import { uploadsApi } from '../../../api/services/uploads';
import { MAX_SOURCE_IMAGE_BYTES, fileToProductImageFile } from '../../../lib/image';
import '../seller-dashboard.css';
import './add-product.css';
import './widgets.css';
import MaterialIcon from '../../../components/ui/MaterialIcon';

/**
 * Represents an image in the form: either a preview (local File not yet
 * processed) or a final uploaded URL string.
 */
const IMAGE_TYPE = {
  PREVIEW: 'preview', // Local File, shown via URL.createObjectURL
  UPLOADED: 'uploaded', // Already uploaded, stored as URL string
};

const CATEGORIES = [
  'Fashion',
  'Electronics',
  'Gadgets',
  'Books',
  'Others',
];

const MAX_IMAGES = 5;

/** Caps mirrored by the API validator (see products.mock.ts). */
const MAX_VARIANTS = 10;
const MAX_VARIANT_VALUES = 20;

/** A blank variant option group ("Size" â†’ "Small"), used for a fresh row. */
function createVariant() {
  return { name: '', values: [''] };
}

/**
 * Add New Product â€” port of add_new_product_blue.html
 * Rendered as a centered modal card on a tinted backdrop.
 * Fully wired to the API: name/SKU/description, category, publish-or-draft
 * status, up to 5 images, and variant option groups (e.g. Size â†’ Small /
 * Medium) that buyers pick from on the product pages of the public
 * marketplace and the seller's storefront.
 *
 * DELIVERY LOCATION â€” a locked platform constant, never a seller input: every
 * product is delivered from DEFAULT_DELIVERY_LOCATION ("Motion Ground At DHL
 * Building") and the public marketplace shows that hub on the product card and
 * the product page. The old free-text "Location" field was removed.
 *
 * IMAGE PIPELINE â€” deferred to submit:
 *  1. Selecting an image creates a local preview only (URL.createObjectURL).
 *     No compression or upload happens yet.
 *  2. Seller fills in the rest of the form fields.
 *  3. Clicking "SET UP" triggers compression and upload behind a full-screen
 *     "Setting up product..." loading state that blocks interaction.
 *  4. Each image File is compressed client-side to a single ~70KB WebP file
 *     (discarding the original). This one file is used for BOTH product card
 *     and detail view â€” no separate card/detail or HD/zoom variants.
 *  5. Compressed files are uploaded via POST /uploads/images.
 *  6. On success: loading dismisses, success shown, form resets/redirects.
 *  7. On failure: loading dismisses, error shown, form data intact for retry.
 *
 * The first image is the cover (primary) image shown in marketplace cards.
 */
function AddProductPage() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const createProduct = useCreateProduct();
  const { data: user } = useCurrentUser();
  // ALL products this seller owns (active + drafts) â€” needed for BOTH caps:
  // the 20-product workshop cap and the 2-slot featured-listing cap.
  // While the user is still loading we pass a non-existent seller id rather
  // than `undefined`: an unfiltered query IS the public catalog, which would
  // count OTHER sellers' products and wrongly lock the form.
  const { data: myProducts = [] } = useProducts(
    user ? { sellerId: user.id, page: 1, pageSize: 50 } : { sellerId: '__loading__' },
  );
    const featuredActiveCount = myProducts.filter(
    (p) => p.featuredInMarketplace === true,
  ).length;
  const canAddListing = featuredActiveCount < MARKETPLACE_LISTING_LIMIT;
  // Workshop product cap â€” a seller may hold at most WORKSHOP_PRODUCT_LIMIT
  // products (active + drafts combined). The API enforces the same number.
  const workshopCount = myProducts.length;
  const canAddProduct = workshopCount < WORKSHOP_PRODUCT_LIMIT;

    // A newly loaded quota can invalidate the default-on listing choice.
    // Unlist this new product immediately so the form cannot submit a listing
    // after the seller has filled every marketplace slot.
    useEffect(() => {
      if (!canAddListing) {
        setForm((current) => (
          current.featuredInMarketplace
            ? { ...current, featuredInMarketplace: false }
            : current
        ));
      }
    }, [canAddListing]);

  const [serverError, setServerError] = useState(null);
  const [imageError, setImageError] = useState(null);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  // Slot the NEXT file selection targets: `null` appends into the free slots,
  // a number replaces that image. Captured when the hidden input is opened.
  const [replaceIndex, setReplaceIndex] = useState(null);

  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    name: '',
    sku: '',
    description: '',
    price: '',
    discount: '',
    length: '',
    stock: '',
    category: '',
    status: 'active',
    featuredInMarketplace: true,
    soldOut: false,
    brand: 'Brand New',
    // Array of image entries: { type: 'preview', file: File } or { type: 'uploaded', url: string }
    images: [],
    variants: [createVariant()],
  });

  const goBack = () => navigate('/seller/marketplace');
  const imageSlots = Array.from({ length: MAX_IMAGES }, (_, index) => form.images[index] ?? null);

  // Clean up object URLs when component unmounts or images change
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      // Revoke all object URLs on unmount
      form.images.forEach((imageEntry) => {
        if (imageEntry?.type === IMAGE_TYPE.PREVIEW && imageEntry.file) {
          const objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(imageEntry.file);
          URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl);
        }
      });
    };
  }, [form.images]);

  const handleChange = (e) => {
    setForm((f) => ({ ...f, [e.target.id]: e.target.value }));
  };

  const toggleField = (field) => {
    setForm((f) => ({ ...f, [field]: !f[field] }));
  };

  const selectBrand = (brand) => {
    setForm((f) => ({ ...f, brand }));
  };

  /* ------------------------------- Variants ------------------------------- */

  const updateVariantName = (variantIndex, name) => {
    setForm((f) => ({
      ...f,
      variants: f.variants.map((variant, index) => (index === variantIndex ? { ...variant, name } : variant)),
    }));
  };

  const updateVariantValue = (variantIndex, valueIndex, value) => {
    setForm((f) => ({
      ...f,
      variants: f.variants.map((variant, index) => {
        if (index !== variantIndex) return variant;
        // Defensive: typing into a row that has no value slot yet appends one.
        const values = variant.values.length > valueIndex
          ? variant.values.map((v, i) => (i === valueIndex ? value : v))
          : [...variant.values, value];
        return { ...variant, values };
      }),
    }));
  };

  /** Append another selectable value to an existing variant name. */
  const addVariantValue = (variantIndex) => {
    setForm((f) => ({
      ...f,
      variants: f.variants.map((variant, index) => (
        index === variantIndex && variant.values.length < MAX_VARIANT_VALUES
          ? { ...variant, values: [...variant.values, ''] }
          : variant
      )),
    }));
  };

  const removeVariantValue = (variantIndex, valueIndex) => {
    setForm((f) => ({
      ...f,
      variants: f.variants.map((variant, index) => (
        index === variantIndex
          ? { ...variant, values: variant.values.filter((_, i) => i !== valueIndex) }
          : variant
      )),
    }));
  };

  const addVariant = () => {
    setForm((f) => (f.variants.length >= MAX_VARIANTS ? f : { ...f, variants: [...f.variants, createVariant()] }));
  };

  const removeVariant = (variantIndex) => {
    setForm((f) => (f.variants.length <= 1 ? f : { ...f, variants: f.variants.filter((_, i) => i !== variantIndex) }));
  };

  /**
   * Trimmed variant groups for the API. Blank rows are dropped, so a single
   * untouched "Variant Name / Variant Value" pair simply means "no variants".
   */
  const collectVariants = () => form.variants
    .map((variant) => ({
      name: variant.name.trim(),
      values: variant.values.map((value) => value.trim()).filter(Boolean),
    }))
    .filter((variant) => variant.name && variant.values.length > 0);

  /**
   * A row is only valid when it has BOTH a name and at least one value, so a
   * half-filled row blocks the submit instead of silently losing what was typed.
   */
  const hasHalfFilledVariant = () => form.variants.some((variant) => (
    Boolean(variant.name.trim()) !== variant.values.some((value) => value.trim())
  ));

  /* -------------------------------- Images -------------------------------- */

  /**
   * Helper to get a displayable URL for an image entry.
   * - For preview entries (File): create an object URL
   * - For uploaded entries (string): return the URL directly
   */
  const getImageDisplayUrl = (imageEntry) => {
    if (!imageEntry) return null;
    if (imageEntry.type === IMAGE_TYPE.PREVIEW) {
      return URL.createObjectURL(imageEntry.file);
    }
    return imageEntry.url;
  };

  /** Append image entries (preview Files or already-uploaded URLs). */
  const addImages = (entries) => {
    setImageError(null);
    setForm((f) => {
      if (!entries.length) return f;
      const remaining = MAX_IMAGES - f.images.length;
      return { ...f, images: [...f.images, ...entries.slice(0, remaining)] };
    });
  };

  /**
   * Open the hidden file picker. An EMPTY slot appends (multi-select); a FILLED
   * slot replaces that one image (single file). `multiple` is set imperatively
   * because the picker reads it the moment it opens â€” before React could
   * re-render from the `replaceIndex` state change.
   */
  const openImagePicker = (index) => {
    const input = document.getElementById('ap-image-input');
    if (!input || isSubmitting) return;
    setImageError(null);
    setReplaceIndex(index);
    input.multiple = index === null;
    input.click();
  };

  const handleImageFiles = (e) => {
    const files = Array.from(e.target.files ?? []);
    e.target.value = ''; // allow re-selecting the same file(s)
    const target = replaceIndex;
    setReplaceIndex(null);
    if (!files.length) return;

    const isReplace = target !== null;
    const free = MAX_IMAGES - form.images.length;
    const selected = isReplace ? files.slice(0, 1) : files.slice(0, Math.max(0, free));
    
    if (!selected.length) {
      setImageError(`You can add up to ${MAX_IMAGES} images â€” remove one to make room.`);
      return;
    }
    
    // Validate file sizes
    const oversized = selected.filter((file) => file.size > MAX_SOURCE_IMAGE_BYTES);
    if (oversized.length > 0) {
      setImageError(`Image must be ${Math.round(MAX_SOURCE_IMAGE_BYTES / 1024 / 1024)}MB or smaller.`);
      return;
    }

    // Report the cap instead of silently dropping extra files
    if (files.length > selected.length) {
      setImageError(`Only ${selected.length} of ${files.length} images were added â€” ${MAX_IMAGES} is the maximum.`);
    }

    // Create preview entries
    const previewEntries = selected.map((file) => ({
      type: IMAGE_TYPE.PREVIEW,
      file,
    }));

    if (isReplace) {
      setForm((f) => {
        if (target >= f.images.length) return f;
        const images = [...f.images];
        images[target] = previewEntries[0];
        return { ...f, images };
      });
    } else {
      addImages(previewEntries);
    }
  };

  const removeImage = (index) => {
    if (isSubmitting) return;
    setImageError(null);
    setForm((f) => ({ ...f, images: f.images.filter((_, i) => i !== index) }));
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setServerError(null);

    // Workshop product cap â€” block submission before hitting the API.
    if (!canAddProduct) {
      setServerError(`Your workshop is full â€” you can store up to ${WORKSHOP_PRODUCT_LIMIT} products. Remove one first.`);
      return;
    }

    if (hasHalfFilledVariant()) {
      setServerError('Every variant needs a name and at least one value â€” for example "size" and "small".');
      return;
    }

    // Show full-screen loading state
    setIsSubmitting(true);

    try {
      // Process images: compress previews and upload them
      const processedImageUrls = [];
      
      for (const imageEntry of form.images) {
        if (imageEntry.type === IMAGE_TYPE.UPLOADED) {
          // Already an uploaded URL, use it directly
          processedImageUrls.push(imageEntry.url);
        } else if (imageEntry.type === IMAGE_TYPE.PREVIEW) {
          // Compress the File to ~70KB WebP, then upload
          const compressedFile = await fileToProductImageFile(imageEntry.file);
          const uploaded = await uploadsApi.uploadImage(compressedFile);
          processedImageUrls.push(uploaded.url);
        }
      }

      const resolvedName = (form.name || form.category || 'New Product').trim() || 'New Product';
      const resolvedPrice = Number.parseFloat(form.price || '0');
      const variants = collectVariants();

      await createProduct.mutateAsync({
        name: resolvedName,
        sku: form.sku || undefined,
        description: form.description || undefined,
        price: Number.isFinite(resolvedPrice) ? resolvedPrice : 0,
        salePrice: form.discount ? parseFloat(form.discount) : null,
        stock: form.stock ? parseInt(form.stock, 10) : null,
        category: form.category || undefined,
        // Delivery location is locked to the platform default hub â€” there is no
        // seller input for it on this page, and the public marketplace shows it.
        deliveryLocation: DEFAULT_DELIVERY_LOCATION,
        status: form.status,
        featuredInMarketplace: form.featuredInMarketplace,
        imageUrl: processedImageUrls[0] || null,
        images: processedImageUrls.length ? processedImageUrls : null,
        variants: variants.length ? variants : null,
        // Persist the seller's condition choice so the marketplace badge can
        // show "New" / "Used" instead of a hardcoded state.
        condition: form.brand === 'Fairly Used' ? 'used' : 'new',
      });

      // Success: dismiss loading, navigate back
      setIsSubmitting(false);
      goBack();
    } catch (error) {
      // Failure: dismiss loading, show error, keep form data intact
      setIsSubmitting(false);
      
      if (error?.fieldErrors && Object.keys(error.fieldErrors).length > 0) {
        setServerError(String(Object.values(error.fieldErrors)[0]));
      } else {
        setServerError(error?.message || 'Failed to create product. Please try again.');
      }
    }
  };

  return (
    <main className="ap-page-shell">
      {/* Full-screen loading overlay during submit */}
      {isSubmitting && (
        <div className="ap-loading-overlay">
          <div className="ap-loading-content">
            <MaterialIcon name="cloud_upload" className="ap-loading-icon" />
            <p className="ap-loading-text">Setting up product...</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="ap-card">
        <header className="ap-header">
          <h1 className="ap-title">Add New Product</h1>
          <p className="ap-subtitle">
            Fill in the details below to add a new product
            <br />
            to your store.
          </p>
        </header>

        <form className="ap-form" id="ap-form" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
          {serverError && <div className="ap-error">{serverError}</div>}
          {!canAddProduct && (
            <div className="ap-error" role="alert">
              Your workshop is full ({workshopCount}/{WORKSHOP_PRODUCT_LIMIT} products). Remove a product before adding a new one.
            </div>
          )}

          <section className="ap-section">
            <div className="ap-section-header">
              <h2>Product Images</h2>
              <p>
                Select up to {MAX_IMAGES} images of the product â€” the first image is the cover.
                Use Replace on an image to swap it for another.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="ap-upload-grid">
              {imageSlots.map((imageEntry, index) => {
                const displayUrl = imageEntry ? getImageDisplayUrl(imageEntry) : null;
                return (
                  <div
                    key={`slot-${index}`}
                    className="ap-upload-slot"
                  >
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className={`ap-upload-box ${displayUrl ? 'has-image' : ''}`}
                      aria-label={displayUrl ? `Replace product image ${index + 1}` : `Add product image ${index + 1}`}
                      disabled={isSubmitting}
                      onClick={() => openImagePicker(displayUrl ? index : null)}
                    >
                      {displayUrl ? (
                        <img src={displayUrl} alt={`Product ${index + 1}`} className="ap-upload-preview" />
                      ) : (
                        <MaterialIcon name="add" />
                      )}
                    </button>

                    {displayUrl && index === 0 && <span className="ap-cover-badge">Cover</span>}

                    {/*
                      Transparent overlay so a mistaken pick can be swapped for
                      another image without removing it first.
                    */}
                    {displayUrl && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className="ap-upload-replace"
                        aria-label={`Replace product image ${index + 1}`}
                        disabled={isSubmitting}
                        onClick={() => openImagePicker(index)}
                      >
                        <MaterialIcon name="sync" />
                        Replace
                      </button>
                    )}

                    {displayUrl && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className="ap-upload-remove"
                        aria-label={`Remove image ${index + 1}`}
                        disabled={isSubmitting}
                        onClick={() => removeImage(index)}
                      >
                        <MaterialIcon name="close" />
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            {imageError && (
              <p className="sd-field-error" role="alert" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>{imageError}</p>
            )}

            <input
              id="ap-image-input"
              type="file"
              accept="image/*"
              onChange={handleImageFiles}
              className="ap-hidden-input"
            />
          </section>

          <label className="ap-field ap-field-full ap-product-name-field">
            <span>Product Name</span>
            <div className="ap-input-wrap ap-no-icon">
              <input
                id="name"
                type="text"
                placeholder="Enter product name"
                value={form.name}
                onChange={handleChange}
                required
              />
            </div>
          </label>

          <div className="ap-row ap-row-2">
            <label className="ap-field">
              <span>Price</span>
              <div className="ap-input-wrap">
                <span className="ap-prefix">â‚¦</span>
                <input id="price" type="number" placeholder="Enter price" value={form.price} onChange={handleChange} />
              </div>
            </label>

            <label className="ap-field">
              <span>Discount Price (Optional)</span>
              <div className="ap-input-wrap">
                <span className="ap-prefix">â‚¦</span>
                <input id="discount" type="number" placeholder="Enter discount price" value={form.discount} onChange={handleChange} />
              </div>

                <input
                  id="stock"
                  type="number"
                  min="0"
                  step="1"
                  placeholder="Enter amount in stock"
                  value={form.stock}
                  onChange={handleChange}
                />
              </div>

                  <span className="ap-switch-thumb" />

              <div className="ap-toggle-line">
                <span className="ap-toggle-label">Marketplace</span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  role="switch"
                  aria-checked={form.featuredInMarketplace}
                  className={`ap-switch ${form.featuredInMarketplace ? 'on' : ''}`}
                  aria-label={
                    form.featuredInMarketplace
                      ? 'Remove this product from the public marketplace'
                      : 'List this product on the public marketplace'
                  }
                  disabled={!canAddListing}
                  onClick={() => {
                    if (!canAddListing) return;
                    toggleField('featuredInMarketplace');
                  }}
                >
                  <span className="ap-switch-thumb" />

              {/*

              {!form.featuredInMarketplace && !canAddListing && (
                <p className="ap-listing-cap">
                  <MaterialIcon name="error" />
                  All {MARKETPLACE_LISTING_LIMIT} marketplace slots are in use. Remove a listing in My Workshop first.
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="ap-row ap-row-2 ap-brand-row">

              type="button"
              className={`ap-brand-option ${form.brand === 'Brand New' ? 'selected' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => selectBrand('Brand New')}
            >
              <span className="ap-option-box" aria-hidden="true" />
              <span>Brand New</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              className={`ap-brand-option ${form.brand === 'Fairly Used' ? 'selected' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => selectBrand('Fairly Used')}
            >
              <span className="ap-option-box" aria-hidden="true" />
              <span>Fairly Used</span>

            <textarea
              id="description"

              placeholder="Write a detailed description..."
              value={form.description}
              onChange={handleChange}
            />
          </label>

          <label className="ap-field ap-field-full">
            <span>Length of roll / Use</span>
            <div className="ap-input-wrap ap-no-icon">
              <input
                id="length"

                onChange={handleChange}

          <div className="ap-location-box ap-field-full">

                <div className="ap-variant-head">
                  <span className="ap-variant-index">Variant {variantIndex + 1}</span>
                  {form.variants.length > 1 && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="ap-variant-remove"
                      onClick={() => removeVariant(variantIndex)}
                    >
                      <MaterialIcon name="delete" />
                      Remove variant

                <div className="ap-row ap-row-2 ap-variant-fields">

                      <input

                  <div className="ap-variant-extra-values">

                      const valueIndex = offset + 1;
                      return (

                          <span>Variant Value</span>
                          <div className="ap-input-wrap ap-variant-value-wrap">
                            <input
                              type="text"
                              placeholder="small"
                              value={value}
                              onChange={(e) => updateVariantValue(variantIndex, valueIndex, e.target.value)}
                            />
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              className="ap-variant-value-remove"
                              aria-label={`Remove value ${valueIndex + 1} from variant ${variantIndex + 1}`}
                              onClick={() => removeVariantValue(variantIndex, valueIndex)}
                            >
                              Ã—
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        </label>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                )}

                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="ap-variant-add-value"
                  onClick={() => addVariantValue(variantIndex)}
                  disabled={variant.values.length >= MAX_VARIANT_VALUES}
                >
                  <MaterialIcon name="add" />

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import './widgets.css';

/**
 * Reusable confirmation dialog.
 *
 * Used for destructive actions (delete product, delete account). Supports:
 * - danger styling
 * - a "type to confirm" phrase (e.g. type DELETE)
 * - extra children rendered between the message and actions (e.g. a password
 *   field for account deletion)
 * - busy state while the destructive mutation is in flight
 */
function ConfirmDialog({
  open,
  title,
  message,
  confirmLabel = 'Confirm',
  cancelLabel = 'Cancel',
  danger = true,
  requireText = null,
  busy = false,
  onConfirm,
  onCancel,
  children,
}) {
  const [typed, setTyped] = useState('');

  // Reset the typed confirmation each time the dialog opens.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) setTyped('');
  }, [open]);

  // Escape closes (unless a request is in flight).
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return undefined;
    const onKey = (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && !busy) onCancel?.();
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, [open, busy, onCancel]);

  if (!open) return null;

  const confirmed = !requireText || typed.trim() === requireText;

  return (
    <div
      className="sd-modal-overlay"
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-label={title}
      onMouseDown={(e) => {
        if (e.target === e.currentTarget && !busy) onCancel?.();
      }}
    >
      <div className="sd-modal">
        <h2 className="sd-modal-title">{title}</h2>
        {message && <p className="sd-modal-message">{message}</p>}

        {requireText && (
          <div className="sd-field">
            <label htmlFor="confirm-typed-input">
              Type <strong>{requireText}</strong> to confirm
            </label>
            <input
              id="confirm-typed-input"
              type="text"
              value={typed}
              autoComplete="off"
              spellCheck="false"
              onChange={(e) => setTyped(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={requireText}
            />
          </div>
        )}

        {children}

        <div className="sd-modal-actions">
          <button type="button" className="sd-btn sd-btn-ghost" onClick={onCancel} disabled={busy}>
            {cancelLabel}
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            className={`sd-btn ${danger ? 'sd-btn-danger' : 'sd-btn-primary'}`}
            onClick={onConfirm}
            disabled={busy || !confirmed}
          >
            {busy ? 'Workingâ€¦' : confirmLabel}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default ConfirmDialog;

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useCurrentUser } from '../../../hooks/useAuth';
import { useProduct, useUpdateProduct, useProducts } from '../../../hooks/useProducts';
import { MARKETPLACE_LISTING_LIMIT } from '../../../api/types';
import { uploadsApi } from '../../../api/services/uploads';
import '../seller-dashboard.css';
import './add-product.css';
import './widgets.css';
import MaterialIcon from '../../../components/ui/MaterialIcon';

const CATEGORIES = [
  'Fashion',
  'Electronics',
  'Gadgets',
  'Books',
  'Others',
];

const MAX_IMAGES = 5;

/**
 * Edit Product â€” same layout as Add New Product, prefilled from the product
 * record. Only the OWNER can edit: the API rejects non-owned ids with 404 and
 * the UI additionally checks ownership before submitting.
 */
function EditProductPage() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { productId } = useParams();
  const { data: user } = useCurrentUser();
  const { data: product, isLoading, error } = useProduct(productId);
  const updateProduct = useUpdateProduct();
  // Other active products this seller already has, minus the one being edited,
  // so the UI can pre-empt the 2-listing cap before the API rejects the save.
  const { data: myProducts = [] } = useProducts(
    user ? { sellerId: user.id, status: 'active', page: 1, pageSize: 50 } : undefined,
  );
  const featuredActiveCount = myProducts.filter(
    (p) => p.id !== productId && p.featuredInMarketplace === true,
  ).length;
  const canAddListing = featuredActiveCount < MARKETPLACE_LISTING_LIMIT;

  const [serverError, setServerError] = useState(null);
  const [imageError, setImageError] = useState(null);
  const [imageUploading, setImageUploading] = useState(false);
  const [imageUrl, setImageUrl] = useState('');
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    name: '',
    sku: '',
    description: '',
    price: '',
    salePrice: '',
    stock: '',
    category: '',
    condition: 'new',
    status: 'active',
    featuredInMarketplace: false,
    images: [],
  });
  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false);

  // Prefill the form once the product arrives.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (product && !loaded) {
      setForm({
        name: product.name ?? '',
        sku: product.sku ?? '',
        description: product.description ?? '',
        price: product.price != null ? String(product.price) : '',
        salePrice: product.salePrice != null ? String(product.salePrice) : '',
        stock: product.stock != null ? String(product.stock) : '',
        category: product.category ?? '',
        // Unknown/legacy conditions fall back to the Add Product default.
        condition: product.condition === 'used' ? 'used' : 'new',
        status: product.status ?? 'active',
        featuredInMarketplace: product.featuredInMarketplace === true,
        images:
          product.images?.length > 0
            ? product.images
            : product.imageUrl
              ? [product.imageUrl]
              : [],
      });
      setLoaded(true);
    }
  }, [product, loaded]);

  const goBack = () => navigate('/seller/marketplace');

  const handleChange = (e) => {
    setForm((f) => ({ ...f, [e.target.id]: e.target.value }));
  };

  /** Condition radio ("Brand New" / "Fairly Used") shown on the marketplace badge. */
  const selectCondition = (condition) => {
    setForm((f) => ({ ...f, condition }));
  };

  /** Append raw image sources (data URLs from uploads, or pasted URLs). */
  const addImages = (urls) => {
    setImageError(null);
    setForm((f) => {
      const clean = urls.filter((u) => u && u.trim());
      if (!clean.length) return f;
      const remaining = MAX_IMAGES - f.images.length;
      return { ...f, images: [...f.images, ...clean.slice(0, remaining)] };
    });
  };

  /** First human-readable message from an ApiError-shaped upload rejection. */
  const imageErrorMessage = (error) => (
    (error?.fieldErrors && Object.values(error.fieldErrors)[0])
    || error?.message
    || 'Could not process that image.'
  );

  const handleImageFiles = async (e) => {
    const files = Array.from(e.target.files ?? []);
    e.target.value = ''; // allow re-selecting the same file(s)
    if (!files.length) return;
    setImageError(null);
    const remaining = MAX_IMAGES - form.images.length;
    if (remaining <= 0) {
      setImageError(`You can add up to ${MAX_IMAGES} images â€” remove one to make room.`);
      return;
    }
    const selected = files.slice(0, remaining);
    // Report the cap instead of silently dropping the extra files.
    if (files.length > selected.length) {
      setImageError(`Only ${selected.length} of ${files.length} images were uploaded â€” ${MAX_IMAGES} is the maximum.`);
    }
    setImageUploading(true);
    try {
      // Uploads go through the documented endpoint (POST /uploads/images); the
      // mock adapter compresses locally and resolves with the same URL shape.
      // allSettled: one rejected file must not discard the ones that uploaded.
      const results = await Promise.allSettled(
        selected.map((file) => uploadsApi.uploadImage(file)),
      );
      const urls = results.filter((r) => r.status === 'fulfilled').map((r) => r.value.url);
      if (urls.length) addImages(urls);
      const failed = results.find((r) => r.status === 'rejected');
      if (failed) setImageError(imageErrorMessage(failed.reason));
    } finally {
      setImageUploading(false);
    }
  };

  const removeImage = (index) => {
    if (imageUploading) return;
    setForm((f) => ({ ...f, images: f.images.filter((_, i) => i !== index) }));
  };

  const handleImageUrlAdd = () => {
    if (imageUploading) return;
    const url = imageUrl.trim();
    if (!url) return;
    // Mirrors the API validator (products.mock.ts) so the form fails early.
    if (!/^(https?:\/\/|data:image\/)/i.test(url)) {
      setImageError('Image must be an http(s) URL or an uploaded image.');
      return;
    }
    if (form.images.length >= MAX_IMAGES) {
      setImageError(`You can add up to ${MAX_IMAGES} images â€” remove one to make room.`);
      return;
    }
    addImages([url]);
    setImageUrl('');
  };

  const handleImageUrlKeyDown = (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      handleImageUrlAdd();
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setServerError(null);

    if (user && product && product.sellerId !== user.id) {
      setServerError('You can only edit your own products.');
      return;
    }

    updateProduct.mutate(
      {
        id: productId,
        data: {
          name: form.name,
          sku: form.sku || undefined,
          description: form.description || undefined,
          price: parseFloat(form.price),
          salePrice: form.salePrice ? parseFloat(form.salePrice) : null,
          stock: form.stock ? parseInt(form.stock, 10) : null,
          category: form.category || undefined,
          condition: form.condition,
          status: form.status,
          featuredInMarketplace: form.featuredInMarketplace,
          imageUrl: form.images[0] || null,
          images: form.images.length ? form.images : null,
        },
      },
      {
        onSuccess: goBack,
        onError: (err) => {
          if (err?.fieldErrors && Object.keys(err.fieldErrors).length > 0) {
            setServerError(String(Object.values(err.fieldErrors)[0]));
          } else {
            setServerError(err.message || 'Failed to update product.');
          }
        },
      },
    );
  };

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <main className="ap-page-shell">
        <div className="ap-card">
          <p style={{ padding: 24 }}>Loading productâ€¦</p>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  if (error || !product) {
    return (
      <main className="ap-page-shell">
        <div className="ap-card">
          <p style={{ padding: 24 }}>
            {error?.status === 404
              ? 'Product not found â€” it may have been deleted, or it belongs to another seller.'
              : error?.message || 'Could not load this product.'}
          </p>
          <div className="ap-action-bar">
            <button type="button" className="ap-clear-btn" onClick={goBack}>
              Back to workshop
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  return (
    <main className="ap-page-shell">
      <div className="ap-card">
        {/* Modal Header */}
        <header className="ap-header">
          <div className="ap-header-brand">
            <img src="/logo.png" alt="Global Store" className="ap-brand-logo" />
            <div>
              <h1 className="ap-title">Edit Product</h1>
              <p className="ap-subtitle">Update the details of &ldquo;{product.name}&rdquo;.</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button className="ap-close" aria-label="Close modal" onClick={goBack}>
            <MaterialIcon name="close" />
          </button>
        </header>

        {/* Modal Body (Form) */}
        <div className="ap-body">
          <form className="ap-form" id="ap-form" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
            {serverError && <div className="ap-error">{serverError}</div>}
            {/* Basic Info Section */}
            <section className="ap-section">
              <h2 className="ap-section-title">Basic Information</h2>
              <div className="ap-grid-2">
                <div className="ap-field">
                  <label className="ap-label" htmlFor="productName">
                    Product Name <span className="ap-required">*</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    className="ap-input"
                    id="productName"
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="e.g. Minimalist Ceramic Vase"
                    value={form.name}
                    onChange={handleChange}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="ap-field">
                  <label className="ap-label" htmlFor="sku">
                    SKU (Stock Keeping Unit)
                  </label>
                  <input className="ap-input" id="sku" type="text" placeholder="e.g. ELEC-HP-001" value={form.sku} onChange={handleChange} />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="ap-field">
                <label className="ap-label" htmlFor="category">Category</label>
                <select className="ap-input" id="category" value={form.category} onChange={handleChange}>
                  <option value="">Uncategorized</option>
                  {[...new Set(form.category && !CATEGORIES.includes(form.category) ? [form.category, ...CATEGORIES] : CATEGORIES)].map((c) => (
                    <option key={c} value={c}>{c}</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
              {/* Same condition selector as the Add Product page â€” the choice is
                  what buyers see as the "New" / "Used" badge on the product page. */}
              <div className="ap-row ap-row-2 ap-brand-row">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className={`ap-brand-option ${form.condition === 'new' ? 'selected' : ''}`}
                  onClick={() => selectCondition('new')}
                >
                  <span className="ap-option-box" aria-hidden="true" />
                  <span>Brand New</span>
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className={`ap-brand-option ${form.condition === 'used' ? 'selected' : ''}`}
                  onClick={() => selectCondition('used')}
                >
                  <span className="ap-option-box" aria-hidden="true" />
                  <span>Fairly Used</span>
                </button>
              </div>
              <div className="ap-field">
                <label className="ap-label" htmlFor="description">Description</label>
                <textarea
                  className="ap-input"
                  id="description"
                  rows="4"
                  placeholder="Describe the product features, materials, and care instructions..."
                  value={form.description}
                  onChange={handleChange}
                ></textarea>
              </div>
            </section>

            {/* Pricing & Inventory Section */}
            <section className="ap-section">
              <h2 className="ap-section-title">Pricing &amp; Inventory</h2>
              <div className="ap-grid-3">
                <div className="ap-field">
                  <label className="ap-label" htmlFor="price">
                    Regular Price <span className="ap-required">*</span>
                  </label>
                  <div className="ap-price-wrap">
                    <span className="ap-prefix">â‚¦</span>
                    <input className="ap-input" id="price" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" placeholder="0.00" value={form.price} onChange={handleChange} />
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="ap-field">
                  <label className="ap-label" htmlFor="salePrice">
                    Sale Price
                  </label>
                  <div className="ap-price-wrap">
                    <span className="ap-prefix">â‚¦</span>
                    <input className="ap-input" id="salePrice" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" placeholder="0.00" value={form.salePrice} onChange={handleChange} />
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="ap-field">
                  <label className="ap-label" htmlFor="stock">
                    Stock
                  </label>
                  <input className="ap-input" id="stock" type="number" min="0" step="1" placeholder="0" value={form.stock} onChange={handleChange} />
                </div>
              </div>
            </section>

            {/* Visibility Section */}
            <section className="ap-section">
              <h2 className="ap-section-title">Visibility</h2>
              <div className="ap-grid-2">
                <label className="ap-field" style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, cursor: 'pointer', marginBottom: 0 }}>
                  <input type="radio" name="status" value="active" checked={form.status === 'active'} onChange={handleChange} />
                  <span className="ap-label" style={{ marginBottom: 0 }}>Published (visible in marketplace)</span>
                </label>
                <label className="ap-field" style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, cursor: 'pointer', marginBottom: 0 }}>
                  <input type="radio" name="status" value="draft" checked={form.status === 'draft'} onChange={handleChange} />
                  <span className="ap-label" style={{ marginBottom: 0 }}>Draft (only you can see it)</span>
                </label>
              </div>
              {/* Public marketplace listing toggle (at most 2 per seller). */}
              <div className="ap-toggle-row" style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
                <div className="ap-toggle-block">
                  <div className="ap-toggle-line">
                    <span className="ap-toggle-label">List on marketplace</span>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className={`ap-switch ${form.featuredInMarketplace ? 'on' : ''}`}
                      aria-label={form.featuredInMarketplace ? 'Remove from marketplace' : 'List on marketplace'}
                      disabled={!form.featuredInMarketplace && !canAddListing}
                      title={
                        !form.featuredInMarketplace && !canAddListing
                          ? `You already have ${MARKETPLACE_LISTING_LIMIT} products listed on the marketplace. Remove one first.`
                          : undefined
                      }
                      onClick={() => {
                        if (!form.featuredInMarketplace && !canAddListing) return;
                        setForm((f) => ({ ...f, featuredInMarketplace: !f.featuredInMarketplace }));
                      }}
                    >
                      <span className="ap-switch-thumb" />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <p style={{ fontSize: 11, marginTop: 4 }}>
                    {form.featuredInMarketplace
                      ? form.status === 'draft'
                        ? 'Listed on the marketplace as soon as you publish it.'
                        : 'This product appears in the public marketplace.'
                      : `List on the public marketplace (${featuredActiveCount}/${MARKETPLACE_LISTING_LIMIT} used)`}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </section>

            {/* Media Section */}
            <section className="ap-section">
              <div className="ap-media-head">
                <h2 className="ap-section-title">Product Images</h2>
                <span className="ap-media-hint">
                  Up to {MAX_IMAGES} images Â· first image is the cover
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* Upload Area (multi-file, wired to a real file input, uploaded via the API) */}
              <label className="ap-upload" htmlFor="ap-image-input" style={{ cursor: imageUploading ? 'progress' : 'pointer' }}>
                <div className="ap-upload-icon">
                  <MaterialIcon name="cloud_upload" />
                </div>
                <p className="ap-upload-text">
                  <strong>Click to upload</strong> or drag and drop
                </p>
                <p className="ap-upload-hint">
                  {imageUploading
                    ? 'Uploadingâ€¦'
                    : `PNG or JPG â€” compressed automatically in your browser (${form.images.length}/${MAX_IMAGES} added)`}
                </p>
                <input
                  id="ap-image-input"
                  type="file"
                  accept="image/*"
                  multiple
                  disabled={imageUploading}
                  style={{ display: 'none' }}
                  onChange={handleImageFiles}
                />
              </label>
              {imageError && <p className="sd-field-error" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>{imageError}</p>}

              <div className="ap-image-url-row">
                <input
                  className="ap-input"
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="Paste an image URL and press Enter to add"
                  value={imageUrl}
                  disabled={imageUploading}
                  onChange={(e) => setImageUrl(e.target.value)}
                  onKeyDown={handleImageUrlKeyDown}
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="ap-btn-add-url"
                  onClick={handleImageUrlAdd}
                  disabled={imageUploading || !imageUrl.trim()}
                >
                  Add
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* Image Thumbnails (live previews, remove + cover badge) */}
              {form.images.length > 0 ? (
                <div className="ap-thumbs">
                  {form.images.map((src, i) => (
                    <div className="ap-preview" key={`${i}-${src.slice(0, 24)}`}>
                      <img src={src} alt={`Product image ${i + 1}`} />
                      {i === 0 && <span className="ap-cover-badge">Cover</span>}
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className="ap-preview-remove"
                        aria-label={`Remove image ${i + 1}`}
                        onClick={() => removeImage(i)}
                      >
                        Ã—
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                  {form.images.length < MAX_IMAGES && (
                    <label className="ap-thumb-add" htmlFor="ap-image-input" style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                      <MaterialIcon name="add" />
                    </label>
                  )}
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="ap-thumbs">
                  <div className="ap-thumb">
                    <MaterialIcon name="image" />
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </section>
          </form>
        </div>

        {/* Modal Footer (Actions) */}
        <footer className="ap-action-bar">
          <button className="ap-clear-btn" type="button" onClick={goBack} disabled={updateProduct.isPending}>
            Cancel
          </button>
          <button className="ap-submit-btn" type="submit" form="ap-form" disabled={updateProduct.isPending}>
            <MaterialIcon name="save" />
            {updateProduct.isPending ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Changes'}
          </button>
        </footer>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

export default EditProductPage;

/* ==========================================================================
   DASHBOARD HOME â€” dashboard_home_blue.html
   Blue Material-3 seller overview: stat bento grid, revenue chart, activity.
   ========================================================================== */

.dh-root {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  height: 100dvh;
  width: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--gs-background);
  color: var(--gs-on-surface);
