import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import '../seller-dashboard.css';
import './dashboard-overview.css';
import { prefetchPropsForPath } from '../../../lib/prefetch';
import { FEEDBACK_WHATSAPP_URL, SUPPORT_EMAIL } from '../../../lib/support';
import { useCurrentUser, useLogout } from '../../../hooks/useAuth';
import { useSellerProfile } from '../../../hooks/useUser';
import { useProducts } from '../../../hooks/useProducts';
import '../ui/widgets.css';
import { getUserInitials, getFirstName, getStoreDisplayName, timeAgo, formatMoney } from '../../../lib/user';
import MaterialIcon from '../../../components/ui/MaterialIcon';

const NAV = [
  { key: 'home', label: 'Home', icon: 'home', to: '/seller', fill: true },
  { key: 'workshop', label: 'My Workshop', icon: 'inventory_2', to: '/seller/marketplace' },
  { key: 'marketplace', label: 'Marketplace', icon: 'storefront', to: '/seller/public-marketplace' },
  { key: 'sales', label: 'Sales', icon: 'monitoring', to: '/seller/sales' },
  { key: 'profile', label: 'Seller Profile', icon: 'account_circle', to: '/seller/profile' },
  { key: 'settings', label: 'Settings', icon: 'settings', to: '/seller/settings' },
];

/**
 * Dashboard Home â€” port of dashboard_home_blue.html
 *
 * Everything on this page is REAL data for the signed-in seller:
 * - greeting + identity dropdown come from the session (GET /auth/me)
 * - stats, category chart and activity feed are computed from that seller's
 *   own products (GET /products?sellerId=me) â€” never another user's data
 */
function DashboardOverview() {
  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const [userMenuOpen, setUserMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const userMenuRef = useRef(null);
  const closeMenu = () => setMenuOpen(false);

  const { data: user } = useCurrentUser();
  const { data: profile } = useSellerProfile();
  const logout = useLogout();

  // Own products only â€” the API scopes this server-side as well.
  const sellerId = user?.id;
  const { data: products } = useProducts(sellerId ? { sellerId, page: 1, pageSize: 50 } : { sellerId: '__loading__' });

  // Close the identity dropdown on outside click / Escape.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!userMenuOpen) return undefined;
    const onMouseDown = (e) => {
      if (userMenuRef.current && !userMenuRef.current.contains(e.target)) setUserMenuOpen(false);
    };
    const onKey = (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') setUserMenuOpen(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', onMouseDown);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onMouseDown);
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    };
  }, [userMenuOpen]);

  const storeDisplayName = getStoreDisplayName(profile?.storeName, user?.fullName);

  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const list = products ?? [];
    const active = list.filter((p) => p.status === 'active');
    const drafts = list.filter((p) => p.status === 'draft');
    const inventoryValue = list.reduce((sum, p) => sum + (p.price ?? 0) * (p.stock ?? 0), 0);
    // Units on hand across every product this seller has â€” a null/undefined
    // stock counts as 0 so the total never becomes NaN.
    const totalStock = list.reduce((sum, p) => sum + (p.stock ?? 0), 0);
    const lowStock = active.filter((p) => p.stock != null && p.stock <= 5);
    const rated = list.filter((p) => p.reviews > 0);
    const avgRating = rated.length > 0 ? rated.reduce((s, p) => s + (p.rating ?? 0), 0) / rated.length : null;
    const reviewCount = rated.reduce((s, p) => s + (p.reviews ?? 0), 0);
    return { list, active, drafts, inventoryValue, totalStock, lowStock, avgRating, reviewCount };
  }, [products]);

  const statCards = [
    {
      label: 'Active Listings',
      icon: 'storefront',
      value: String(stats.active.length),
      sub: `${stats.drafts.length} draft${stats.drafts.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} saved`,
    },
    {
      label: 'Inventory Value',
      icon: 'payments',
      value: formatMoney(stats.inventoryValue),
      sub: `${stats.list.length} product${stats.list.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} in total`,
      // Sits on the opposite end of the same row: how many units the seller holds.
      subExtra: `${stats.totalStock.toLocaleString('en-US')} stock in total`,
    },
    {
      label: 'Low Stock Alerts',
      icon: 'warning',
      value: String(stats.lowStock.length),
      sub: stats.lowStock.length > 0 ? 'Restock these items soon' : 'Everything is well stocked',
    },
    {
      label: 'Average Rating',
      icon: 'sentiment_satisfied',
      value: stats.avgRating != null ? `${stats.avgRating.toFixed(1)}/5` : 'â€”',
      sub: stats.avgRating != null ? `Based on ${stats.reviewCount} reviews` : 'No reviews yet',
      highlight: true,
    },
  ];

  // Inventory-by-category bars (real distribution of this seller's products).
  const categoryChart = useMemo(() => {
    const counts = new Map();
    (products ?? []).forEach((p) => {
      const key = p.category || 'Uncategorized';
      counts.set(key, (counts.get(key) ?? 0) + 1);
    });
    const entries = [...counts.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 7);
    const max = entries.reduce((m, [, c]) => Math.max(m, c), 1);
    return {
      max,
      bars: entries.map(([name, count]) => ({
        name,
        count,
        h: `${Math.max(12, Math.round((count / max) * 100))}%`,
        strong: count === max,
      })),
    };
  }, [products]);

  // Recent activity from real data: newest products + low-stock warnings.
  const activity = useMemo(() => {
    const items = [];
    stats.lowStock.slice(0, 2).forEach((p) => {
      items.push({
        key: `low-${p.id}`,
        icon: 'warning',
        cls: 'dh-ai-secondary',
        text: (
          <>
            Low stock: <strong>{p.name}</strong> ({p.stock} left)
          </>
        ),
        time: 'Restock soon',
      });
    });
    [...stats.list]
      .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.createdAt) - new Date(a.createdAt))
      .slice(0, 4 - Math.min(2, items.length))
      .forEach((p) => {
        items.push({
          key: `prod-${p.id}`,
          icon: p.status === 'active' ? 'inventory_2' : 'edit_note',
          cls: p.status === 'active' ? 'dh-ai-primary' : 'dh-ai-tertiary',
          text: (
            <>
              <strong>{p.name}</strong> {p.status === 'active' ? 'is live in your store' : 'was saved as draft'}
            </>
          ),
          time: timeAgo(p.createdAt),
        });
      });
    return items;
  }, [stats]);

  const sidebarContent = (
    <>
      {/* SideNavBar content (shared by desktop sidebar + mobile drawer) */}
      <div className="dh-sb-title">
          <img src="/logo.png" alt="Global Store" className="dh-sb-logo" />
          <h1>Seller Dashboard</h1>
        </div>

        <div className="dh-sb-nav">
          {NAV.map((item) => (
            <Link
              key={item.key}
              to={item.to}
              className={`dh-sb-link${item.key === 'home' ? ' active' : ''}`}
              onClick={closeMenu}
              {...prefetchPropsForPath(item.to)}
            >
              <MaterialIcon name={item.icon} fill={item.fill} />
              <span className="dh-sb-label">{item.label}</span>
            </Link>
          ))}
        </div>

        <div className="dh-sb-foot">
          <div className="dh-sb-help">
            <a
              href={FEEDBACK_WHATSAPP_URL}
              className="dh-sb-link"
              target="_blank"
              rel="noopener noreferrer"
              onClick={closeMenu}
            >
              <MaterialIcon name="feedback" />
              <span className="dh-sb-label">Feedback</span>
            </a>
            <a
              href={`mailto:${SUPPORT_EMAIL}`}
              className="dh-sb-link"
              target="_blank"
              rel="noopener noreferrer"
              onClick={closeMenu}
            >
              <MaterialIcon name="help" />
              <span className="dh-sb-label">Help Center</span>
            </a>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="dh-sb-link"
              style={{ background: 'none', border: 0, cursor: 'pointer', font: 'inherit', width: '100%', textAlign: 'left' }}
              onClick={() => logout.mutate()}
              disabled={logout.isPending}
            >
              <MaterialIcon name="logout" />
              <span className="dh-sb-label">{logout.isPending ? 'Logging outâ€¦' : 'Logout'}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </>
    );

    return (
      <div className="dh-root">
        {/* SideNavBar (Hidden on Mobile, Visible on Desktop) */}
        <nav className="dh-sidebar">{sidebarContent}</nav>

        {/* Mobile drawer */}
        {menuOpen && (
          <>
            <div className="dh-mobile-overlay" onClick={closeMenu} />
            <nav className="dh-sidebar dh-sidebar-mobile">
              <button className="dh-drawer-close" aria-label="Close menu" onClick={closeMenu}>
                <MaterialIcon name="close" />
              </button>
              {sidebarContent}
            </nav>
          </>
        )}

        {/* Main Content Area */}
        <div className="dh-main">
        {/* TopAppBar (Visible on all screens) */}
        <header className="dh-topbar">
          <div className="dh-mobile-title">
            <button className="dh-menu-btn" aria-label="Open menu" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(true)}>
              <MaterialIcon name="menu" />
            </button>
            <h1>Seller Dashboard</h1>
          </div>

          {/* Mobile Search Icon */}
          <div className="dh-mobile-search">
            <button aria-label="Search">
              <MaterialIcon name="search" />
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Desktop Search Bar */}
          <div className="dh-search">
            <MaterialIcon name="search" />
            <input type="text" placeholder="Search orders, products..." />
          </div>

          {/* Trailing Actions */}
          <div className="dh-trailing">
            <div className="dh-usermenu-wrap" ref={userMenuRef}>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="dh-user-btn"
                onClick={() => setUserMenuOpen((v) => !v)}
                aria-haspopup="menu"
                aria-expanded={userMenuOpen}
                aria-label="Account menu"
              >
                <span className="dh-user-avatar" aria-hidden="true">{getUserInitials(user?.fullName)}</span>
                <span className="dh-store-label">{storeDisplayName}</span>
                <MaterialIcon name="arrow_drop_down" className="dh-store-caret" />
              </button>

              {userMenuOpen && (
                <div className="dh-usermenu" role="menu">
                  <div className="dh-usermenu-head">
                    <p className="dh-usermenu-name">{user?.fullName ?? 'Loadingâ€¦'}</p>
                    <p className="dh-usermenu-email">{user?.email ?? ''}</p>
                  </div>
                  <Link
                    to="/seller/profile"
                    className="dh-menu-item"
                    onClick={() => setUserMenuOpen(false)}
                    {...prefetchPropsForPath('/seller/profile')}
                  >
                    <MaterialIcon name="account_circle" />
                    Seller Profile
                  </Link>
                  <Link
                    to="/seller/settings"
                    className="dh-menu-item"
                    onClick={() => setUserMenuOpen(false)}
                    {...prefetchPropsForPath('/seller/settings')}
                  >
                    <MaterialIcon name="settings" />
                    Settings
                  </Link>
                  <div className="dh-menu-divider" />
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="dh-menu-item dh-menu-danger"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setUserMenuOpen(false);
                      logout.mutate();
                    }}
                    disabled={logout.isPending}
                  >
                    <MaterialIcon name="logout" />
                    {logout.isPending ? 'Logging outâ€¦' : 'Log out'}
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </header>

        {/* Main Canvas */}
        <main className="dh-canvas">
          <div className="dh-container">
            {/* Page Header â€” greets the signed-in seller by name */}
            <div>
              <h2 className="dh-head-title">Welcome back, {getFirstName(user?.fullName)}</h2>
              <p className="dh-head-sub">{storeDisplayName} &mdash; here&apos;s how your store is doing today.</p>
            </div>

            {/* Stats Bento Grid â€” computed from this seller's real products */}
            <div className="dh-stats">
              {statCards.map((stat) => (
                <div
                  key={stat.label}
                  className={`dh-stat${stat.highlight ? ' dh-stat-highlight' : ''}`}
                >
                  <div className="dh-stat-head">
                    <span className="dh-stat-label">{stat.label}</span>
                    <MaterialIcon name={stat.icon} className="dh-stat-icon" fill={stat.highlight} />
                  </div>
                  <div className="dh-stat-bottom">
                    <span className="dh-stat-value">{stat.value}</span>
                    {stat.sub && (
                      <div className="dh-stat-trend dh-stat-sub">
                        <span>{stat.sub}</span>
                        {stat.subExtra && (
                          <span className="dh-stat-sub-extra">{stat.subExtra}</span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            {/* Charts & Activity Area */}
            <div className="dh-grid">
              {/* Main Chart (takes 2 columns) */}
              <div className="dh-panel dh-panel-wide">
                <div className="dh-panel-head">
                  <h3 className="dh-panel-title">Inventory by Category</h3>
                  <span className="dh-select" style={{ border: 0, background: 'transparent', fontWeight: 600, color: '#475569' }}>
                    {stats.list.length} item{stats.list.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}
                  </span>
                </div>
                {/* Chart Area (stylized div bars â€” real category counts) */}
                <div className="dh-chart">
                  <div className="dh-chart-y">
                    <span>{categoryChart.max}</span>
                    <span>{Math.round((categoryChart.max * 2) / 3)}</span>
                    <span>{Math.round(categoryChart.max / 3)}</span>
                    <span>0</span>
                  </div>
                  {categoryChart.bars.map((bar) => (
                    <div
                      key={bar.name}
                      className={`dh-bar${bar.strong ? ' dh-bar-strong' : ''}`}
                      style={{ height: bar.h }}
                    >
                      <div className="dh-bar-tooltip">{`${bar.name}: ${bar.count}`}</div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Recent Activity List */}
              <div className="dh-panel">
                <h3 className="dh-panel-title" style={{ marginBottom: '24px' }}>
                  Recent Activity
                </h3>
                <div className="dh-activity">
                  {activity.length === 0 ? (
                    <p style={{ color: '#64748b', fontSize: '0.88rem', margin: 0 }}>
                      No activity yet â€” add your first product to see it here.
                    </p>
                  ) : (
                    activity.map((item) => (
                      <div key={item.key} className="dh-activity-item">
                        <div className={`dh-activity-icon ${item.cls}`}>
                          <MaterialIcon name={item.icon} />
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <p className="dh-activity-text">{item.text}</p>
                          <p className="dh-activity-time">{item.time}</p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ))
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </main>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default DashboardOverview;

import { uploadsApi } from '../../../api/services/uploads';
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import Sidebar from '../Sidebar';

import { getUserInitials, getFirstName, formatMoney, getStoreDisplayName } from '../../../lib/user';

/**
 * How many products a seller may list in the shared public marketplace â€” the
 * same cap the API enforces (see MARKETPLACE_LISTING_LIMIT in products.mock.ts,
 * re-exported through the types barrel so the UI never hard-codes it twice).
 */
import { MARKETPLACE_LISTING_LIMIT, WORKSHOP_PRODUCT_LIMIT } from '../../../api/types';
import MaterialIcon from '../../../components/ui/MaterialIcon';

const FILTERS = [
  { key: 'all', label: 'All products' },
  { key: 'active', label: 'Active' },
  { key: 'draft', label: 'Drafts' },
];

const SORTS = [
  { key: 'newest', label: 'Newest first' },
  { key: 'oldest', label: 'Oldest first' },
  { key: 'price_asc', label: 'Price: low to high' },
  { key: 'price_desc', label: 'Price: high to low' },
  { key: 'name', label: 'Name Aâ€“Z' },
];

/** Inline SVG paths for the three template cards (ported from the mockup). */
const TEMPLATE_ICONS = {
  'modern-boutique': 'M16 11V7a4 4 0 00-8 0v4M5 9h14l1 12H4L5 9z',
  'campus-quick-mart': 'M13 10V3L4 14h7v7l9-11h-7z',
  'tech-essentials-pro':
    'M9.75 17L9 20l-1 1h8l-1-1-.75-3M3 13h18M5 17h14a2 2 0 002-2V5a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v10a2 2 0 002 2z',
};

/** Badge chip shown on each template card in the picker. */

  'modern-boutique': { label: 'Active', tone: 'blue' },
  'campus-quick-mart': { label: 'Fast Deals', tone: 'emerald' },
  'tech-essentials-pro': { label: 'Gadgets', tone: 'purple' },
};

/** "PNG, JPG or SVG. Max size 2MB" â€” enforced before base64-encoding. */
const MAX_LOGO_BYTES = 2 * 1024 * 1024;

function WorkshopCard({ product, currentUser, onEdit, onDelete, onToggleStatus, onToggleFeatured, menuOpenId, setMenuOpenId, actionPending }) {
  const isOwner = currentUser && product.sellerId === currentUser.id;
  const open = menuOpenId === product.id;
  const menuRef = useRef(null);

  // Close the card menu on outside click / Escape.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return undefined;
    const onMouseDown = (e) => {
      if (menuRef.current && !menuRef.current.contains(e.target)) setMenuOpenId(null);
    };
    const onKey = (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') setMenuOpenId(null);
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', onMouseDown);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onMouseDown);
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    };
  }, [open, setMenuOpenId]);

  return (
    <div className="ws-card">
      <div className="ws-card-media">
        <img src={product.imageUrl} alt="" data-alt={product.imageAlt} loading="lazy" decoding="async" />
        <span className={`ws-badge ${product.status === 'active' ? 'ws-badge-active' : 'ws-badge-draft'}`}>
          {product.status === 'active' ? 'Active' : 'Draft'}
        </span>
        {/* Listing state must always be readable: an ACTIVE product is either
            on the marketplace or not, and "no badge" was ambiguous â€” a seller
            who accidentally switched listing OFF saw nothing and assumed it
            was live. Drafts cannot be listed, so they read "Lists on publish". */}
        {product.status === 'active' ? (
          <span className={`ws-badge ${product.featuredInMarketplace ? 'ws-badge-featured' : 'ws-badge-unlisted'}`}>
            <MaterialIcon name="storefront" />
            {product.featuredInMarketplace ? 'On Marketplace' : 'Not listed'}
          </span>
        ) : product.featuredInMarketplace ? (
          <span className="ws-badge ws-badge-featured">
            <MaterialIcon name="storefront" />
            Lists on publish
          </span>
        ) : null}
        {isOwner && (
          <div className="ws-menu-wrap" ref={menuRef}>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="ws-card-menu"
              aria-label={`Options for ${product.name}`}
              aria-expanded={open}
              onClick={() => setMenuOpenId(open ? null : product.id)}
            >
              <MaterialIcon name="more_vert" />
            </button>
            {open && (
              <div className="ws-menu" role="menu">
                <button type="button" className="dh-menu-item" onClick={() => { setMenuOpenId(null); onEdit(product); }}>
                  <MaterialIcon name="edit" /> Edit product
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="dh-menu-item"
                  disabled={actionPending}
                  onClick={() => {
                    setMenuOpenId(null);
                    onToggleStatus(product);
                  }}
                >
                  <MaterialIcon name={product.status === "active" ? "unpublish" : "publish"} />
                  {product.status === 'active' ? 'Unpublish (draft)' : 'Publish'}
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="dh-menu-item"
                  disabled={actionPending}
                  onClick={() => {
                    setMenuOpenId(null);
                    onToggleFeatured(product);
                  }}
                >
                  <MaterialIcon name="storefront" />
                  {product.featuredInMarketplace ? 'Remove from marketplace' : 'List on marketplace'}
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="dh-menu-item dh-menu-danger"
                  disabled={actionPending}
                  onClick={() => {
                    setMenuOpenId(null);
                    onDelete(product);
                  }}
                >
                  <MaterialIcon name="delete" /> Delete
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="ws-card-body">
        <h3 className="ws-card-title">{product.name}</h3>
        <p className="ws-card-desc">{product.description}</p>
        <div className="ws-card-footer">
          <span className="ws-price">{formatMoney(product.salePrice ?? product.price)}</span>
          <span className="ws-stock">Stock: {product.stock ?? '--'}</span>
        </div>
        {/*
          Primary edit action, always visible. Edit also lives in the â€œâ‹®â€ menu,
          but a control hidden behind a menu was not discoverable â€” sellers
          looking to change a product never found it.
        */}
        {isOwner && (
          <div className="ws-card-actions">
            <button
              type="button"
              className="ws-edit-btn"
              onClick={() => onEdit(product)}
              disabled={actionPending}
              aria-label={`Edit ${product.name}`}
            >
              <MaterialIcon name="edit" />
              Edit product
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * My Workshop â€” port of my_workshop_blue.html.
 *
 * Shows ONLY the signed-in seller's products (active + drafts), fetched with
 * the session user's id; the API additionally scopes this server-side, so no
 * other user's products can ever appear here. Search / filter / sort are fully
 * working, and each card has working Edit / Publish / Delete actions.
 */
function MyMarketplace() {
  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState('all');
  const [sort, setSort] = useState('newest');
  const [openMenu, setOpenMenu] = useState(null); // 'filter' | 'sort' | null
  const [menuForId, setMenuForId] = useState(null); // product card menu
  const [pendingDelete, setPendingDelete] = useState(null);
  // Message from the API when the 2-marketplace-listing cap is hit (or any
  // other listing failure) â€” shown just above the product grid.
  const [listingError, setListingError] = useState('');
  const toolbarRef = useRef(null);
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const { data: user } = useCurrentUser();
  const { data: profile } = useSellerProfile();
  const { data: products, isLoading } = useProducts(
    user?.id ? { sellerId: user.id, page: 1, pageSize: 50 } : { sellerId: '__loading__' },
  );
  const updateProduct = useUpdateProduct();
  const deleteProduct = useDeleteProduct();
  const updateProfile = useUpdateSellerProfile();

  // Logo column preview â€” the persisted profile logo (http(s) or data URL).
  const logoPreview = profile?.logoUrl ?? '';

  // Logo column â€” hidden file input behind the dashed upload box.
  const logoInputRef = useRef(null);
  const [logoError, setLogoError] = useState('');

  // Contact column â€” local drafts synced from the profile, saved on blur/Enter.
  const [phoneDraft, setPhoneDraft] = useState('');
  const [emailDraft, setEmailDraft] = useState('');
  const [contactSaved, setContactSaved] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    setPhoneDraft(profile?.phone ?? '');
    setEmailDraft(profile?.supportEmail ?? '');
  }, [profile?.phone, profile?.supportEmail]);

  // Location column â€” product location draft synced from the profile, saved on blur/Enter.
  const [locationDraft, setLocationDraft] = useState('');
  const [locationSaved, setLocationSaved] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    setLocationDraft(profile?.pickupLocation ?? '');
  }, [profile?.pickupLocation]);

  // Close toolbar dropdowns on outside click / Escape.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!openMenu) return undefined;
    const onMouseDown = (e) => {
      if (toolbarRef.current && !toolbarRef.current.contains(e.target)) setOpenMenu(null);
    };
    const onKey = (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') setOpenMenu(null);
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', onMouseDown);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onMouseDown);
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    };
  }, [openMenu]);

  const visible = useMemo(() => {
    let list = products ?? [];
    if (filter !== 'all') list = list.filter((p) => p.status === filter);
    if (search.trim()) {
      const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
      list = list.filter(
        (p) => p.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || p.description?.toLowerCase().includes(q),
      );
    }
    const sorters = {
      newest: (a, b) => new Date(b.createdAt) - new Date(a.createdAt),
      oldest: (a, b) => new Date(a.createdAt) - new Date(b.createdAt),
      price_asc: (a, b) => (a.salePrice ?? a.price) - (b.salePrice ?? b.price),
      price_desc: (a, b) => (b.salePrice ?? b.price) - (a.salePrice ?? a.price),
      name: (a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name),
    };
    return [...list].sort(sorters[sort] ?? sorters.newest);
  }, [products, filter, search, sort]);

  const activeCount = (products ?? []).filter((p) => p.status === 'active').length;
  const draftCount = (products ?? []).filter((p) => p.status === 'draft').length;
  const featuredCount = (products ?? []).filter(
    (p) => p.status === 'active' && p.featuredInMarketplace === true,
  ).length;
  const featuredSlotsLeft = Math.max(0, MARKETPLACE_LISTING_LIMIT - featuredCount);
  // Workshop product cap (active + drafts combined) â€” mirrors the API check.
  const workshopCount = (products ?? []).length;
  const workshopSlotsLeft = Math.max(0, WORKSHOP_PRODUCT_LIMIT - workshopCount);
  const canAddProduct = workshopSlotsLeft > 0;

  const handleToggleStatus = (product) => {
    updateProduct.mutate({
      id: product.id,
      data: { status: product.status === 'active' ? 'draft' : 'active' },
    });
  };

  /**
   * Feature / un-feature a product in the shared public marketplace. The API
   * caps each seller at 2 featured active products; when the cap is hit it
   * answers 422 and we surface that message above the grid.
   */
  const handleToggleFeatured = (product) => {
    setListingError('');
    updateProduct.mutate(
      {
        id: product.id,
        data: { featuredInMarketplace: !product.featuredInMarketplace },
      },
      {
        onError: (error) => {
          setListingError(error?.message ?? 'Could not update the marketplace listing. Try again.');
        },
      },
    );
  };

  /** Logo column â€” validate (2MB cap), base64 and persist as logoUrl. */
  const handleLogoChange = async (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    e.target.value = ''; // allow re-selecting the same file later
    if (!file) return;
    if (file.size > MAX_LOGO_BYTES) {
      setLogoError('Logo must be 2MB or smaller.');
      return;
    }
    setLogoError('');
    try {
      const uploaded = await uploadsApi.uploadImage(file);
      updateProfile.mutate({ logoUrl: uploaded.url });
    } catch (error) {
      setLogoError(error?.message || 'Could not upload that file. Try again.');
    }
  };

  /** Contact column â€” saves WhatsApp/phone + support email on blur/Enter. */
  const saveContact = () => {
    if (updateProfile.isPending) return;
    const phone = phoneDraft.trim();
    const email = emailDraft.trim();
    if (phone === (profile?.phone ?? '') && email === (profile?.supportEmail ?? '')) return;
    updateProfile.mutate(
      { phone, supportEmail: email },
      {
        onSuccess: () => {
          setContactSaved(true);
          window.setTimeout(() => setContactSaved(false), 2200);
        },
      },
    );
  };

  /** Location column â€” persists the product location on blur/Enter. */
  const saveLocation = () => {
    if (updateProfile.isPending) return;
    const location = locationDraft.trim();
    if (location === (profile?.pickupLocation ?? '')) return;
    updateProfile.mutate(
      { pickupLocation: location },
      {
        onSuccess: () => {
          setLocationSaved(true);
          window.setTimeout(() => setLocationSaved(false), 2200);
        },
      },
    );
  };

  const handleConfirmDelete = () => {
    if (!pendingDelete) return;
    deleteProduct.mutate(pendingDelete.id, {
      onSettled: () => setPendingDelete(null),
    });
  };

  const actionPending = updateProduct.isPending || deleteProduct.isPending;
  const filterLabel = FILTERS.find((f) => f.key === filter)?.label ?? 'All products';
  const sortLabel = SORTS.find((s) => s.key === sort)?.label ?? 'Newest first';

  return (
    <>
      <Sidebar active="workshop" mobileOpen={menuOpen} onMobileClose={() => setMenuOpen(false)} />

      <main className="sd-main">
        {/* TopAppBar */}
        <header className="sd-topbar">
          <div className="sd-topbar-left">
            <button className="sd-topbar-menu" aria-label="Open menu" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(true)}>
              <MaterialIcon name="menu" />
            </button>
            <div className="sd-top-search">
              <MaterialIcon name="search" />
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search workshop..."
                value={search}
                onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
                                <div className="sd-topbar-actions">
            <div className="sd-avatar-sm ws-avatar-initials" title={user?.fullName}>
              {getUserInitials(user?.fullName)}
              <span className="sd-avatar-name">Hi, {getFirstName(user?.fullName)}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </header>

        {/* Page Content */}
        <div className="sd-page ws-page">

          {/* ===== Hero Banner ===== */}
          <section className="ws-hero">
            <span className="ws-hero-glow ws-hero-glow-tl" aria-hidden="true" />
            <span className="ws-hero-glow ws-hero-glow-br" aria-hidden="true" />
            <div className="ws-hero-inner">
              <div className="ws-hero-badge">
                <MaterialIcon name="storefront" />
                <span>My Workshop</span>
              </div>
              <h1 className="ws-hero-title">
                Manage Your Workshop
                <br />
                Grow Your Business
              </h1>
              <p className="ws-hero-sub">Everything you need to run your shop in one simple place.</p>
            </div>
          </section>

          {/* Page Header with Stats */}
          <div className="ws-header-section">
            <div className="ws-header-main">
              <div>
                <h2 className="sd-page-title">My Workshop</h2>
                <p className="sd-page-sub">
                  {products
                    ? `${products.length} product${products.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} Â· ${activeCount} active Â· ${draftCount} draft${draftCount === 1 ? '' : 's'}`
                    : 'Manage your active products and drafts'}
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="ws-add-btn-primary"
                onClick={() => navigate('/seller/add-product')}
                disabled={!canAddProduct}
                title={
                  canAddProduct
                    ? undefined
                    : `Workshop is full â€” ${WORKSHOP_PRODUCT_LIMIT} of ${WORKSHOP_PRODUCT_LIMIT} products. Remove one to add another.`
                }
              >
                <MaterialIcon name="add" />
                <span>Add Product</span>
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Quick Stats */}
            <div className="ws-stats-compact">
              <div className="ws-stat-compact">
                <MaterialIcon name="inventory_2" />
                <div>
                  <div className="ws-stat-value">{workshopCount}/{WORKSHOP_PRODUCT_LIMIT}</div>
                  <div className="ws-stat-label">Total Products</div>

              <div className="ws-stat-compact">

              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="ws-settings-grid">
              {/* Logo */}
              <div className="ws-setting-item">
                <div className="ws-setting-icon">
                  {logoPreview ? (
                    <img src={logoPreview} alt="Shop logo" className="ws-setting-logo" />
                  ) : (
                    <MaterialIcon name="store" />
                  )}
                </div>
                <div className="ws-setting-info">
                  <div className="ws-setting-label">Store Logo</div>
                  <div className="ws-setting-value">
                    {getStoreDisplayName(profile?.storeName, user?.fullName)}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <label className="ws-setting-action">
                  <input
                    type="file"
                    accept="image/png,image/jpeg,image/svg+xml"
                    onChange={handleLogoChange}
                    disabled={updateProfile.isPending}
                    style={{ display: 'none' }}
                  />
                  <MaterialIcon name="upload" />
                </label>
              </div>

              {/* Location */}
              <div className="ws-setting-item">
                <div className="ws-setting-icon">
                  <MaterialIcon name="location_on" />
                </div>
                <div className="ws-setting-info">
                  <div className="ws-setting-label">Pickup Location</div>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    className="ws-setting-input"
                    value={locationDraft}
                    placeholder="e.g. Ago-Iwoye Main Campus Gate"
                    maxLength={120}
                    disabled={updateProfile.isPending}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      setLocationDraft(e.target.value);
                      setLocationSaved(false);
                    }}
                    onBlur={saveLocation}
                    onKeyDown={(e) => {
                      if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        e.currentTarget.blur();
                      }
                    }}
                  />
                </div>
                {locationSaved && (
                  <span className="ws-setting-saved">
                    <MaterialIcon name="check" />
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Contact */}
              <div className="ws-setting-item">
                <div className="ws-setting-icon">
                  <MaterialIcon name="phone" />
                </div>
                <div className="ws-setting-info">
                  <div className="ws-setting-label">WhatsApp / Hotline</div>
                  <div className="ws-phone-input-compact">
                    <span className="ws-phone-prefix-compact">+234</span>
                    <input
                      type="tel"
                      className="ws-setting-input"
                      value={phoneDraft}
                      placeholder="705 191 7468"
                      onChange={(e) => setPhoneDraft(e.target.value)}
                      onBlur={saveContact}
                      onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') e.currentTarget.blur(); }}
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
                {contactSaved && (
                  <span className="ws-setting-saved">
                    <MaterialIcon name="check" />
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Email */}
              <div className="ws-setting-item">
                <div className="ws-setting-icon">
                  <MaterialIcon name="mail" />
                </div>
                <div className="ws-setting-info">
                  <div className="ws-setting-label">Support Email</div>
                  <input
                    type="email"
                    className="ws-setting-input"
                    value={emailDraft}
                    placeholder="store@example.com"
                    onChange={(e) => setEmailDraft(e.target.value)}
                    onBlur={saveContact}
                    onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') e.currentTarget.blur(); }}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </section>

          {/* Marketplace listing cap error (e.g. "you can list at most 2") */}
          {listingError && (
            <div className="ws-listing-error" role="alert">
              <MaterialIcon name="error" />
              {listingError}
              <button
                type="button"
                className="ws-listing-error-close"
                aria-label="Dismiss message"
                onClick={() => setListingError('')}
              >
                <MaterialIcon name="close" />
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="ws-grid">
            {isLoading ? (
              <div className="ws-loading">Loading products...</div>
            ) : visible.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="ws-empty">
                <h3>No products found</h3>
                <p>
                  {search || filter !== 'all'
                    ? 'Try changing your search or filter.'
                    : 'Your workshop is empty â€” create your first product below.'}
                </p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              visible.map((product) => (
                <WorkshopCard
                  key={product.id}
                  product={product}
                  currentUser={user}
                  menuOpenId={menuForId}
                  setMenuOpenId={setMenuForId}
                  actionPending={actionPending}
                  onEdit={(p) => navigate(`/seller/edit-product/${p.id}`)}
                  onToggleStatus={handleToggleStatus}
                  onToggleFeatured={handleToggleFeatured}
                  onDelete={(p) => setPendingDelete(p)}
                />
              ))
            )}

            {/* Add New Product Card (Ghost/Dash style) */}
            <Link to="/seller/add-product" className="ws-add-card">
              <div className="ws-add-icon">
                <MaterialIcon name="add" />
              </div>
              <h3 className="ws-add-title">Create New Product</h3>
              <p className="ws-add-sub">Start a new draft or publish directly to your store.</p>
            </Link>
          </div>

        </div>
      </main>

      {/* Delete confirmation */}
      <ConfirmDialog
        open={pendingDelete !== null}
        title="Delete product?"
        message={
          pendingDelete
            ? `"${pendingDelete.name}" will be permanently removed from your workshop. This cannot be undone.`
            : ''
        }
        confirmLabel="Delete product"
        busy={deleteProduct.isPending}
        onConfirm={handleConfirmDelete}
        onCancel={() => setPendingDelete(null)}
      />
    </>
  );
}

export default MyMarketplace;

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useInfiniteProducts } from '../../../hooks/useProducts';
import {
  Icon,
  MobileFrame,
  ProductCard,
} from '../../marketplace/MobileMarketplaceShell';

const CATEGORIES = ['All', 'Fashion', 'Electronics', 'Gadgets', 'Books', 'Others'];
const MARKETPLACE_BANNERS = [
  '/ads1.jpg',
  '/ads2.jpg',
  '/ads3.jpg',
];

/**
 * Listings fetched per request. The catalog can outgrow one page (every seller
 * may list up to MARKETPLACE_LISTING_LIMIT products), so the grid renders page
 * one and "Load more" appends the next page â€” previously page one was all a
 * buyer could ever see, which hid freshly added products entirely.
 */
const PAGE_SIZE = 40;

function PublicMarketplace({ cartItems = [], savedProducts = [], onToggleSaved, onAddToCart }) {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [activeCategory, setActiveCategory] = useState('All');
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [activeBanner, setActiveBanner] = useState(0);
  const bannerRef = useRef(null);
  const prefetchTriggerRef = useRef(null);
  const isFetchingRef = useRef(false);
  
  const trimmedSearch = search.trim();
  const isFiltered = Boolean(trimmedSearch) || activeCategory !== 'All';
  const {
    data: catalog,
    isLoading,
    hasNextPage,
    fetchNextPage,
    isFetchingNextPage,
  } = useInfiniteProducts({
    featured: true,
    status: 'active',
    search: trimmedSearch || undefined,
    category: activeCategory === 'All' ? undefined : activeCategory,
    pageSize: PAGE_SIZE,
  });
  const products = (catalog?.pages ?? []).flatMap((page) => page.items);
  const catalogTotal = catalog?.pages[0]?.total ?? products.length;
  const savedIds = new Set(savedProducts.map((product) => product.id));
  const displayProducts = products;

  const submitSearch = (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    navigate(`/marketplace/search${search.trim() ? `?q=${encodeURIComponent(search.trim())}` : ''}`);
  };

  // Reset pagination when search or category filter changes
  useEffect(() => {
    queryClient.resetQueries({ 
      queryKey: ['products', 'pages'],
      exact: false 
    });
  }, [trimmedSearch, activeCategory, queryClient]);

  // Banner carousel auto-advance
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = window.setInterval(() => {
      setActiveBanner((current) => (current + 1) % MARKETPLACE_BANNERS.length);
    }, 3000);
    return () => window.clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);

  // Banner scroll behavior
  useEffect(() => {
    const track = bannerRef.current;
    const slide = track?.children[activeBanner];
    // Scroll only the banner track itself (horizontal). scrollIntoView() would
    // also scroll the page's vertical container, yanking the user back to the
    // top every time the carousel auto-advances.
    if (track && slide) track.scrollTo({ left: slide.offsetLeft, behavior: 'smooth' });
  }, [activeBanner]);

  // Prefetch next page when user reaches ~50% of current products
  useEffect(() => {
    // Track fetching state to prevent duplicate requests
    isFetchingRef.current = isFetchingNextPage;
  }, [isFetchingNextPage]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const trigger = prefetchTriggerRef.current;
    if (!trigger || isLoading || !hasNextPage) return;

    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        const [entry] = entries;
        // Trigger prefetch when the 50% marker becomes visible
        // Only if we're not already fetching and there's a next page
        if (entry.isIntersecting && !isFetchingRef.current && hasNextPage) {
          fetchNextPage();
        }
      },
      {
        root: null,
        rootMargin: '0px',
        threshold: 0,
      }
    );

    observer.observe(trigger);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [displayProducts.length, hasNextPage, isLoading, fetchNextPage]);

  return <MobileFrame active="home" cartCount={cartItems.reduce((total, item) => total + item.quantity, 0)}>
    <main className="mm-scroll mm-discover">
      <section className="mm-discover-heading"><h1>Discover</h1></section>
      <form className="mm-search-row" onSubmit={submitSearch}><label><Icon name="search" /><input value={search} onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)} placeholder="Search for product" /></label><button type="submit" aria-label="Search products" className="mm-filter"><Icon name="search" /></button></form>
      <section className="mm-banner-carousel" aria-label="Marketplace promotions"><div className="mm-banner-track" ref={bannerRef}>{MARKETPLACE_BANNERS.map((banner, index) => <img key={banner} src={banner} className="mm-banner-slide" alt={`Marketplace promotion ${index + 1}`} />)}</div><div className="mm-banner-dots" aria-hidden="true">{MARKETPLACE_BANNERS.map((banner, index) => <button type="button" key={banner} className={activeBanner === index ? 'active' : ''} aria-label={`Show promotion ${index + 1}`} onClick={() => setActiveBanner(index)} />)}</div></section>
      <section className="mm-categories"><div><h2>Categories</h2><button type="button">See all</button></div><div className="mm-category-scroll">{CATEGORIES.map((category) => <button type="button" key={category} className={activeCategory === category ? 'active' : ''} onClick={() => setActiveCategory(category)}>{category}</button>)}</div></section>
      {isLoading ? <section className="mm-product-grid"><p className="mm-loading">Loading products...</p></section> : displayProducts.length ? <section className="mm-product-grid">{displayProducts.map((product, index) => {
        // Place the prefetch trigger at approximately 50% of visible products
        const isPrefetchTrigger = index === Math.floor(displayProducts.length * 0.5);
        return (
          <div key={product.id} ref={isPrefetchTrigger ? prefetchTriggerRef : null}>
            <ProductCard product={product} saved={savedIds.has(product.id)} onToggleSaved={onToggleSaved} onAddToCart={onAddToCart} onOpen={(item) => navigate(`/marketplace/product/${item.id}`)} />
          </div>
        );
      })}</section> : <section className="mm-empty-cart mm-marketplace-empty"><Icon name="search" /><h2>{isFiltered ? 'No products match your filters' : 'No products available yet'}</h2><p>{isFiltered ? 'Try another search or category.' : 'Products will appear here when sellers publish them.'}</p></section>}
      {displayProducts.length > 0 && isFetchingNextPage && (
        <div className="mm-load-more">
          <p className="mm-loading">Loading products...</p>
        </div>
      )}
      {displayProducts.length > 0 && hasNextPage && !isFetchingNextPage && (
        <div className="mm-load-more">
          <button type="button" onClick={() => fetchNextPage()}>
            Load more products ({displayProducts.length} of {catalogTotal})
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </main>
  </MobileFrame>;
}

export default PublicMarketplace;

import { useState } from 'react';
import Sidebar from '../Sidebar';
import '../seller-dashboard.css';
import './sales-analytics.css';
import { useCurrentUser } from '../../../hooks/useAuth';
import { RANGE_LABELS, orderSellerAmount, useSellerSales } from '../../../hooks/useSellerAnalytics';
import { formatMoney, getUserInitials, timeAgo } from '../../../lib/user';
import MaterialIcon from '../../../components/ui/MaterialIcon';

/**
 * "vs last period" cell. A `null` trend means the previous period had no
 * baseline â€” shown honestly as a note, never as a fake percentage.
 */
function TrendCell({ trend, goodWhenUp }) {
  if (trend == null) {
    return <span className="sa-trend-sub">No previous-period data</span>;
  }
  const up = trend >= 0;
  const good = goodWhenUp ? up : !up;
  return (
    <>
      <span className={good ? 'sa-trend-up' : 'sa-trend-down'}>{`${up ? '+' : ''}${trend.toFixed(1)}%`}</span>
      <span className="sa-trend-sub">vs last period</span>
    </>
  );
}

/** Percentage change vs the previous period; null when there is no baseline. */
function trend(current, previous) {
  if (previous == null || previous <= 0) return null;
  return ((current - previous) / previous) * 100;
}

/**
 * Sales Analytics â€” NO mock data. Every figure is computed from the signed-in
 * seller's real orders (GET /seller/orders, aggregated in useSellerSales):
 * an empty store shows the empty state and a failing backend shows the
 * error â€” the page never invents numbers.
 */
function SalesAnalytics() {
  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const [range, setRange] = useState('30d');

  const { data: user } = useCurrentUser();
  const { summary, previous, isLoading, isFetching, isError, error, refetch, isEmpty } = useSellerSales(range);

  const stats = [
    {
      label: 'Total Revenue',
      value: formatMoney(summary.revenue),
      trend: trend(summary.revenue, previous?.revenue ?? null),
      goodWhenUp: true,
      icon: 'payments',
    },
    {
      label: 'Orders',
      value: String(summary.orders),
      trend: trend(summary.orders, previous?.orders ?? null),
      goodWhenUp: true,
      icon: 'shopping_bag',
    },
    {
      label: 'Products Sold',
      value: String(summary.productsSold),
      trend: trend(summary.productsSold, previous?.productsSold ?? null),
      goodWhenUp: true,
      icon: 'inventory_2',
    },
    {
      label: 'Refunds',
      value: String(summary.refunds),
      trend: trend(summary.refunds, previous?.refunds ?? null),
      // Refunds going UP is bad â€” the color inverts.
      goodWhenUp: false,
      icon: 'assignment_return',
    },
  ];

  return (
    <>
      <Sidebar active="sales" mobileOpen={menuOpen} onMobileClose={() => setMenuOpen(false)} />

      <main className="sd-main">
        {/* TopAppBar */}
        <header className="sd-topbar">
          <div className="sd-topbar-left">
            <button className="sd-topbar-menu" aria-label="Open menu" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(true)}>
              <MaterialIcon name="menu" />
            </button>
            <div className="sd-top-search">
              <MaterialIcon name="search" />
              <input type="text" placeholder="Search sales..." />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="sd-topbar-actions">
            <button className="sd-icon-btn" aria-label="Account">
              <MaterialIcon name="account_circle" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </header>

        {/* Page Content */}
        <div className="sd-page">
          <div className="sa-header">
            <div>
              <h2 className="sd-page-title">Sales Analytics</h2>
              <p className="sd-page-sub">Track your revenue, orders, and product performance.</p>
            </div>
            <div className="sa-toolbar">
              <select
                className="sa-select"
                value={range}
                onChange={(event) => setRange(event.target.value)}
                aria-label="Analytics period"
              >
                <option value="7d">Last 7 days</option>
                <option value="30d">Last 30 days</option>
                <option value="90d">Last 90 days</option>
              </select>
              <button
                type="button"
                className={isFetching ? 'sa-refresh spinning' : 'sa-refresh'}
                onClick={() => refetch()}
                disabled={isFetching}
                aria-label="Refresh sales data"
              >
                <MaterialIcon name="refresh" />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Honest data states â€” the page never shows invented numbers. */}
          {isError ? (
            <div className="sa-message sa-message--error">
              <p>{error?.message || 'We could not load your sales right now.'}</p>
              <button type="button" className="sa-retry" onClick={() => refetch()}>Try again</button>
            </div>
          ) : isLoading ? (
            <div className="sa-message"><p>Loading your salesâ€¦</p></div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <div className="sa-stats">
                {stats.map((stat) => (
                  <div key={stat.label} className="sa-card">
                    <div className="sa-card-top">
                      <span className="sa-card-label">{stat.label}</span>
                      <div className="sa-card-icon">
                        <MaterialIcon name={stat.icon} />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="sa-card-value">{stat.value}</div>
                    <div className="sa-card-trend">
                      <TrendCell trend={stat.trend} goodWhenUp={stat.goodWhenUp} />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>

              <div className="sa-grid">
                {/* Revenue chart â€” real revenue buckets from real orders */}
                <div className="sa-panel">
                  <div className="sa-panel-head">
                    <h3 className="sa-panel-title">Revenue Overview</h3>
                    <span className="sd-text-variant sd-hidden-md-down">{RANGE_LABELS[range]}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="sa-panel-body">
                    {isEmpty ? (
                      <div className="sa-message">
                        <p>No revenue in this period yet</p>
                        <small>Orders show up here as soon as buyers check out.</small>
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <div className={range === '30d' ? 'sa-chart sa-chart--dense' : 'sa-chart'}>
                          {summary.series.map((bar, index) => (
                            <div
                              key={`${bar.fullLabel}-${index}`}
                              className="sa-bar-wrap"
                              title={`${bar.fullLabel}: ${formatMoney(bar.value)}`}
                            >
                              <div className="sa-bar-track">
                                <div className="sa-bar" style={{ height: `${bar.height}%` }}></div>
                              </div>
                              <span className="sa-bar-label">
                                {range !== '30d' || index % 5 === 4 || index === summary.series.length - 1 ? bar.label : ''}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                        <p className="sa-note">
                          Figures from {summary.basis} order{summary.basis === 1 ? '' : 's'} in this period Â· auto-refreshes every minute
                        </p>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Recent orders â€” the newest real orders in the window */}
                <div className="sa-panel">
                  <div className="sa-panel-head">
                    <h3 className="sa-panel-title">Recent Orders</h3>
                  </div>
                  <div className="sa-panel-body">
                    {isEmpty ? (
                      <div className="sa-message">
                        <p>No orders in this period yet</p>
                        <small>Share your store link to start making sales.</small>
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="sa-orders">
                        {summary.recent.map((order) => (
                          <div key={order.id} className="sa-order">
                            <div className="sa-order-info">
                              <div className="sa-order-avatar">{order.buyerInitials || getUserInitials(order.buyerName)}</div>
                              <div>
                                <div className="sa-order-name">{order.buyerName || 'Customer'}</div>
                                <div className="sa-order-sub">{order.reference ? `#${order.reference} Â· ` : ''}{timeAgo(order.createdAt)}</div>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                            <div className="sa-order-amount">{formatMoney(orderSellerAmount(order, user?.id))}</div>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </main>
    </>
  );
}

export default SalesAnalytics;

/* ==========================================================================

import { useState } from 'react';
import Sidebar from '../Sidebar';
import {
  useSellerProfile,
  useUpdateSellerProfile,
  useUpdateCurrentUser,
} from '../../../hooks/useUser';
import { useCurrentUser } from '../../../hooks/useAuth';
import { getUserInitials, getFirstName } from '../../../lib/user';
import '../seller-dashboard.css';
import './settings.css';
import MaterialIcon from '../../../components/ui/MaterialIcon';

function SellerProfile() {
  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const { data: profile, isLoading, error } = useSellerProfile();
  const { data: user } = useCurrentUser();
  const updateProfile = useUpdateSellerProfile();
  const updateAccount = useUpdateCurrentUser();
  const [serverError, setServerError] = useState(null);

  const handleSave = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setServerError(null);
    const formData = new FormData(e.target);

    const profileData = {
      storeName: formData.get('storeName') || undefined,
      phone: formData.get('phone') || undefined,
      level: formData.get('level') || undefined,
      department: formData.get('department') || undefined,
      course: formData.get('course') || undefined,
      school: formData.get('school') || undefined,
      bio: formData.get('bio') || undefined,
    };
    const fullName = String(formData.get('fullName') ?? '').trim();
    const accountData = fullName && fullName !== user?.fullName ? { fullName } : null;

    try {
      // Save both the seller profile and (if changed) the account name.
      await Promise.all([
        updateProfile.mutateAsync(profileData),
        accountData ? updateAccount.mutateAsync(accountData) : Promise.resolve(null),
      ]);
      setEditing(false);
    } catch (err) {
      setServerError(err?.message || 'Failed to save profile.');
    }
  };

  const memberSince = user?.createdAt
    ? new Date(user.createdAt).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', year: 'numeric' })
    : null;

  if (isLoading) {
    return (<><Sidebar active="profile" variant="profile" mobileOpen={menuOpen} onMobileClose={() => setMenuOpen(false)} /><div className="sd-main"><div className="sp-canvas"><p>Loading profile…</p></div></div></>);
  }
  if (error) {
    return (<><Sidebar active="profile" variant="profile" mobileOpen={menuOpen} onMobileClose={() => setMenuOpen(false)} /><div className="sd-main"><div className="sp-canvas"><p>Error loading profile: {error.message}</p></div></div></>);
  }

  return (
    <>
      <Sidebar active="profile" variant="profile" mobileOpen={menuOpen} onMobileClose={() => setMenuOpen(false)} />
      <div className="sd-main">
        <header className="sd-topbar">
          <div className="sd-topbar-left">
            <button className="sd-topbar-menu" aria-label="Open menu" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(true)}><MaterialIcon name="menu" /></button>
            <h2 className="sp-title">Seller Dashboard</h2>
          </div>
                              <div className="sd-topbar-actions">
            <div className="sp-search"><MaterialIcon name="search" /><input type="text" placeholder="Search..." /></div>
            <div className="sd-avatar-sm ws-avatar-initials" title={user?.fullName}>
              {getUserInitials(user?.fullName)}
              <span className="sd-avatar-name">Hi, {getFirstName(user?.fullName)}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </header>
        <main className="sp-canvas">
          <div className="sp-inner">
            <div className="sp-heading">
              <h1 className="sp-heading-title">Account Settings</h1>
              <p className="sp-heading-sub">Manage your seller profile and contact information.</p>
            </div>
            {serverError && <div style={{ padding: "12px 16px", borderRadius: "12px", background: "#FEF2F2", border: "1px solid #FECACA", color: "#DC2626", fontSize: "0.875rem", marginBottom: "16px" }}>{serverError}</div>}
            {updateProfile.isSuccess && <div style={{ padding: "12px 16px", borderRadius: "12px", background: "#F0FDF4", border: "1px solid #BBF7D0", color: "#16A34A", fontSize: "0.875rem", marginBottom: "16px" }}>Profile saved successfully.</div>}
            <div className="sp-card">
              {/* Account summary — real session data (read-only) */}
              <div className="sp-card-head">
                <div className="sp-card-head-left">
                  <div className="sp-avatar-circle"><span style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>{getUserInitials(user?.fullName)}</span></div>
                  <div>
                    <h3 className="sp-card-title">{user?.fullName ?? 'Loading…'}</h3>
                    <p className="sp-card-sub">
                      {user?.email}
                      {memberSince ? ` · Member since ${memberSince}` : ''}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="sp-edit-btn"
                  onClick={() => setEditing((v) => !v)}
                >
                  <MaterialIcon name={editing ? "close" : "edit"} />
                  {editing ? 'CANCEL' : 'EDIT'}
                </button>
              </div>
              <form className="sp-card-body" onSubmit={handleSave}>
                <div className="sp-grid">
                  <div className="sp-field">
                    <label className="sp-label" htmlFor="profileFullName">Full Name</label>
                    <input
                      className="sp-input"
                      id="profileFullName"
                      name="fullName"
                      type="text"
                      defaultValue={user?.fullName ?? ''}
                      placeholder="Your full name"
                      disabled={!editing}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div className="sp-field">
                    <label className="sp-label" htmlFor="profileEmail">Email (read-only)</label>
                    <input
                      className="sp-input"
                      id="profileEmail"
                      type="email"
                      value={user?.email ?? ''}
                      disabled
                      readOnly
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div className="sp-field">
                    <label className="sp-label" htmlFor="profileStoreName">Store Name</label>
                    <input className="sp-input" id="profileStoreName" name="storeName" type="text" defaultValue={profile?.storeName ?? ''} placeholder="Your store name" disabled={!editing} />
                  </div>
                  <div className="sp-field">
                    <label className="sp-label" htmlFor="profilePhone">Phone Number</label>
                    <input className="sp-input" id="profilePhone" name="phone" type="text" defaultValue={profile?.phone ?? ''} placeholder="Your phone number" disabled={!editing} />
                  </div>
                  <div className="sp-field">
                    <label className="sp-label" htmlFor="profileLevel">Level</label>
                    <input className="sp-input" id="profileLevel" name="level" type="text" defaultValue={profile?.level ?? ''} placeholder="e.g. 400" disabled={!editing} />
                  </div>
                  <div className="sp-field">
                    <label className="sp-label" htmlFor="profileDepartment">Department</label>
                    <input className="sp-input" id="profileDepartment" name="department" type="text" defaultValue={profile?.department ?? ''} placeholder="Your department" disabled={!editing} />
                  </div>
                  <div className="sp-field">
                    <label className="sp-label" htmlFor="profileCourse">Course of Study</label>
                    <input className="sp-input" id="profileCourse" name="course" type="text" defaultValue={profile?.course ?? ''} placeholder="Your course of study" disabled={!editing} />
                  </div>
                  <div className="sp-field">
                    <label className="sp-label" htmlFor="profileSchool">School</label>
                    <input className="sp-input" id="profileSchool" name="school" type="text" defaultValue={profile?.school ?? ''} placeholder="Your school" disabled={!editing} />
                  </div>
                  <div className="sp-field sp-field-full">
                    <label className="sp-label" htmlFor="profileBio">Bio</label>
                    <textarea className="sp-textarea" id="profileBio" name="bio" rows="3" defaultValue={profile?.bio ?? ''} placeholder="Tell buyers about your store" disabled={!editing} />
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="sp-card-foot">
                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    className="sp-done-btn"
                    disabled={!editing || updateProfile.isPending || updateAccount.isPending}
                  >
                    {updateProfile.isPending || updateAccount.isPending ? 'Saving…' : 'Save Changes'}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </form>
            </div>
            <div className="sp-card sp-contact">
              <div className="sp-contact-head">
                <h3 className="sp-contact-title"><MaterialIcon name="support_agent" />Contact Us</h3>
                <p className="sp-contact-sub">Need help with your seller account? Reach out to support.</p>
              </div>
              <div className="sp-contact-grid">
                <div className="sp-contact-item">
                  <div className="sp-contact-icon"><MaterialIcon name="call" /></div>
                  <div><p className="sp-contact-label">Phone No.</p><p className="sp-contact-value">07051917468</p></div>
                </div>
                <div className="sp-contact-item">
                  <div className="sp-contact-icon"><MaterialIcon name="mail" /></div>
                  <div><p className="sp-contact-label">Email</p><p className="sp-contact-value">universe26@gmail.com</p></div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="sp-contact-wa-wrap">
                <a className="sp-contact-wa" href="https://wa.me/2347051917468" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                  <svg className="sp-contact-wa-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="20" height="20" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M17.472 14.382c-.297-.149-1.758-.867-2.03-.967-.273-.099-.471-.148-.67.15-.197.297-.767.966-.94 1.164-.173.199-.347.223-.644.075-.297-.15-1.255-.463-2.39-1.475-.883-.788-1.48-1.761-1.653-2.059-.173-.297-.018-.458.13-.606.134-.133.298-.347.446-.52.149-.174.198-.298.298-.497.099-.198.05-.371-.025-.52-.075-.149-.669-1.612-.916-2.207-.242-.579-.487-.5-.669-.51-.173-.008-.371-.01-.57-.01-.198 0-.52.074-.792.372-.272.297-1.04 1.016-1.04 2.479 0 1.462 1.065 2.875 1.213 3.074.149.198 2.096 3.2 5.077 4.487.709.306 1.262.489 1.694.625.712.227 1.36.195 1.871.118.571-.085 1.758-.719 2.006-1.413.248-.694.248-1.289.173-1.413-.074-.124-.272-.198-.57-.347m-5.421 7.403h-.004a9.87 9.87 0 01-5.031-1.378l-.361-.214-3.741.982.998-3.648-.235-.374a9.86 9.86 0 01-1.51-5.26c.001-5.45 4.436-9.884 9.888-9.884 2.64 0 5.122 1.03 6.988 2.898a9.825 9.825 0 012.893 6.994c-.003 5.45-4.437 9.884-9.885 9.884m8.413-18.297A11.815 11.815 0 0012.05 0C5.495 0 .16 5.335.157 11.892c0 2.096.547 4.142 1.588 5.945L.057 24l6.305-1.654a11.882 11.882 0 005.683 1.448h.005c6.554 0 11.89-5.335 11.893-11.893a11.821 11.821 0 00-3.48-8.413z" /></svg>
