/**
 * Seller Settings hub â€” port of seller_settings.html.
 * /seller/settings
 *
 * Every action is real: password change, email change and account deletion go
 * through the API (all password-confirmed server-side); logout ends the
 * session; Terms/Privacy open their content inline.
 */
function SellerSettings() {
  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const [activeModal, setActiveModal] = useState(null); // 'password' | 'email' | 'terms' | 'privacy' | 'delete'
  const [deletePassword, setDeletePassword] = useState('');
  const closeMenu = () => setMenuOpen(false);

  const { data: user } = useCurrentUser();
  const logout = useLogout();
  const deleteAccount = useDeleteAccount();

  const openModal = (key) => setActiveModal(key);
  const closeModal = () => setActiveModal(null);

  const memberSince = user?.createdAt
    ? new Date(user.createdAt).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', year: 'numeric' })
    : null;

  return (
    <>
      <Sidebar active="settings" mobileOpen={menuOpen} onMobileClose={closeMenu} />

      <div className="sd-main st-root">
        {/* TopAppBar */}
        <header className="st-topbar">
          <div className="st-topbar-left">
            <button className="st-topbar-hamburger" aria-label="Open menu" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(true)}>
              <MenuIcon />
            </button>
            <h2 className="st-topbar-title">Settings</h2>
          </div>
          <div className="st-topbar-actions">
            <div className="st-avatar" title={user?.fullName}>{getUserInitials(user?.fullName)}</div>
          </div>
        </header>

        {/* Main Content */}
        <main className="st-canvas">
          <div className="st-container">
            {/* Header Section */}
            <div className="st-head">
              <div className="st-head-icon">
                <CogIcon />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h1 className="st-head-title">Account Settings</h1>
                <p className="st-head-sub">Manage your preferences and configurations.</p>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Signed-in account summary â€” real session data */}
            <div className="st-account-card">
              <span className="sd-user-avatar st-account-avatar" aria-hidden="true">
                {getUserInitials(user?.fullName)}
              </span>
              <div>
                <p className="st-account-name">{user?.fullName ?? 'Loadingâ€¦'}</p>
                <p className="st-account-email">{user?.email ?? ''}</p>
                <span className="st-account-badge">
                  {user?.accountType === 'seller' ? 'Seller account' : 'Buyer account'}
                </span>
              </div>
              {memberSince && <div className="st-account-since">Member since {memberSince}</div>}
            </div>

            {/* Settings List */}
            <div className="st-list">
              <ul>
                {SETTINGS_ITEMS.map((item) => (
                  <li key={item.key}>
                    {item.to ? (
                      <Link to={item.to} className="st-item">
                        <div className="st-item-left">
                          <span className="st-item-icon">{item.icon}</span>
                          <div>
                            <h3 className="st-item-title">{item.title}</h3>
                            <p className="st-item-desc">{item.desc}</p>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <span className="st-item-chevron">
                          <ChevronIcon />
                        </span>
                      </Link>
                    ) : item.href ? (
                      <a
                        href={item.href}
                        className="st-item"
                        target="_blank"
                        rel="noopener noreferrer"
                      >
                        <div className="st-item-left">
                          <span className="st-item-icon">{item.icon}</span>
                          <div>
                            <h3 className="st-item-title">{item.title}</h3>
                            <p className="st-item-desc">{item.desc}</p>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <span className="st-item-chevron">
                          <ExternalLinkIcon />
                        </span>
                      </a>
                    ) : (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className="st-item"
                        style={{ width: '100%', background: 'none', border: 0, font: 'inherit', cursor: 'pointer', textAlign: 'left' }}
                        onClick={() => openModal(item.key)}
                      >
                        <div className="st-item-left">
                          <span className="st-item-icon">{item.icon}</span>
                          <div>
                            <h3 className="st-item-title">{item.title}</h3>
                            <p className="st-item-desc">{item.desc}</p>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <span className="st-item-chevron">
                          <ChevronIcon />
                        </span>
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </li>
                ))}

                {/* Logout (distinct visually) â€” fully working */}
                <li>
                  <button className="st-item st-item-logout" type="button" onClick={() => logout.mutate()} disabled={logout.isPending}>
                    <div className="st-item-left">
                      <span className="st-item-icon">
                        <LogoutIcon />
                      </span>
                      <div>
                        <h3 className="st-logout-title">{logout.isPending ? 'Logging outâ€¦' : 'Logout'}</h3>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </button>
                </li>
              </ul>
            </div>

            {/* Danger Zone â€” permanent account deletion */}
            <div className="st-danger-card">
              <h3 className="st-danger-title">
                <MaterialIcon name="dangerous" />
                Danger Zone
              </h3>
              <p className="st-danger-desc">
                Permanently delete your account, along with your products, store profile and all
                sessions. This action cannot be undone â€” download anything you want to keep first.
              </p>
              <button type="button" className="sd-btn sd-btn-danger" onClick={() => openModal('delete')}>
                <MaterialIcon name="delete_forever" style={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
                Delete My Account
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </main>
      </div>

      {/* ---- Modals ---- */}
      {activeModal === 'password' && <ChangePasswordModal onClose={closeModal} />}
      {activeModal === 'email' && <UpdateEmailModal onClose={closeModal} />}

      {activeModal === 'terms' && (
        <InfoModal title="Terms of Service" onClose={closeModal}>
          <p><strong>1. Selling on Universe.</strong> Sellers are responsible for the accuracy of their listings, the quality of their products and timely fulfilment of orders.</p>
          <p><strong>2. Prohibited items.</strong> Counterfeit goods, illegal items and anything that violates another person's rights may not be listed.</p>
          <p><strong>3. Payouts.</strong> Sale proceeds are held until the order is confirmed delivered, then released to your payout method.</p>
          <p><strong>4. Account security.</strong> Keep your password confidential. You are responsible for activity that happens under your account.</p>
          <p><strong>5. Termination.</strong> Accounts that repeatedly violate these terms may be suspended.</p>
          <p style={{ color: 'var(--color-primary)' }}>
            <Link to="/terms" style={{ fontWeight: 600, textDecoration: 'none', color: 'var(--color-primary)' }}>
              Read the full Terms of Service â†’
            </Link>
          </p>
        </InfoModal>
      )}

      {activeModal === 'privacy' && (
        <InfoModal title="Privacy Policy" onClose={closeModal}>
          <p><strong>What we store.</strong> Your name, email, store profile and the products you publish. Passwords are stored only as salted PBKDF2 hashes â€” never in plain text.</p>
          <p><strong>What we never share.</strong> Your personal details and your draft products are private. Other users only ever see your public store information and published listings.</p>
          <p><strong>Sessions.</strong> Sessions are scoped to your browser. Logging out revokes your tokens; changing your password revokes every other device's session.</p>
          <p><strong>Deletion.</strong> Deleting your account permanently removes your products, profile and personal data.</p>
        </InfoModal>
      )}

      <ConfirmDialog
        open={activeModal === 'delete'}
        title="Delete your account?"
        message="This permanently removes your account, every product you own, your store profile and all sessions. There is no way back."
        requireText="DELETE"
        confirmLabel="Delete forever"
        busy={deleteAccount.isPending}
        onConfirm={() => deleteAccount.mutate({ currentPassword: deletePassword })}
        onCancel={closeModal}
      >
        <div className="sd-field">
          <label htmlFor="delete-current-password">Current password</label>
          <input
            id="delete-current-password"
            type="password"
            autoComplete="current-password"
            value={deletePassword}
            onChange={(e) => setDeletePassword(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Confirm your password"
          />
          {deleteAccount.isError && (
            <p className="sd-field-error">{deleteAccount.error?.message ?? 'Deletion failed.'}</p>
          )}
        </div>
      </ConfirmDialog>

    </>
  );
}

/** Modal with a simple body â€” used for Terms and Privacy content. */
function InfoModal({ title, onClose, children }) {
  return (
    <div
      className="sd-modal-overlay"
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-label={title}
      onMouseDown={(e) => {
        if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose();
      }}
    >
      <div className="sd-modal">
        <h2 className="sd-modal-title">{title}</h2>
        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gap: 10, fontSize: '0.86rem', color: '#475569', lineHeight: 1.55 }}>
          {children}
        </div>
        <div className="sd-modal-actions">
          <button type="button" className="sd-btn sd-btn-primary" onClick={onClose}>
            Close
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Change-password dialog â€” posts to PATCH /users/me/password. */
function ChangePasswordModal({ onClose }) {
  const changePassword = useChangePassword();
  const [fields, setFields] = useState({ currentPassword: '', newPassword: '', confirm: '' });
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);

  const set = (key) => (e) => setFields((f) => ({ ...f, [key]: e.target.value }));

  const submit = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    if (fields.newPassword !== fields.confirm) {
      setError('New passwords do not match.');
      return;
    }
    changePassword.mutate(
      { currentPassword: fields.currentPassword, newPassword: fields.newPassword },
      {
        onSuccess: () => setSuccess(true),
        onError: (err) => {
          const fieldMsg = err?.fieldErrors && Object.values(err.fieldErrors)[0];
          setError(fieldMsg || err.message || 'Could not change your password.');
        },
      },
    );
  };

  return (
    <div
      className="sd-modal-overlay"
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-label="Change password"
      onMouseDown={(e) => {
        if (e.target === e.currentTarget && !changePassword.isPending) onClose();
      }}
    >
      <div className="sd-modal">
        <h2 className="sd-modal-title">Change Password</h2>
        {success ? (
          <>
            <div className="sd-form-success">
              Password changed. Every other signed-in device has been logged out.
            </div>
            <div className="sd-modal-actions">
              <button type="button" className="sd-btn sd-btn-primary" onClick={onClose}>Done</button>
            </div>
          </>
        ) : (
          <form onSubmit={submit}>
            {error && <div className="sd-form-error">{error}</div>}
            <div className="sd-field">
              <label htmlFor="pw-current">Current password</label>
              <input id="pw-current" type="password" autoComplete="current-password" value={fields.currentPassword} onChange={set('currentPassword')} />
            </div>
            <div className="sd-field">
              <label htmlFor="pw-new">New password</label>
              <input id="pw-new" type="password" autoComplete="new-password" value={fields.newPassword} onChange={set('newPassword')} />
            </div>
            <div className="sd-field">
              <label htmlFor="pw-confirm">Confirm new password</label>
              <input id="pw-confirm" type="password" autoComplete="new-password" value={fields.confirm} onChange={set('confirm')} />
            </div>
            <div className="sd-modal-actions">
              <button type="button" className="sd-btn sd-btn-ghost" onClick={onClose} disabled={changePassword.isPending}>
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button type="submit" className="sd-btn sd-btn-primary" disabled={changePassword.isPending}>
                {changePassword.isPending ? 'Savingâ€¦' : 'Change password'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Update-email dialog â€” posts to POST /users/me/email (password-confirmed). */
function UpdateEmailModal({ onClose }) {
  const updateEmail = useUpdateEmail();
  const [fields, setFields] = useState({ currentPassword: '', newEmail: '' });
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);

  const submit = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    updateEmail.mutate(
      { currentPassword: fields.currentPassword, newEmail: fields.newEmail },
      {
        onSuccess: () => setSuccess(true),
        onError: (err) => {
          const fieldMsg = err?.fieldErrors && Object.values(err.fieldErrors)[0];
          setError(fieldMsg || err.message || 'Could not update your email.');
        },
      },
    );
  };

  return (
    <div
      className="sd-modal-overlay"
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-label="Update email"
      onMouseDown={(e) => {
        if (e.target === e.currentTarget && !updateEmail.isPending) onClose();
      }}
    >
      <div className="sd-modal">
        <h2 className="sd-modal-title">Update Email</h2>
        {success ? (
          <>
            <div className="sd-form-success">Email updated. Use your new email next time you sign in.</div>
            <div className="sd-modal-actions">
              <button type="button" className="sd-btn sd-btn-primary" onClick={onClose}>Done</button>
            </div>
          </>
        ) : (
          <form onSubmit={submit}>
            {error && <div className="sd-form-error">{error}</div>}
            <div className="sd-field">
              <label htmlFor="email-current-password">Current password</label>
              <input
                id="email-current-password"
                type="password"
                autoComplete="current-password"
                value={fields.currentPassword}
                onChange={(e) => setFields((f) => ({ ...f, currentPassword: e.target.value }))}
              />
            </div>
            <div className="sd-field">
              <label htmlFor="email-new">New email address</label>
              <input
                id="email-new"
                type="email"
                autoComplete="email"
                value={fields.newEmail}
                onChange={(e) => setFields((f) => ({ ...f, newEmail: e.target.value }))}
              />
            </div>
            <div className="sd-modal-actions">
              <button type="button" className="sd-btn sd-btn-ghost" onClick={onClose} disabled={updateEmail.isPending}>
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button type="submit" className="sd-btn sd-btn-primary" disabled={updateEmail.isPending}>
                {updateEmail.isPending ? 'Savingâ€¦' : 'Update email'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default SellerSettings;

import { Suspense } from 'react';
import { useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
import DashboardSkeleton from '../skeletons/DashboardSkeleton';

/**
 * Keyed Suspense wrapper for lazy dashboard views.
 *
 * When switching between /seller/* views, React (and React Router's route
 * transitions) can otherwise REUSE the same Suspense boundary and keep the
 * old view visible while the next chunk downloads â€” so no skeleton would show.
 * Keying the boundary by pathname forces a fresh mount on every navigation,
 * which makes the DashboardSkeleton appear the moment the user clicks a nav
 * option and stay until the target view's chunk is ready.
 */
const DashboardView = ({ children }) => {
  const { pathname } = useLocation();
  return (
    <Suspense key={pathname} fallback={<DashboardSkeleton />}>
      {children}
    </Suspense>
  );
};

export default DashboardView;

/**
 * Shared Global Store sidebar (blue theme) as seen in
 * my_workshop_blue.html and seller_profile.html.
 *
 * Shows the signed-in user's identity (avatar initials, name, email) and a
 * fully working logout action.
 */
function Sidebar({ active, showLogo = true, variant = 'workshop', mobileOpen = false, onMobileClose }) {
  const { data: user } = useCurrentUser();
  const logout = useLogout();
  const isProfile = variant === 'profile';

  const handleLogout = () => {
    logout.mutate();
    onMobileClose?.();
  };

  const content = (
    <>
      <div className="sd-brand">
        {showLogo && <img src="/logo.png" alt="Global Store" className="sd-brand-logo" />}
      </div>

      <div className={isProfile ? 'sd-nav sd-nav-tight' : 'sd-nav'}>
        {NAV_ITEMS.map((item) => (
          <Link
            key={item.key}
            to={item.to}
            className={`sd-nav-link${active === item.key ? ' active' : ''}`}
            onClick={onMobileClose}
            {...prefetchPropsForPath(item.to)}
          >
            <MaterialIcon name={item.icon} className="sd-nav-icon" />
            {isProfile ? (
              <span className="sd-nav-label">{item.label}</span>
            ) : (
              item.label
            )}
          </Link>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="sd-foot">
        {user && (
          <div className="sd-user-card">
            <span className="sd-user-avatar" aria-hidden="true">{getUserInitials(user.fullName)}</span>
            <div className="sd-user-meta">
              <p className="sd-user-name">{user.fullName}</p>
              <p className="sd-user-email">{user.email}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        <a
          href={FEEDBACK_WHATSAPP_URL}
          className="sd-foot-link"
          target="_blank"
          rel="noopener noreferrer"
          onClick={onMobileClose}
        >
          <MaterialIcon name="feedback" />
          {isProfile ? <span className="sd-nav-label">Feedback</span> : 'Feedback'}
        </a>
        <a
          href={`mailto:${SUPPORT_EMAIL}`}
          className="sd-foot-link"
          target="_blank"
          rel="noopener noreferrer"
          onClick={onMobileClose}
        >
          <MaterialIcon name="help" />
          {isProfile ? <span className="sd-nav-label">Help Center</span> : 'Help Center'}
        </a>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="sd-foot-link"
          onClick={handleLogout}
          disabled={logout.isPending}
          style={{ background: 'none', border: 0, font: 'inherit', cursor: 'pointer', textAlign: 'left', width: '100%' }}
        >
          <MaterialIcon name="logout" />
          {isProfile ? <span className="sd-nav-label">{logout.isPending ? 'Logging outâ€¦' : 'Logout'}</span> : logout.isPending ? 'Logging outâ€¦' : 'Logout'}
        </button>
      </div>
    </>

  );

  return (
    <>
      <nav className="sd-sidebar">{content}</nav>

      {/* Mobile drawer */}
      {mobileOpen && (
        <>
          <div className="sd-mobile-overlay" onClick={onMobileClose} />
          <nav className="sd-sidebar sd-sidebar-mobile">
            <button className="sd-drawer-close" aria-label="Close menu" onClick={onMobileClose}>
              <MaterialIcon name="close" />
            </button>
            {content}
          </nav>
        </>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

export default Sidebar;

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useCurrentUser } from '../../hooks/useAuth';
import { useSellerProfile, useUpdateCurrentUser, useUpdateSellerProfile } from '../../hooks/useUser';
import { getPrettyStoreDomain, slugifyStoreName } from '../../lib/storeDomain';
import './seller-onboarding.css';

const StoreIcon = () => <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 10h18M5 10v10h14V10M4 10l1.5-6h13L20 10M8 10v3m4-3v3m4-3v3" /></svg>;
const UserIcon = () => <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="8" r="3.5" /><path d="M5 21a7 7 0 0 1 14 0" /></svg>;
const GlobeIcon = () => <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9" /><path d="M3 12h18M12 3a14 14 0 0 1 0 18M12 3a14 14 0 0 0 0 18" /></svg>;
const ChartIcon = () => <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 19V5m0 14h16M8 16v-4m4 4V8m4 8V5" /></svg>;
const BoxIcon = () => <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m12 3 8 4-8 4-8-4 8-4Zm-8 4v10l8 4 8-4V7M12 11v10" /></svg>;
const ArrowIcon = () => <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14m-6-6 6 6-6 6" /></svg>;

const initialFields = {
  storeName: '',
  fullName: '',
  phone: '',
  level: '',
  department: '',
  course: '',
  school: 'Olabisi Onabanjo University',
};

function SellerOnboarding() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { data: user } = useCurrentUser();
  const { data: profile, isLoading } = useSellerProfile();
  const updateProfile = useUpdateSellerProfile();
  const updateUser = useUpdateCurrentUser();
  const [step, setStep] = useState(1);
  const [fields, setFields] = useState(initialFields);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user || profile) {
      setFields((current) => ({
        ...current,
        fullName: user?.fullName || current.fullName,
        storeName: profile?.storeName || current.storeName,
        phone: profile?.phone || current.phone,
        level: profile?.level || current.level,
        department: profile?.department || current.department,
        course: profile?.course || current.course,
        school: profile?.school || current.school,
      }));
    }
  }, [user, profile]);

  const setField = (name) => (event) => setFields((current) => ({ ...current, [name]: event.target.value }));

  const saveStore = async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!fields.storeName.trim()) {
      setError('Enter a store or brand name to continue.');
      return;
    }
    setError('');
    try {
      await updateProfile.mutateAsync({ storeName: fields.storeName.trim() });
      setStep(2);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err?.message || 'We could not save your store details.');
    }
  };

  const saveProfile = async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!fields.fullName.trim() || !fields.phone.trim() || !fields.level || !fields.department.trim() || !fields.course.trim()) {
      setError('Complete the required profile fields to continue.');
      return;
    }
    setError('');
    try {
      await Promise.all([
        updateProfile.mutateAsync({
          storeName: fields.storeName.trim(),
          phone: fields.phone.trim(),
          level: fields.level,
          department: fields.department.trim(),
          course: fields.course.trim(),
          school: fields.school,
        }),
        updateUser.mutateAsync({ fullName: fields.fullName.trim() }),
      ]);
      setStep(3);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err?.message || 'We could not save your profile.');
    }
  };

  const pending = updateProfile.isPending || updateUser.isPending;

  if (isLoading) return <div className="seller-onboarding-loading">Loading your setup...</div>;

  return (
    <div className="seller-onboarding">
      <header className="onboarding-header">
        <button className="onboarding-back" type="button" onClick={() => navigate('/seller')}><span aria-hidden="true">â€¹</span> <span>Back to Dashboard</span></button>
        <img className="onboarding-logo" src="/logo.png" alt="Universe" />
        <a href="mailto:support@universe.com" className="onboarding-support">Need help? <b>Support</b></a>
      </header>

      {step === 3 ? (
        <Milestones
          onContinue={() => navigate('/seller')}
          storeSlug={slugifyStoreName(
            fields.storeName || profile?.storeName || user?.fullName || '',
          )}
        />
      ) : (
        <main className="setup-shell">
          <aside className="setup-steps" aria-label="Onboarding progress">
            <span className="eyebrow">MERCHANT SETUP</span>
            <h1>Create Your Store</h1>
            <div className="step-list">
              <Step number="1" active={step === 1} complete={step > 1} title="Store Setup" description="Name & brand definition" />
              <Step number="2" active={step === 2} title="Profile Setup" description="Personal details" />
              <Step number="3" title="Getting Started" description="Launch checklist" />
            </div>
          </aside>

          <section className="setup-form-panel">
            {step === 1 ? (
              <>
                <span className="step-label">STEP 1</span>
                <h2>Name of Setup</h2>
                <p className="setup-intro">Get a head start on your store setup in just a few minutes.</p>
                <form onSubmit={saveStore} className="setup-form">
                  <div className="setup-card">
                    <div className="setup-card-title"><span className="icon-badge"><StoreIcon /></span><div><h3>Setup</h3><p>What's your store name?</p></div></div>
                    <label htmlFor="store-name">STORE OR BRAND NAME <em>*</em></label>
                    <div className="input-with-icon"><StoreIcon /><input id="store-name" value={fields.storeName} onChange={setField('storeName')} placeholder="Enter the name of your store" autoFocus /></div>
                    <small>You can change or customize your public store URL at any time later in Settings.</small>
                  </div>
                  <ActionRow pending={pending} label="NEXT" />
                </form>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <span className="step-label">STEP 2</span>
                <h2>Complete Your Profile</h2>
                <p className="setup-intro">Tell us more about your background to set up your merchant profile.</p>
                <form onSubmit={saveProfile} className="profile-form">
                  <div className="profile-card-header"><span className="profile-avatar"><UserIcon /></span><div><h3>Seller Profile</h3><p>Update your academic and personal details.</p></div></div>
                  <div className="profile-fields">
                    <Field label="Name" name="fullName" value={fields.fullName} onChange={setField('fullName')} placeholder="Enter your full name" />
                    <Field label="Phone No." name="phone" value={fields.phone} onChange={setField('phone')} placeholder="+234" type="tel" />
                    <label><span>Level</span><select name="level" value={fields.level} onChange={setField('level')}><option value="">Select Level</option>{['100', '200', '300', '400', '500'].map((level) => <option key={level} value={level}>{level} Level</option>)}</select></label>
                    <Field label="Department" name="department" value={fields.department} onChange={setField('department')} placeholder="e.g. Computer Science" wide />
                    <Field label="Course" name="course" value={fields.course} onChange={setField('course')} placeholder="Your current course of study" wide />
                    <label className="profile-wide"><span>School</span><input name="school" value={fields.school} readOnly /></label>
                  </div>
                  <ActionRow pending={pending} label="CONTINUE" onBack={() => setStep(1)} />
                </form>
              </>
            )}
            {error && <p className="onboarding-error" role="alert">{error}</p>}
          </section>
        </main>
      )}
      <footer className="onboarding-footer">Â© 2026 UNIVERSE All-in-One Platform. All rights reserved.</footer>
    </div>
  );
}

function Step({ number, active, complete, title, description }) {
  return <div className={`progress-step${active ? ' active' : ''}${complete ? ' complete' : ''}`}><span>{complete ? 'âœ“' : number}</span><div><small>{active ? 'CURRENT STEP' : `STEP ${number}`}</small><strong>{title}</strong><p>{description}</p></div></div>;
}

function Field({ label, name, value, onChange, placeholder, type = 'text', wide = false }) {
  return <label className={wide ? 'profile-wide' : ''}><span>{label}</span><input name={name} type={type} value={value} onChange={onChange} placeholder={placeholder} /></label>;
}

function ActionRow({ pending, label, onBack }) {

===== C:\Users\Admin\Universe-frontend\Universe-frontend\universe-react\src\components\storefront\ProductDetailPage.jsx =====

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Link, useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useStorefront } from '../../hooks/useStorefront';
import { slugifyStoreName } from '../../lib/storeDomain';
import './product-detail.css';
import MaterialIcon from '../../components/ui/MaterialIcon';

function ProductDetailPage() {
  const { storeSlug, productSlug } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { data: store, isLoading, isError, error, refetch } = useStorefront(storeSlug);

  if (isLoading) {
    return <ProductDetailState title="Opening product" text="Loading product details from this storefront." />;
  }

  const product = store?.products.find((item) => slugifyStoreName(item.name) === productSlug);

  if (isError || !store) {
    return <ProductDetailState title="Storefront unavailable" text={error?.message || 'We could not load this private marketplace.'} action="Try again" onAction={() => refetch()} />;
  }

  if (!product) {
    return <ProductDetailState title="Product not found" text="This product may have been removed or the link may be outdated." action="Back to store" onAction={() => navigate(`/store/${store.slug}`)} />;
  }

  const productImages = product.images?.length ? product.images : [product.image];
  return <ProductDetails store={store} product={product} productImages={productImages} />;
}

function ProductDetails({ store, product, productImages }) {
  const [selectedImage, setSelectedImage] = useState(productImages[0]);
  // Map of variant name â†’ chosen value. Values default to the first option so a
  // buyer can add to basket without touching the selectors.
  const [selectedVariants, setSelectedVariants] = useState({});

  // Variant option groups entered by the seller on the Add Product page.
  const variants = (product.variants ?? []).filter(
    (variant) => variant?.name && Array.isArray(variant.values) && variant.values.length > 0,
  );
  const selectedValue = (variant) => selectedVariants[variant.name] ?? variant.values[0];
  const variantLabel = variants
    .map((variant) => `${variant.name}: ${selectedValue(variant)}`)
    .join(' Â· ');

  return (
    <main className="pd-root">
      <div className="pd-shell">
        <Link className="pd-back" to={`/store/${store.slug}`}>
          <MaterialIcon name="arrow_back" />
          Back to {store.name}
        </Link>

        <article className="pd-card">
          <div className="pd-image-panel">
            <img src={selectedImage} alt={product.imageAlt || product.name} className="pd-image" />
            {productImages.length > 1 && (
              <div className="pd-gallery" aria-label="Product images">
                {productImages.map((image, index) => (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className={selectedImage === image ? 'pd-thumbnail active' : 'pd-thumbnail'}
                    key={`${image}-${index}`}
                    onClick={() => setSelectedImage(image)}
                    aria-label={`View product image ${index + 1}`}
                  >
                    <img src={image} alt="" />
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="pd-content">
            <span className="pd-category">{product.categoryLabel}</span>
            <h1>{product.name}</h1>
            <div className="pd-rating">
              {product.rating != null ? (
                <>
                  <MaterialIcon name="star" fill />
                  <strong>{product.rating.toFixed(1)}</strong>
                  <span>{`(${product.reviews ?? 0} reviews)`}</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <span>No reviews yet</span>
              )}
            </div>
            {product.description && <p className="pd-description">{product.description}</p>}
            <div className="pd-price-row">
              <strong>{product.priceLabel ?? 'â€”'}</strong>
              {product.oldPriceLabel && <span>{product.oldPriceLabel}</span>}
            </div>
            <div className="pd-stock">
              <MaterialIcon name="inventory_2" />
              {product.stock == null ? 'Availability confirmed with seller' : `${product.stock} available`}
            </div>
            {variants.length > 0 && (
              <div className="pd-variants" aria-label="Choose product options">
                {variants.map((variant) => {
                  const current = selectedValue(variant);
                  return (
                    <div className="pd-variant" key={variant.name}>
                      <span className="pd-variant-label">
                        {variant.name}: <strong>{current}</strong>
                      </span>
                      <div className="pd-variant-values">
                        {variant.values.map((value) => (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            key={value}
                            className={value === current ? 'pd-variant-value active' : 'pd-variant-value'}
                            aria-pressed={value === current}
                            onClick={() => setSelectedVariants((previous) => ({ ...previous, [variant.name]: value }))}
                          >
                            {value}
                          </button>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="pd-actions">
              <button type="button" className="pd-add" onClick={() => window.alert(`${product.name}${variantLabel ? ` (${variantLabel})` : ''} added to basket`)}>
                <MaterialIcon name="shopping_bag" />
                Add to basket
              </button>
              <button type="button" className="pd-buy" onClick={() => window.alert(`Proceeding to checkout for ${product.name}${variantLabel ? ` (${variantLabel})` : ''}`)}>
                Buy now
                <MaterialIcon name="arrow_forward" />
              </button>
            </div>
            <p className="pd-seller">Sold by <strong>{store.name}</strong></p>
          </div>
        </article>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

function ProductDetailState({ title, text, action, onAction }) {
  return (
    <main className="pd-root">
      <div className="pd-state">
        <MaterialIcon name="inventory_2" className="pd-state-icon" />
        <h1>{title}</h1>
        <p>{text}</p>
        {action && <button type="button" className="pd-buy" onClick={onAction}>{action}</button>}
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

export default ProductDetailPage;

===== C:\Users\Admin\Universe-frontend\Universe-frontend\universe-react\src\components\storefront\StorefrontPage.jsx =====

/**
 * Seller Private Marketplace Storefront â€” pixel-faithful port of
 * seller_private_market_storefront.html.
 *
 * This is the page served on every seller's own domain
 * (storename.<app-domain>, e.g. globalstore.universe.market). It is PUBLIC:
 * buyers visiting a store domain never need an account.
 *
 * Every section, icon, color and interaction matches the original mockup:
 * fixed glass header + page tabs, layered hero with profile mosaic, metric
 * cards, assurance bar, announcement strip, filterable/sortable catalog,
 * wishlist, follow, coupon + share copying and the toast notifications.
 */
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useStorefront } from '../../hooks/useStorefront';
import { getUserInitials } from '../../lib/user';
import { slugifyStoreName } from '../../lib/storeDomain';
import './storefront.css';
import './storefrontTemplates.css';
import MaterialIcon from '../../components/ui/MaterialIcon';

const CATEGORY_TABS = [
  { key: 'all', label: 'All Products' },
  { key: 'tech', label: 'Tech & Gadgets' },
  { key: 'campus', label: 'Campus Essentials' },
  { key: 'lifestyle', label: 'Lifestyle & Accessories' },
];

const PAGE_TABS = [
  { key: 'all-products', label: 'All Products', target: 'sf-catalog' },
  { key: 'collections', label: 'Collections', target: 'sf-catalog' },
  { key: 'about-store', label: 'About Store', target: 'sf-about' },
  { key: 'customer-reviews', label: 'Customer Reviews', target: 'sf-reviews' },
  { key: 'contact-seller', label: 'Contact Seller', target: 'sf-contact' },
];

function StorefrontPage() {
  const { storeSlug } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { data: store, isLoading, isError, error, refetch } = useStorefront(storeSlug);

  const [activePageTab, setActivePageTab] = useState('all-products');
  const [category, setCategory] = useState('all');
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [sort, setSort] = useState('popular');
  const [following, setFollowing] = useState(false);
  const [wishlist, setWishlist] = useState(() => new Set());
  const [cartCount, setCartCount] = useState(3);
  const [toast, setToast] = useState(null);
  const toastTimer = useRef(null);

  // The tab title mirrors the store domain experience.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (store) document.title = `${store.name} â€” UNIVERSE Private Marketplace`;
    return () => {
      document.title = 'Universe - Launch, Manage, and Scale Your Online Marketplace';
    };
  }, [store]);

  useEffect(() => () => {
    if (toastTimer.current) clearTimeout(toastTimer.current);
  }, []);
  /** Toast notifications â€” same behaviour as the mockup's showToast(). */
  const showToast = (message, icon = 'check_circle') => {
    if (toastTimer.current) clearTimeout(toastTimer.current);
    setToast({ message, icon, show: true });
    toastTimer.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setToast((current) => (current ? { ...current, show: false } : current));
    }, 3000);
  };

  const firstName = useMemo(
    () => (store?.owner ?? '').trim().split(/\s+/)[0] || 'the seller',
    [store?.owner],
  );

  /** Category + search filtering and sorting, mirroring the mockup's JS. */
  const visibleProducts = useMemo(() => {
    if (!store) return [];
    const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    const list = store.products.filter((product) => {
      const matchesCategory = category === 'all' || product.category === category;
      const haystack = `${product.name} ${product.categoryLabel}`.toLowerCase();
      const matchesSearch = !q || haystack.includes(q);
      return matchesCategory && matchesSearch;
    });
    const sorted = [...list];
    // Null popularity/price = unknown; unknowns sink to the end instead of
    // pretending a score the backend never sent.
    if (sort === 'popular') sorted.sort((a, b) => (b.popularity ?? -1) - (a.popularity ?? -1));
    else if (sort === 'price-low') sorted.sort((a, b) => (a.price ?? Infinity) - (b.price ?? Infinity));
    else if (sort === 'price-high') sorted.sort((a, b) => (b.price ?? -Infinity) - (a.price ?? -Infinity));
    return sorted; // 'newest' keeps the catalog order
  }, [store, category, query, sort]);

  const toggleFollow = () => {
    setFollowing((was) => {
      showToast(was ? `Unfollowed ${store.name}` : `You are now following ${store.name}!`);
      return !was;
    });
  };

  const toggleWishlist = (product) => {
    setWishlist((current) => {
      const next = new Set(current);
      if (next.has(product.id)) {
        next.delete(product.id);
        showToast('Item removed from wishlist');
      } else {
        next.add(product.id);
        showToast('Saved to wishlist!', 'favorite');
      }
      return next;
    });
  };

  const copyStoreUrl = async () => {
    const url = `https://${store.domain}`;
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);
      showToast('Store URL copied to clipboard!', 'content_copy');
    } catch {
      showToast(`Store link: ${store.domain}`, 'link');
    }
  };

  const applyDiscountBanner = async () => {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(store.couponCode);
      showToast(`Code ${store.couponCode} copied! (10% OFF applied)`, 'sell');
    } catch {
      showToast(`Code: ${store.couponCode}`, 'sell');
    }
  };

  const handleAddToCart = (product) => {
    setCartCount((count) => count + 1);
    showToast(`Added ${product.name} (${product.priceLabel}) to basket!`, 'shopping_bag');
  };

  const handleInstantBuy = (product) => {
    showToast(`Proceeding to Escrow Checkout for ${product.name}...`, 'lock');
  };

  const resetFilters = () => {
    setQuery('');
    setCategory('all');
  };

  const goToSection = (tab) => {
    setActivePageTab(tab.key);
    document.getElementById(tab.target)?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
  };
  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="sf-root">
        <div className="sf-state">
          <MaterialIcon name="storefront" className="sf-state-icon" fill />
          <p className="sf-state-title">Opening storefrontâ€¦</p>
          <p className="sf-state-text">Loading the private marketplace on this domain.</p>
          <div className="sf-loading-grid">
            <div className="sf-loading-bar" />
            <div className="sf-loading-bar" />
            <div className="sf-loading-bar" />
            <div className="sf-loading-bar" />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (isError || !store) {
    return (
      <div className="sf-root">
        <div className="sf-state">
          <MaterialIcon name="domain_disabled" className="sf-state-icon" />
          <p className="sf-state-title">Storefront unavailable</p>
          <p className="sf-state-text">{error?.message || 'We could not load this private marketplace.'}</p>
          <button type="button" className="sf-noresults-btn" onClick={() => refetch()}>
            Try again
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const followerCount = store.followers != null ? store.followers + (following ? 1 : 0) : null;
  // Null followers = the backend tracks none â€” render "â€”" instead of "0.0k".
  const followerLabel = followerCount != null ? `${(followerCount / 1000).toFixed(1)}k` : 'â€”';
  const pageTabs = store.template
    ? PAGE_TABS.filter((tab) => tab.key === 'all-products')
    : PAGE_TABS;

  return (
    <div className="sf-root">
      <StorefrontChrome
        store={store}
        firstName={firstName}
        cartCount={cartCount}
        activePageTab={activePageTab}
        onGoToSection={goToSection}
        pageTabs={pageTabs}
      />
      <main className="sf-main">
        <div className={`sf-page${store?.template ? ` sf-tpl-${store.template}` : ''}`}>
          {store.template && <TemplateGallery store={store} onExplore={() => document.getElementById('sf-catalog')?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' })} />}
          {/* Hero Banner with Layered Profile Mosaic */}
          <div className="sf-hero">
            <div
              className={store.bannerImage ? 'sf-hero-banner' : 'sf-hero-banner sf-banner-fallback'}
              style={store.bannerImage ? { backgroundImage: `url('${store.bannerImage}')` } : undefined}
              role="img"
              aria-label={store.bannerAlt || store.name}
            >
              {!store.bannerImage && (
                <div className="sf-banner-fallback-title">{store.name}</div>
              )}
              <div className="sf-hero-scrim" />
              <div className="sf-hero-status">
                <span className="sf-pulse-dot" />
                Accepting Orders Now
              </div>
            </div>
            {/* Store Profile Bar (Negative Margined Layered Content) */}
            <div className="sf-hero-body">
              <div className="sf-hero-flex">
                {/* Avatar + Store Identity */}
                <div className="sf-hero-identity">
                  <div className="sf-avatar-frame">
                    {store.avatarImage ? (
                      <div
                        className="sf-avatar-img"
                        style={{ backgroundImage: `url('${store.avatarImage}')` }}
                        role="img"
                        aria-label={store.avatarAlt}
                      />
                    ) : (
                      <div className="sf-avatar-fallback" title={store.name}>
                        {getUserInitials(store.name)}
                      </div>
                    )}
                    <div className="sf-avatar-check">
                      <MaterialIcon name="verified" className="sf-i15" fill />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="sf-hero-titleblock">
                    <div className="sf-hero-titlerow">
                      <h1 className="sf-hero-title">{store.name}</h1>
                      {/* Seller's own badge label â€” hidden when the backend
                          provides none. */}
                      {store.badgeLabel && (
                        <span className="sf-toprated">
                          <MaterialIcon name="military_tech" className="sf-i13" />
                          {` ${store.badgeLabel}`}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="sf-hero-subrow">
                      <span>
                        {'Curated by '}
                        <strong className="sf-strong">{store.owner}</strong>
                      </span>
                      <span className="sf-dot2" />
                      <span className="sf-school">
                        <MaterialIcon name="school" className="sf-i16" />
                        {` ${store.school} Verified`}
                      </span>
                      <span className="sf-dot2" />
                      {store.storeId && <span className="sf-storeid">{`ID: ${store.storeId}`}</span>}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
                {/* Store Actions Group */}
                <div className="sf-hero-actions">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className={following ? 'sf-btn-follow following' : 'sf-btn-follow'}
                    onClick={toggleFollow}
                  >
                    <MaterialIcon name={following ? "bookmark_added" : "bookmark_add"} className="sf-i18" />
                    <span>{following ? 'Following' : 'Follow Store'}</span>
                    <span className="sf-follow-count">{followerLabel}</span>
                  </button>
                  <a
                    className="sf-btn-message"
                    href={store.whatsappUrl}
                    rel="noopener noreferrer"
                    target="_blank"
                  >
                    <MaterialIcon name="chat" className="sf-i20" />
                    <span>Message Seller</span>
                  </a>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="sf-btn-share"
                    onClick={copyStoreUrl}
                    title="Share store link"
                  >
                    <MaterialIcon name="share" className="sf-i18" />
                    <span className="sf-share-label">{store.domain}</span>
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
              {/* Metric Cards Grid */}
              <div className="sf-metrics">
                <div className="sf-metric">
                  <div className="sf-metric-icon tone-tertiary">
                    <MaterialIcon name="star" className="sf-i20" fill />
                  </div>
                  <div className="sf-metric-col">
                    <span className="sf-metric-value">{store.rating != null ? `${store.rating.toFixed(1)} â˜…` : 'No rating yet'}</span>
                    <span className="sf-metric-label">{store.reviewCount != null ? `${store.reviewCount.toLocaleString('en-US')} Reviews` : 'No reviews yet'}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="sf-metric">
                  <div className="sf-metric-icon tone-secondary">
                    <MaterialIcon name="speed" className="sf-i20" />
                  </div>
                  <div className="sf-metric-col">
                    <span className="sf-metric-value">{store.fulfillmentLabel ?? 'â€”'}</span>
                    <span className="sf-metric-label">Fulfillment Rate</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="sf-metric">
                  <div className="sf-metric-icon tone-primary">
                    <MaterialIcon name="reply_all" className="sf-i20" />
                  </div>
                  <div className="sf-metric-col">
                    <span className="sf-metric-value">{store.responseTimeLabel ?? 'â€”'}</span>
                    <span className="sf-metric-label">Avg Response Time</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="sf-metric">
                  <div className="sf-metric-icon tone-neutral">
                    <MaterialIcon name="verified_user" className="sf-i20" />
                  </div>
                  <div className="sf-metric-col">
                    <span className="sf-metric-value">{store.memberSinceLabel ?? 'â€”'}</span>
                    <span className="sf-metric-label">Active on UNIVERSE</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

            </div>
          </div>
          {/* Assurance Highlights Bar */}
          <div className="sf-assurances">
            {store.assurances.map((item) => (
              <div className="sf-assurance" key={item.title}>
                <MaterialIcon name={item.icon} className={`tone-${item.tone}`} />
                <div className="sf-assurance-col">
                  <span className="sf-assurance-title">{item.title}</span>
                  <span className="sf-assurance-sub">{item.sub}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          {/* Announcement & Promotion Strip. The coupon elements render only
              when the backend provides a code â€” no invented promotions. */}
          {(store.announcementTitle || store.announcementLead || store.couponCode) && <div className="sf-announce">
            <div className="sf-announce-blur" />
            <div className="sf-announce-row">
              <div className="sf-announce-left">
                <div className="sf-announce-icon">
                  <MaterialIcon name="celebration" className="sf-i26" />
                </div>
                <div className="sf-announce-text">
                  <div className="sf-announce-titlerow">
                    <span className="sf-announce-title">{store.announcementTitle}</span>
                    {store.couponCode && <span className="sf-limited">LIMITED TIME</span>}
                  </div>
                  <p className="sf-announce-sub">
                    {store.announcementLead}
                    {store.couponCode && <span className="sf-coupon">{` ${store.couponCode}`}</span>}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
              {store.couponCode && (
                <button type="button" className="sf-btn-coupon" onClick={applyDiscountBanner}>
                  <MaterialIcon name="content_copy" className="sf-i18" />
                  <span>Copy Coupon</span>
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>}

          {/* Main Catalog Section */}
          <div className="sf-catalog" id="sf-catalog">
            {/* Section Title & Filter Tabs */}
            <div className="sf-catalog-head">
              <div className="sf-catalog-titlerow">
                <div>
                  <span className="sf-eyebrow">Catalog Selection</span>
                  <h2 className="sf-catalog-title">{`${firstName}'s Verified Inventory`}</h2>
                </div>
                {/* Seller assurance copy â€” hidden entirely when the backend
                    provides none (never a fabricated assurance). */}
                {store.stockNote && (
                  <div className="sf-stocknote">
                    <span className="sf-stockdot" />
                    <span>{store.stockNote}</span>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
              {/* Category Pills Bar & Controls */}
              <div className="sf-controls">
                <div className="sf-pills">
                  {CATEGORY_TABS.map((tab) => (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      key={tab.key}
                      className={category === tab.key ? 'sf-pill active' : 'sf-pill'}
                      onClick={() => setCategory(tab.key)}
                    >
                      {`${tab.label} (${store.catalogCounts[tab.key] ?? 0})`}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
                {/* In-Store Search & Sort Controls */}
                <div className="sf-controls-right">
                  <div className="sf-filter-search">
                    <span className="sf-filter-icon">
                      <MaterialIcon name="search" className="sf-i18" />
                    </span>
                    <input
                      className="sf-filter-input"
                      type="text"
                      placeholder="Filter store items..."
                      value={query}
                      onChange={(event) => setQuery(event.target.value)}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div className="sf-sort">
                    <select
                      className="sf-sort-select"
                      value={sort}
                      onChange={(event) => setSort(event.target.value)}
                      aria-label="Sort products"
                    >
                      <option value="popular">Most Popular</option>
                      <option value="price-low">Price: Low to High</option>
                      <option value="price-high">Price: High to Low</option>
                      <option value="newest">Newest Arrivals</option>
                    </select>
                    <span className="sf-sort-caret">
                      <MaterialIcon name="expand_more" className="sf-i16" />
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            {/* Products Grid */}
            <div className="sf-grid">
              {visibleProducts.map((product) => (
                <ProductCard
                  key={product.id}
                  product={product}
                  wishlisted={wishlist.has(product.id)}
                  onToggleWishlist={toggleWishlist}
                  onAddToCart={handleAddToCart}
                  onInstantBuy={handleInstantBuy}
                  onOpen={() => navigate(`/store/${store.slug}/${slugifyStoreName(product.name)}`)}
                />
              ))}
            </div>
            {/* Empty State for Search Filter */}
            {visibleProducts.length === 0 && (
              <div className="sf-noresults">
                <MaterialIcon name="search_off" className="sf-i48" />
                <h4 className="sf-noresults-title">No Products Found</h4>
                <p className="sf-noresults-text">
                  Try tweaking your search keyword or explore other verified categories.
                </p>
                <button type="button" className="sf-noresults-btn" onClick={resetFilters}>
                  Reset Search
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
          {/* Secondary seller details stay off template storefronts so products remain the focus. */}
          {!store.template && <div className="sf-bento">
            {/* Bio & Verification Card (5 Cols) */}
            <div className="sf-bio" id="sf-about">
              <div className="sf-bio-inner">
                <div className="sf-bio-head">
                  <div className="sf-bio-icon">
                    <MaterialIcon name="store" className="sf-i24" />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span className="sf-bio-eyebrow">Merchant Story</span>
                    <h3 className="sf-bio-title">{`About ${store.name}`}</h3>
                  </div>
                </div>
                {/* Seller's own bio copy â€” each part renders only when the
                    backend provides it; nothing is invented here. */}
                {store.bioLead && <p className="sf-bio-lead">{store.bioLead}</p>}
                {store.bioDetail && <p className="sf-bio-detail">{store.bioDetail}</p>}
                <div className="sf-bio-badges">
                  {store.bioBadges.map((badge) => (
                    <span className="sf-bio-badge" key={badge.label}>
                      <MaterialIcon name={badge.icon} className={`sf-i15 tone-${badge.tone}`} />
                      {badge.label}
                    </span>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
              {/* Direct Contact Info Strip */}
              <div className="sf-contact" id="sf-contact">
                <span className="sf-contact-label">Verified Contact Channels</span>
                <div className="sf-contact-row">
                  <span className="sf-contact-key">
                    <MaterialIcon name="call" className="sf-i16" />
                    {' Phone / WhatsApp:'}
                  </span>
                  {store.phone ? <a className="sf-contact-val" href={`tel:${store.phone}`}>{store.phone}</a> : <span className="sf-contact-val">Not provided</span>}
                </div>
                <div className="sf-contact-row">
                  <span className="sf-contact-key">
                    <MaterialIcon name="mail" className="sf-i16" />
                    {' Official Email:'}
                  </span>
                  {store.email ? <a className="sf-contact-val" href={`mailto:${store.email}`}>{store.email}</a> : <span className="sf-contact-val">Not provided</span>}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            {/* Campus Customer Reviews Section (7 Cols) */}
            <div className="sf-reviews" id="sf-reviews">
              <div>
                <div className="sf-reviews-head">
                  <div>
                    <span className="sf-reviews-eyebrow">Verified Buyer Trust</span>
                    <h3 className="sf-reviews-title">What Students Say</h3>
                  </div>
                  <div className="sf-rating-pill">
                    <MaterialIcon name="star" className="sf-i18" fill />
                    <strong>{store.rating != null ? `${store.rating.toFixed(1)} / 5.0` : 'No rating yet'}</strong>
                  </div>
                </div>
                {/* Reviews Grid */}
                <div className="sf-review-list">
                  {store.reviews.map((review) => (
                    <div className="sf-review" key={review.id}>
                      <div className="sf-review-top">
                        <div className="sf-review-who">
                          <div className={`sf-review-avatar tone-${review.avatarTone}`}>{review.initials}</div>
                          <div className="sf-review-id">
                            <span className="sf-review-name">{review.name}</span>
                            <span className="sf-review-meta">{review.meta}</span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="sf-review-stars">
                          {[0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map((starIndex) => (
                            <MaterialIcon name="star" className="sf-i14" fill />
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <p className="sf-review-text">{review.text}</p>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
              {/* Rating Breakdown Bar Mini Visual */}
              <div className="sf-reviews-foot">
                <div className="sf-reviews-foot-left">
                  <MaterialIcon name="verified" className="sf-i18" />
                  <span>{store.reviewsNote ?? 'No reviews yet'}</span>
                </div>
                <a className="sf-reviews-link" href="#sf-reviews" onClick={(event) => event.preventDefault()}>
                  {'Read all reviews '}
                  <MaterialIcon name="arrow_forward" className="sf-i14" />
                </a>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>}
        </div>
      </main>

      <div className={toast?.show ? 'sf-toast show' : 'sf-toast'}>
        <MaterialIcon name={toast?.icon ?? "check_circle"} className="sf-i20" />
        <span className="sf-toast-msg">{toast?.message ?? 'Action completed'}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
/**
 * Fixed glass header â€” store identity, catalog search, WhatsApp/cart/avatar
 * actions and the secondary page-tabs row with the campus pickup note.
 * Structure and iconography match the mockup's <header> 1:1.
 */
function StorefrontChrome({ store, firstName, cartCount, activePageTab, onGoToSection, pageTabs }) {
  return (
    <header className={`sf-header${store.template ? ` sf-header-tpl-${store.template}` : ''}`}>
      <div className="sf-header-inner">
        <div className="sf-header-row">
          <div className="sf-brand">
            <div className="sf-brand-col">
              <div className="sf-brand-row">
                <span className="sf-brand-name">{store.name}</span>
                <span className="sf-brand-verified" title="Verified Merchant">
                  <MaterialIcon name="verified" className="sf-i18" />
                </span>
                <span className="sf-brand-rating">
                  <MaterialIcon name="star" className="sf-i14" fill />
                  {store.rating != null ? store.rating.toFixed(1) : 'â€”'}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="sf-brand-row">
                <span className="sf-brand-owner">{`by ${store.owner}`}</span>
                {/* Seller's own campus tag â€” hidden when the backend provides
                    none. */}
                {store.campusTag && (
                  <>
                    <span className="sf-dot" />
                    <span className="sf-brand-campus">
                      <MaterialIcon name="school" className="sf-i14" />
                      {store.campusTag}
                    </span>
                  </>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="sf-header-search">
            <div className="sf-search-wrap">
              <span className="sf-search-icon">
                <MaterialIcon name="search" className="sf-i20" />
              </span>
              <input
                className="sf-search-input"
                type="text"
                placeholder={`Search in ${firstName}'s catalog...`}
                aria-label="Search this store's catalog"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="sf-header-actions">
            <a
              className="sf-btn-whatsapp"
              href={store.whatsappUrl}
              rel="noopener noreferrer"
              target="_blank"
              type="button"
            >
              <MaterialIcon name="chat" className="sf-i18" />
              <span>WhatsApp</span>
            </a>
            <button className="sf-btn-cart" type="button" aria-label={`Basket, ${cartCount} items`}>
              <MaterialIcon name="shopping_bag" className="sf-i22" />
              <span className="sf-cart-badge">{cartCount}</span>
            </button>
            <div className="sf-avatar-circle">
              {store.avatarImage ? (
                <img className="sf-avatar-circle-img" src={store.avatarImage} alt={store.avatarAlt || store.name} />
              ) : (
                <span className="sf-avatar-circle-initials">{getUserInitials(store.name)}</span>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="sf-header-navrow">
          <nav className="sf-page-tabs" aria-label="Store sections">
            {pageTabs.map((tab) => (
              <button
                key={tab.key}
                type="button"
                aria-current={activePageTab === tab.key ? 'page' : undefined}
                className={activePageTab === tab.key ? 'sf-page-tab active' : 'sf-page-tab'}
                onClick={() => onGoToSection(tab)}
              >
                {tab.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </nav>
          {/* Pickup note derives from the seller's real pickupLocation â€”
              hidden entirely when there is none. */}
          {store.pickupNote && (
            <div className="sf-pickup-note">
              <MaterialIcon name="storefront" className="sf-i16" />
              <span>{store.pickupNote}</span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </header>
  );
}

function TemplateGallery({ store, onExplore }) {
  const copy = store.template === 'tech-essentials-pro'
    ? { eyebrow: 'Verified hardware', title: 'Tools for serious study and work.', text: 'Certified tech, practical accessories, and reliable gear selected for campus life.' }
    : store.template === 'campus-quick-mart'
      ? { eyebrow: 'Fast campus essentials', title: 'Good deals, ready when you are.', text: 'Everyday essentials stocked close by, packed quickly, and ready for pickup or delivery.' }
      : { eyebrow: 'Curated campus living', title: 'Useful things, beautifully chosen.', text: 'A considered edit of accessories, study pieces, and lifestyle essentials from a trusted local seller.' };
  const images = store.bannerImages?.length ? store.bannerImages : (store.bannerImage ? [store.bannerImage] : []);
  const [activeImageIndex, setActiveImageIndex] = useState(0);
  const galleryRef = useRef(null);
  const galleryPaused = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    setActiveImageIndex((current) => Math.min(current, Math.max(images.length - 1, 0)));
  }, [images.length]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (images.length < 2 || window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return undefined;
    const timer = window.setInterval(() => {
      if (galleryPaused.current) return;
      setActiveImageIndex((current) => (current + 1) % images.length);
    }, 3200);

    return () => window.clearInterval(timer);
  }, [images.length]);

  return (
    <section className="sf-template-gallery" aria-labelledby="sf-template-gallery-title">
      <div className="sf-template-gallery-copy">
        <span className="sf-template-eyebrow">{copy.eyebrow}</span>
        <h1 id="sf-template-gallery-title">{copy.title}</h1>
        <p>{copy.text} {`Curated by ${store.owner}.`}</p>
        <button type="button" className="sf-template-primary-action" onClick={onExplore}>Shop the collection <MaterialIcon name="arrow_downward" className="sf-i18" /></button>
      </div>
      <div className="sf-template-gallery-media">
        <div
          ref={galleryRef}
          className="sf-template-gallery-rail"
          aria-label={`${store.name} storefront images`}
          onMouseEnter={() => { galleryPaused.current = true; }}
          onMouseLeave={() => { galleryPaused.current = false; }}
          onFocus={() => { galleryPaused.current = true; }}
          onBlur={() => { galleryPaused.current = false; }}
        >
          {images.length ? (
            <figure className="sf-template-gallery-card" key={images[activeImageIndex]}>
              <img src={images[activeImageIndex]} alt={`${store.name} storefront view ${activeImageIndex + 1}`} />
              <figcaption>{activeImageIndex === 0 ? 'Storefront collection' : `Collection view ${activeImageIndex + 1}`}</figcaption>
            </figure>
          ) : <div className="sf-template-gallery-empty">Seller images will appear here.</div>}
        </div>
        {images.length > 1 && (
          <div className="sf-template-gallery-dots" aria-label="Choose storefront image">
            {images.map((image, index) => (
              <button
                type="button"
                key={image}
                className={index === activeImageIndex ? 'active' : ''}
                aria-label={`Show storefront image ${index + 1}`}
                aria-current={index === activeImageIndex ? 'true' : undefined}
                onClick={() => setActiveImageIndex(index)}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
/**
 * One product card â€” image with hover zoom, stock/campus/badge pills,
 * wishlist heart, category + rating meta, Naira price and the
 * Add / Buy Now action pair. Exactly the mockup's .product-card markup.
 */
function ProductCard({ product, wishlisted, onToggleWishlist, onAddToCart, onInstantBuy, onOpen }) {
  const categoryTone = product.category === 'tech' ? 'tone-primary' : 'tone-secondary';
  return (
    <article
      className="sf-card sf-card-clickable"
      onClick={onOpen}
      onKeyDown={(event) => {
        if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') {
          event.preventDefault();
          onOpen();
        }
      }}
      role="link"
      tabIndex={0}
    >
      <div className="sf-card-media">
        <div
          className="sf-card-img"
          style={{ backgroundImage: `url('${product.image}')` }}
          role="img"
          aria-label={product.imageAlt}
        />
        <div className="sf-card-badges">
          {product.badge === 'flash' && (
            <span className="sf-badge sf-badge-flash">-20% FLASH SALE</span>
          )}
          {product.badge === 'bestseller' && (
            <span className="sf-badge sf-badge-best">Best Seller</span>
          )}
          {product.stock != null && product.stock > 0 && (
            <span className="sf-badge sf-badge-stock">
              <span className="sf-badge-dot" />
              {` In Stock (${product.stock} available)`}
            </span>
          )}
          {product.campusPickup && (
            <span className="sf-badge sf-badge-pickup">
              <MaterialIcon name="location_on" className="sf-i12" />
              Campus Pickup Available
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          className={wishlisted ? 'sf-wish active' : 'sf-wish'}
          onClick={(event) => { event.stopPropagation(); onToggleWishlist(product); }}
          title="Save to wishlist"
          aria-label={wishlisted ? `Remove ${product.name} from wishlist` : `Save ${product.name} to wishlist`}
        >
          <MaterialIcon name="favorite" className="sf-i18" fill={wishlisted} />
        </button>
      </div>
      <div className="sf-card-body">
        <div>
          <div className="sf-card-meta">
            <span className={`sf-card-cat ${categoryTone}`}>{product.categoryLabel}</span>
            <div className="sf-card-rating">
              {product.rating != null && (
                <>
                  <MaterialIcon name="star" className="sf-i14" fill />
                  <span>{product.rating.toFixed(1)}</span>
                  <span className="sf-muted">{`(${product.reviews ?? 0})`}</span>
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
          <h3 className="sf-card-name">{product.name}</h3>
          <p className="sf-card-desc">{product.description}</p>
        </div>
        <div className="sf-card-pricing">
          <div className="sf-price-row">
            <span className="sf-price">{product.priceLabel ?? 'â€”'}</span>
            {product.oldPriceLabel && <span className="sf-oldprice">{product.oldPriceLabel}</span>}
          </div>
          <div className="sf-card-actions">
            <button type="button" className="sf-btn-add" onClick={(event) => { event.stopPropagation(); onAddToCart(product); }}>
              <MaterialIcon name="shopping_bag" className="sf-i18" />
              <span>Add</span>
            </button>
            <button type="button" className="sf-btn-buy" onClick={(event) => { event.stopPropagation(); onInstantBuy(product); }}>
              <span>Buy Now</span>
              <MaterialIcon name="arrow_forward" className="sf-i16" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}

===== C:\Users\Admin\Universe-frontend\Universe-frontend\universe-react\src\components\ui\Button.jsx =====

import { useRef } from 'react';

const Button = ({ children, className = "", onClick, type = "button", ...props }) => {
  const btnRef = useRef(null);

  const handleClick = (e) => {
    const btn = btnRef.current;
    if (!btn) return;

    const rect = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
    const ripple = document.createElement("span");
    const size = Math.max(rect.width, rect.height);
    const x = e.clientX - rect.left - size / 2;
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top - size / 2;

    ripple.style.width = ripple.style.height = `${size}px`;
    ripple.style.left = `${x}px`;
    ripple.style.top = `${y}px`;
    ripple.classList.add("ripple");

    const existingRipple = btn.querySelector(".ripple");
    if (existingRipple) {
      existingRipple.remove();
    }

    btn.appendChild(ripple);

    if (onClick) {
      onClick(e);
    }
  };

  return (
    <button
      ref={btnRef}
      type={type}
      className={`btn ${className}`}
      onClick={handleClick}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
};

export default Button;

===== C:\Users\Admin\Universe-frontend\Universe-frontend\universe-react\src\components\ui\Counter.jsx =====

import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

const Counter = ({ value, duration = 1500, prefix = "", suffix = "" }) => {
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);
  const elementRef = useRef(null);
  const hasAnimated = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([entry]) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting && !hasAnimated.current) {
          hasAnimated.current = true;
          let startTimestamp = null;
          const step = (timestamp) => {
            if (!startTimestamp) startTimestamp = timestamp;
            const progress = Math.min((timestamp - startTimestamp) / duration, 1);
            setCount(Math.floor(progress * value));
            if (progress < 1) {
              window.requestAnimationFrame(step);
            }
          };
          window.requestAnimationFrame(step);
        }
      },
      { threshold: 0.1 }
    );

    if (elementRef.current) {
      observer.observe(elementRef.current);
    }

    return () => {
      if (elementRef.current) {
        observer.unobserve(elementRef.current);
      }
    };
  }, [value, duration]);

  return (
    <span ref={elementRef}>
      {prefix}
      {count.toLocaleString()}
      {suffix}
    </span>
  );
};

export default Counter;

===== C:\Users\Admin\Universe-frontend\Universe-frontend\universe-react\src\components\ui\MaterialIcon.jsx =====

import paths from './materialIconPaths.json';

/** Ligature names that don't exist as glyphs (rendered as raw text in the
 *  old font); map them to their closest real icons. */
const ALIASES = {
  phone: 'call',
  unpublish: 'publish',
};

/**
 * Inline-SVG replacement for the Material Symbols Outlined icon font.
 *
 * Renders the icon at 1em so the existing size classes (sf-i14, sf-i16,
 * sd-nav-icon, ap-loc-icon, ...) keep working via font-size, and inherits
 * `currentColor` so all existing color classes/hover states work unchanged.
 *
 * Paths are Google's static opsz-24 SVGs â€” the same optical size the icon
 * font rendered at ('opsz' 24), so stroke weight and glyph size match.
 *
 * Fill handling mirrors the font's FILL axis:
 *  - `fill` prop sets data-fill on the <svg>
 *  - CSS shows .mi-f / hides .mi-o for [data-fill], or for any selector that
 *    used to apply font-variation-settings 'FILL' 1 (e.g. active nav links)
 *
 * Usage:
 *   <MaterialIcon name="add" />
 *   <MaterialIcon name="star" fill className="sf-i14" />
 */
export default function MaterialIcon({ name, fill = false, className = '', style, ...rest }) {
  const key = ALIASES[name] ?? name;
  const outlineD = paths.outline[key];
  const fillD = paths.fill[key];

  if (!outlineD) {
    if (import.meta.env?.DEV) {
      console.warn(`[MaterialIcon] Unknown icon: "${name}"`);
    }
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <svg
      // Keep the legacy class: dashboard/storefront CSS sizes icons via
      // descendant selectors like `.sd-add-btn .material-symbols-outlined`.
      // font-family has no effect on SVG, but font-size drives the 1em size.
      className={`material-symbols-outlined${className ? ` ${className}` : ''}`}
      style={style}
      viewBox="0 -960 960 960"
      width="1em"
      height="1em"
      fill="currentColor"
      aria-hidden="true"
      focusable="false"
      data-fill={fill && fillD ? '' : undefined}
      {...rest}
    >
      <path className="mi-o" d={outlineD} />
      {fillD && <path className="mi-f" d={fillD} />}
    </svg>
  );
}
